info.title: Adventure Land socket API (unofficial)
info.description:
**Unofficial.** The Socket.IO protocol of the MMO [Adventure Land](https://adventure.land),
generated from the machine-readable schema of the Adventure Land API reference (`schema/`), which
is written from the live game's open-source server, [kaansoral/adventureland_mongodb](https://github.com/kaansoral/adventureland_mongodb) at
commit `987831288c40928b959bc06a626a4d67cd0c98ca` (server version 15555, G version 17478).
Adventure Land and its code belong to its author; the game's code is under the
"AdventureLandOnlyUse" license, which asks for attribution and a link to https://adventure.land.

**Connecting.** Get a server's `address` and `path` from the HTTP API (`servers_and_characters`
or `get_servers`), then open a Socket.IO v4 WebSocket to
`wss://{address}{path}/?EIO=4&transport=websocket&map_protocol=1&no_graphics=1`. Each
message here is one Socket.IO event, `42["<name>", <payload>]` on the wire: the message `name`
is the event name, the payload is the JSON value. A message with no payload is
`socket.emit("<name>")`.

**HTTP API.** Login, the server list and character management are HTTP, not Socket.IO, so they
are not in this document: `POST https://adventure.land/api/<method>` with a JSON body (the
reference's "HTTP API" guide).

**Replies.** Most requests are answered on `game_response` with `place` (the request) and
`response` (the code); `fail.<event>` messages list every failure form, and `x-al-failures`
on each send operation gives the check, in handler order, behind each code. Several handlers
copy `request_id` from the request into the reply (correlationId).

**Extensions** (`x-al-*`, where AsyncAPI has no slot): `x-al-order` (send order of the success
path), `x-al-also` (events the server also sends, to you or to others), `x-al-failures` (check
-> reply rows), `x-al-no-reply` (cases where the server sends nothing or closes the socket),
`x-al-variants` (request variants), `x-al-confirm` (where the shape is confirmed: code lines of
the live server, or live captures), `x-al-coerce` (how the server converts a field),
`x-al-extends` (the base type of a flattened object), `x-al-source` (`path:line` in the server
code at the pinned commit).

license.name: Unofficial reference. Game code: AdventureLandOnlyUse (attribution and a link to https://adventure.land required)

game.title: A game server (Socket.IO v4, JSON frames)
game.description: Each game server (EU I, US II, ...) has its own `address` and `path`; they come from the server list of the HTTP API and change. Add a `/` after `path`, then the query of the channel binding. A second endpoint at `msgpack_path` speaks the game's own MessagePack framing; it carries the same events and is not described here.

address.description: `address` of the server list entry (host, maybe with a port).

path.description: `path` of the server list entry (the Socket.IO path).

socket.title: The game socket
socket.description: The default Socket.IO namespace of a game server. Every event goes both ways on this one connection; the message `name` is the Socket.IO event name.

map_protocol.description: The client understands generated maps; without it the server cannot send one.

no_graphics.description: Generated maps arrive without tile data.

broadcast.description: A public camera that follows active groups.

receive.achievement_progress.title: Receive achievement_progress
receive.achievement_progress.summary: Progress on the achievement counter of an equipped item. The server sends it each time the count goes past a multiple of the `rr` step of the achievement.

receive.action.title: Receive action
receive.action.summary: An attack, heal or projectile skill started. The result arrives later as `hit`.

receive.blocker.title: Receive blocker
receive.blocker.summary: The reply to the client's `blocker` request. It tells if the arena PvP blocker lets players through.

receive.cave.title: Receive cave
receive.cave.summary: State of a Cave of Many Dreams run (a generated dungeon for a party).

receive.ccreport.title: Receive ccreport
receive.ccreport.summary: The reply to the client's `ccreport` request.

receive.chat_log.title: Receive chat_log
receive.chat_log.summary: Public chat, or an NPC or monster that speaks.

receive.chest_opened.title: Receive chest_opened
receive.chest_opened.summary: The result of a chest open.

receive.citizen.title: Receive citizen
receive.citizen.summary: An animation or effect of a town NPC (a citizen).

receive.cm.title: Receive cm
receive.cm.summary: A code message from another character. The `cm` request lets characters send data to each other.

receive.code_eval.title: Receive code_eval
receive.code_eval.summary: Sends an `o:command` from an observer socket to the socket of the observed player, so the player's code can react.

receive.correction.title: Receive correction
receive.correction.summary: The server's position for the player.

receive.death.title: Receive death
receive.death.summary: A monster died. `remove_monster` sends it; its default `method` is `"death"`.

receive.dice.title: Receive dice
receive.dice.summary: The state of the tavern dice round.

receive.disappear.title: Receive disappear
receive.disappear.summary: An entity left view or stopped existing (transport, invisibility, disconnect, monster removal), or a skill target is not there.

receive.disappearing_text.title: Receive disappearing_text
receive.disappearing_text.summary: Floating text over an entity or a point (damage numbers, `+gold`, `NO HITS`, and so on).

receive.disconnect_reason.title: Receive disconnect_reason
receive.disconnect_reason.summary: The server sends it before it disconnects a socket, or broadcasts it before a shutdown.

receive.drop.title: Receive drop
receive.drop.summary: A loot chest appeared for this player or party.

receive.duel.title: Receive duel
receive.duel.summary: The server sends it to the challenged player when someone challenges them to a duel.

receive.emote.title: Receive emote
receive.emote.summary: A player used an emote skill (a skill with `emote` in `G.skills`).

receive.entities.title: Receive entities
receive.entities.summary: Position and state updates for the players and monsters that the receiver can see.

receive.eval.title: Receive eval
receive.eval.summary: Asks the client to run a code snippet (UI timers and visual effects).

receive.game_chat.title: Receive game_chat
receive.game_chat.summary: A system line for the chat panel (GM mute feedback, duel results).

receive.game_event.title: Receive game_event
receive.game_event.summary: A world event or boss appeared.

receive.game_log.title: Receive game_log
receive.game_log.summary: A line for the log panel of the player: errors without a response code, loot, gold, and so on. About 140 call sites send it.

receive.game_response.title: Receive game_response
receive.game_response.summary: The reply channel for requests. Most handlers send their result or their failure as `game_response`.

receive.gm.title: Receive gm
receive.gm.summary: The reply to a GM-only `gm` request with `action: "jump_list"`.

receive.hardcore_info.title: Receive hardcore_info
receive.hardcore_info.summary: The state and reward winners of a HARDCORE server.

receive.hit.title: Receive hit
receive.hit.summary: Damage, a heal, a miss or an evade reached an entity.

receive.invite.title: Receive invite
receive.invite.summary: Someone invited this player to their party.

receive.kill_credit.title: Receive kill_credit
receive.kill_credit.summary: The player got credit for a monster kill.

receive.light.title: Receive light
receive.light.summary: A `light` skill or a monster `mlight` event showed the invisible players nearby.

receive.limitdcreport.title: Receive limitdcreport
receive.limitdcreport.summary: The server sends it right before a `limitdc` disconnect.

receive.lostandfound.title: Receive lostandfound
receive.lostandfound.summary: The item list of the lost and found NPC. The request needs a donation first.

receive.magiport.title: Receive magiport
receive.magiport.summary: A mage offers to magiport this player.

receive.map_chunk.title: Receive map_chunk
receive.map_chunk.summary: A part of a generated map (the Cave of Many Dreams). The server sends the map before `welcome` or `new_map` when the destination is a generated map.

receive.map_info.title: Receive map_info
receive.map_info.summary: The state of a duel: the countdown and the two teams. The server sends it each second while the duel runs.

receive.merrit_gift.title: Receive merrit_gift
receive.merrit_gift.summary: Merrit gave a market parcel to this player.

receive.merrit_status.title: Receive merrit_status
receive.merrit_status.summary: The status of Merrit, the market patron NPC that gives a parcel to merchants with an open stand in town.

receive.new_map.title: Receive new_map
receive.new_map.summary: The server sends it when a player or observer moves to another map or instance.

receive.notice.title: Receive notice
receive.notice.summary: A system notice for everyone (live reload failure, event monsters, Goo Brawl, admin notice).

receive.observer_broadcast.title: Receive observer_broadcast
receive.observer_broadcast.summary: The state of the automatic camera, for the public broadcast observer. The camera follows active groups of players and moves every 250 ms.

receive.online.title: Receive online
receive.online.summary: A friend came online on some server.

receive.party_update.title: Receive party_update
receive.party_update.summary: The party changed: someone joined or left, or the info of a member changed.

receive.player.title: Receive player
receive.player.summary: The full state of your character. Most actions that change the character send it.

receive.players.title: Receive players
receive.players.summary: The player list of the server, or the pets of the player.

receive.pm.title: Receive pm
receive.pm.summary: A private message. The sender gets a copy too.

receive.pvp_list.title: Receive pvp_list
receive.pvp_list.summary: The reply to `list_pvp`: the last 200 PvP kills on this server.

receive.q_data.title: Receive q_data
receive.q_data.summary: The progress of an upgrade or compound while the timer runs: the digits of the hidden roll, and the success or failure flags.

receive.reloaded.title: Receive reloaded
receive.reloaded.summary: The server sends it after a live reload of the game data (`G`, `D`).

receive.request.title: Receive request
receive.request.summary: Someone asked to join the party of this player.

receive.secondhands.title: Receive secondhands
receive.secondhands.summary: The item list of the secondhands NPC.

receive.server_info.title: Receive server_info
receive.server_info.summary: The server sends its event state S (`E` in the code) each time it changes and every 24 s. S holds boss timers, duels, `abtesting`, `goobrawl` and holidays.

receive.server_message.title: Receive server_message
receive.server_message.summary: A server-wide announcement line (level ups, rare finds, high upgrades, big chest loot, events that start or end).

receive.simple_eval.title: Receive simple_eval
receive.simple_eval.summary: The reply to the admin-only `render` request (needs `data.pass == keys.ACCESS_MASTER`).

receive.skill_timeout.title: Receive skill_timeout
receive.skill_timeout.summary: Tells the client to start (or start again) a cooldown.

receive.start.title: Receive start
receive.start.summary: The server sends it after a successful character login. It is the full start state of the character.

receive.tauri_auth.title: Receive tauri_auth
receive.tauri_auth.summary: The desktop (Tauri) Steam check succeeded at login.

receive.tauri_auth_error.title: Receive tauri_auth_error
receive.tauri_auth_error.summary: The desktop (Tauri) Steam check failed at login. The login continues with platform `web`.

receive.test.title: Receive test
receive.test.summary: The reply to the client's `test` event.

receive.track.title: Receive track
receive.track.summary: The result of the ranger skill `track`.

receive.tracker.title: Receive tracker
receive.tracker.summary: The kill statistics of the character and the drop tables of the server, for the tracker UI.

receive.trade_history.title: Receive trade_history
receive.trade_history.summary: The trade history of the player.

receive.ui.title: Receive ui
receive.ui.summary: A visual event about an entity: level up, skill animations, NPC trades, sends, resists, tavern games and so on. The official client uses it for effects and log lines.

receive.upgrade.title: Receive upgrade
receive.upgrade.summary: Plays an NPC animation for an upgrade, compound, exchange or similar.

receive.welcome.title: Receive welcome
receive.welcome.summary: The server sends it right after a socket connects, before any login. It names the server and gives the start position of the observer camera.

send.activate.title: Send activate
send.activate.summary: Activates an equipped item (`etherealamulet`, `angelwings`, `tristone`, `darktristone`) or an inventory item (`frozenstone`, `bkey`, `ukey`, `dkey`).

list.name: Equipment
list.when: Activates an equipped item: `etherealamulet`, `angelwings`, `tristone` or `darktristone`.

list.name: Inventory
list.when: Uses an inventory item: `frozenstone`, `bkey`, `ukey` or `dkey`.

Inventory: for `bkey`, `ukey` or `dkey`: `game_response` (`"door_unlocked"` or `"bank_pack_unlocked"`, a bare string) to you

x-al-failures.when: No character.
The slot is empty, or it is a trade slot.
`etherealamulet`, less than 120 ms after its last use (`mssince(last_ethereal) < 120`).
`angelwings`, the `snow_angel` skin is not on, and the wings are below +8 or you are not a mage or a priest.
The item is not one of the four items above.
`bkey`, `ukey` or `dkey`, and you are not in the bank.
`bkey` or `ukey`, and that bank area is unlocked already. The server keeps the key.
`dkey`, and you have every pack already. The server keeps the key.

x-al-also.when: `etherealamulet`, after the `eval`: a normal update (`u+cid`), without `reopen`.
x-al-also.summary: Your state with `s.ethereal` (`{ms: 5000}`).

send.attack.title: Send attack
send.attack.summary: Attacks a monster or a character. It is a short form of `skill` with `name: "attack"`.

x-al-failures.when: No character.
You are disabled: dead (`rip`), or `stunned`, `fingered`, `stoned`, `deepfreezed` or `sleeping`. Silence and the `konami` skin do not stop `attack`.
The attack is on cooldown. The cooldown is `attack_ms` (`round(1000 / frequency)`, node/server.js:1627) plus any `penalty_cd`, up to 10,000 ms.
The map is `safe`.
`id` is missing or `null`.
`id` is your own name.
No monster with that id is in your instance, and no character has that name. Or the target is invisible, or more than `B.max_vision` (1,000 px) from you.
The target is farther than `range + xrange`. `xrange` is a leeway of up to 25 px; an attack that uses it lowers it.
`commence_attack`: your instance or the instance of the target is paused.

confirm.note: The skill handler adds `response: "data"` to the returned object

x-al-failures.when: `commence_attack`: you or the target is a cave actor, and the cave rules say that the target is not hostile.
`commence_attack`: you are a merchant without a `dartgun` in `mainhand`.
`commence_attack`: `mode.pvp_level_gap` is on (only on the `HARDCORE` server), the target is a character, and your levels differ by more than 10.
`commence_attack`: the target is a character that is not in a PvP area (`is_in_pvp`), or the target is an NPC.
`commence_attack`: your `mp` is less than your `mp_cost`.

`commence_attack`: you are on a `safe` map; or the map is `duelland` and you or the target is not in the duel; or `mode.friendly_fire` is off (it is on, node/server.js:286) and the target is in your party or guild.

x-al-also.when: Success. Every client whose view holds you, and the target.

confirm.note: Sent before `response` and `place` are added (node/server.js:3609-3610)

x-al-also.when: Success: the cooldown starts. Also before `action` for `invis` when the attack ends your invisibility.
Success, after `skill_timeout`. It has `reopen: true` for a merchant (gold changed). A failure sends it too when the attack removed your `invincible` condition.
x-al-also.summary: Your new `mp`, `target`, and empty `c` (the attack stops your channeled actions).

x-al-also.when: Later: when the projectile arrives, after `eta` ms (at once for an instant projectile).
x-al-also.summary: The result of the hit. Look for `pid` of the `Action`.

confirm.note: `complete_attack` can also return without any `hit` (node/server.js:3708-3714)

send.auth.title: Send auth
send.auth.summary: Logs a character into this game server. The socket must be an observer: send `auth` after `loaded`.

shared: later: `game_response` `mail_received` to the characters of your account (one time per account), and `online` to your friends

x-al-failures.when: The payload is not an object, or `user`, `character` or `auth` is not a string.
A test server (`gameplay == "test"`) and `passphrase` is not `"potato salad"`.
This socket has a login in progress, or the character has a login in progress.
The character is in the disconnect queue (`dc_players`), or it is online on this server.
The server is not live, the socket is not an observer (no `loaded` yet), or the socket has a character already.
The server is full (`max_players`).

The database claim fails. `reason`: `no_character` (no such character, or not on your account), `password_issue` (wrong `auth` or no account), `mainframe_issue`, `ingame` (the character is online on a server), `cancelled` (the login was cancelled or passed 60 s), or `exception` (a database error).
A poker hand of the character still runs on another server.
The server cannot confirm your other characters (`encouragement_login`).
The server became full during the login.
The account is over its limits (`is_player_allowed`, node/server_functions.js:383): for example a second merchant of the account on this server.
After the claim: the socket disconnects, the observer goes away, the server stops being live, or the 60 s deadline passes (`check_character_login`). Or any other error in the login.

replies.note: a bare string, only if the socket is still connected

x-al-failures.when: The login takes more than 60 s (`character_login_timeout`) at any point. The server sends no message.

x-al-also.to: every character of your account online on this server, you included
x-al-also.when: Later, after `start`, one time per account: the server sends the Tracktrix mail (when the account has not got it yet).

confirm.note: `count` is undefined (no reply) when the mail was not sent

x-al-also.to: your friends: each online character, on any server, whose `friends` holds your account
x-al-also.when: Later, after `start`, when the account has friends and the character is not `private`.

send.bank.title: Send bank
send.bank.summary: Does all bank operations: deposit and withdraw gold, unlock bank packs, and move items in a pack or between a pack and your inventory. It works only on a bank map.

x-al-variants.intro: Each variant reads only its own fields; the server ignores the others. Every variant ends with `player` (`reopen: true`) and a `game_response` `data`.

list.name: withdraw
list.when: Takes gold from the bank.

list.name: deposit
list.when: Puts gold into the bank.

list.name: unlock
list.when: Buys a bank pack with gold (`gold: true`) or with shells (`shells: true`). The bank map does not matter.

list.name: move
list.when: Moves an item between two slots of one pack. Two stacks of the same item merge into slot `b`.

list.name: swap
list.when: Moves an item between your inventory and a pack: a swap of two slots, a store (no usable `str`) or a retrieve (no usable `inv`).

shared: `game_response` `data` (with the fields of the operation) to you
for `withdraw`, `deposit` and a gold `unlock`: a second `game_response` with the code

x-al-failures.when: No character.
You are not in the bank (`player.user` is not set), or the bank is mounting or unmounting.
`pack` is not a key of `bank_packs`.
You unlocked the pack already.
`gold` is set, and your gold is less than the gold price.
`shells` is set (and `gold` is not), and a shell unlock of the same pack runs already.

Later (a shell unlock): the account is not found (`nouser`), the transaction fails (`already_unlocked`, `not_enough`, or `exception` for any other error inside it), or an error outside the transaction occurs (`coms_failure`). The code also names `purchase_failed` (a failure without a reason) and the `tx` helper can return `retries`, but neither can happen: `tx` runs one try here and always gives a reason. Before each reason except `coms_failure` you also get `game_log` "Purchase failed". If you left the game, the server sends nothing.
You did not unlock `pack`, or the pack is on another bank map.
`a` equals `b` after the conversion.
Slot `a` or slot `b` holds a placeholder.
You did not unlock `pack`, or the pack is on another bank map.
Both `str` and `inv` mean "find a slot".
The inventory slot holds a placeholder.
The inventory item has `b` (it is on your merchant stand).
A store: the pack has no space for the item (`can_add_item`). When the pack has no empty slot, `str` becomes 0.
A retrieve: your inventory has no space for the item. When the inventory has no empty slot, `inv` becomes 0.

x-al-also.when: Every success, before the `game_response`.
x-al-also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. `gold`, `items` and `user` (the bank) show the change.

x-al-also.when: A shell unlock fails later for any reason except `coms_failure`, before `bank_new_pack_failed`.
A shell unlock is complete, before `bank_new_pack`.
x-al-also.name: later
x-al-also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. `cash` and `user` (the bank) show the new pack.

send.bet.title: Send bet
send.bet.summary: Places a wager in the tavern: dice, Fortune's Wheel (`"wheel"`), slots, or roulette (dev servers only).

x-al-variants.intro: An unknown `type` runs the shared checks, then ends with no reply.

list.name: dice
list.when: The dice table: bet that the roll (0 to 99.99) lands above or below `num`. The round rolls every 40 s or so.

list.name: wheel
list.when: Fortune's Wheel: an even-money bet on a side (`sun` or `moon`). The server decides the slice at once; the spin settles after 4 s.

list.name: slots
list.when: The slot machine: one pull costs `G.games.slots.gold` (1,000,000). The server draws the prize at once; the pull settles after 3.6 s. It ignores `gold`.

list.name: roulette
list.when: The old roulette (dev servers only). Its failures do not use `bet_failure`: they send nothing or a `game_log`, also with `request_id`. A roulette bet never settles (see the notes).

After 3.6 s: `game_response` `slots_success` or `slots_fail` to you (an object with `request_id`, else a bare string)

roulette: `tavern` with the bet object to you

x-al-failures.when: The server has no `tavern` instance.
No character, or you are in the bank (`player.user`), or you are not on the `tavern` map. Dev servers skip the map check.
You have the `xshotted` condition.
`tavern_closing()`: the tavern closed for a restart, or `server.shutdown` is set, or the server is not live yet.
The round rolls now (`tavern.dice.state` is `"roll"`).
The round does not take bets (the state is `"lock"` or `"suspense"`).
The stake (after the clamp) is more than your gold.
The possible net win (`win - edge - gold`) is more than 40% of `S.gold - house_debt()`.
You have an open bet already (`player.bets` is not empty).
`tavern_closing()` again: the same check as the shared row, so it does not fail here.
`side` is not `"sun"` or `"moon"`.
Your last spin did not settle yet (`player.q.wheel`).
The stake (after the clamp) is more than your gold.
The net win (`gold - ceil(gold * edge / 100)`) is more than 40% of `S.gold - house_debt()`.
`tavern_closing()` again: the same check as the shared row, so it does not fail here.
Your last pull did not settle yet (`player.q.slots`).
You have less than `G.games.slots.gold` (1,000,000).
The largest prize, minus the cost and the house cut, is more than `S.gold - house_debt()`.
Not a dev server.
`odds` is not a key of `tavern.roulette.odds`.
The table does not take bets now.
You have 5 or more open bets.
The stake is more than your gold.

x-al-also.when: A restart returns a wager (`tavern_close`): one per wager, after the `tavern_closing` reply (if any).

example.message: 100,000 gold returned: the restart interrupted your wager

x-al-also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance; for wheel and slots also you, when you are not in it
x-al-also.when: A restart returns a wager. wheel: `{event: "refund", type: "wheel", name, index, gold}`. slots: `{event: "refund", type: "slots", name, symbols, gold}`. dice: one event for all your bets, `{event: "refund", type: "dice", name, gold}` with the total, to the instance only.
x-al-also.summary: A refund notice.

x-al-also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance; on a hardcore server, everyone (`instance_emit` broadcasts every event but `tavern` and `dice` there)
x-al-also.when: A restart closes the tavern, after all refunds. Before it, each player that got gold back gets a `player` update (`resend "reopen+nc"`).

example.message: The Tavern closes its games for the restart. Unfinished wagers are returned

x-al-also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance, you included
x-al-also.when: The server took the bet.
The server took the bet (`resend "reopen+nc"`).
x-al-also.name: stake
x-al-also.summary: Your state with the stake taken from `gold`.

x-al-also.when: The dice round, for every bet: `{state: "roll"}` after 30 s of bets, `{state: "lock", num, text, key}` 10 s later, and `{state: "bets", hex, algorithm}` when the next round opens.
x-al-also.summary: See the receive entry.

x-al-also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance (not you when you left it)
x-al-also.when: 1.6 s after the `lock`, for each bet, after your `game_log`. `instance_emit` only.
The bet settles, last. `resend "reopen"` when the bet raised your XP to the next level (a merchant gets `edge * 7.2` XP for a win), else `"reopen+nc"`.
x-al-also.name: settle
x-al-also.summary: Your state with the payout in `gold` (the gold moved at the `lock`, 1.6 s earlier).

x-al-also.when: The server took the stake (`resend "u+cid+reopen+nc"`).
x-al-also.name: stake
x-al-also.summary: Your state with the stake taken from `gold`. `q.wheel` holds the decided result already (`won`, `result`, `slice`, `index`) and `request_id`. `q` also goes to other clients in `entities`.

x-al-also.when: The server took the stake. Every client whose view holds you.

x-al-also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance; also you, when you are not in it
x-al-also.when: The spin settles (`tavern_result`), after your `game_log`.
The spin settles, last (`resend "reopen+nc"`).
x-al-also.name: settle
x-al-also.summary: Your state with the payout in `gold`, and without `q.wheel` or `q.slots`.

send.skill.title: Send skill
send.skill.summary: Uses a class skill, an item skill or an emote. `attack` and `heal` are short forms of this event. The handler does a shared set of checks, then runs one branch for each skill.

x-al-variants.intro: The emote, `ids`, `targets`, target, `slot` and `consume` checks run in the shared checks, before the variant. They apply to the skills that `G.skills` marks (`emote`, `target`, `slot`, `consume`), so each variant lists only the request fields that its skills read.

list.name: Emote
list.when: An emote skill (`emote` in `G.skills`). Spends the MP of the emote. Clients nearby get `emote`. During the anniversary, `ikissyou` on the featured character can claim a reward. The checks of emotes (ownership, `no_self`, friend, `ikissyou` target) are in the shared checks.

list.name: Attack
list.when: `commence_attack`: a projectile to the target. `curse` adds party DPS credit on success. A `commence_attack` failure keeps the cooldown free.

list.name: selfheal
list.when: `commence_attack` with you as the target. It reads no `id`.

list.name: invis
list.when: Adds `invis` if you are not invisible now. If you are invisible now, no branch runs (the generic path, as for **Other**): you get the default success. The cooldown (`reuse_cooldown`) starts when you become visible again (node/server.js:13756-13767).

list.name: pickpocket
list.when: Starts the `pickpocket` channel (`duration_min` to `duration_max`). At the end, it takes one item with `v` from a random slot of the target, if the target is within 20 px.

list.name: Fishing or mining
list.when: Starts the channel if a zone of that type is next to you and you do not move. At the end, a 10% (`fishing`) or 20% (`mining`) roll gives a drop of the zone, and the tool can break (`breaks`).

list.name: light
list.when: Clients nearby get `light`. Rogues and invisible characters within 300 px lose `invis`.

list.name: Self buff
list.when: Adds a condition to you: `charge` adds `charging` for `duration`; `hardshell`, `power`, `xpower`, `shelter` add the condition of the skill; `mshield` and `aether_shield` turn their condition on or off (each one removes the other); `phaseout` adds `phasedout`; `pcoat` adds `poisonous`. The reply is the default success.

list.name: dash
list.when: Moves you at speed 500 to a safe spot near the point (within 50 px of you). Adds `dash` (1,000 ms).

list.name: cleansing_light
list.when: Removes each `cleansable` condition from the target.

list.name: guardians_oath
list.when: Adds `guardians_oath` to the target. Part of the damage to the target then goes to you.

list.name: beacon_of_resolve
list.when: Adds the condition to each living character within `range` that passes `is_same` level 3, you included.

list.name: paladin_aura
list.when: Selects the aura state.

list.name: Merchant buff
list.when: Adds the condition of the skill to you.

list.name: throw
list.when: Removes one unit of the item. `essenceoffire` adds `eburn`, `essenceoflife` adds `eheal`. Another item does `random * attack * 15` or `random * armor * 24` damage; the target keeps at least 1 HP.

list.name: Entangle
list.when: Adds `tangled` to the target and stops it.

list.name: 4fingers
list.when: Adds `fingered` and `stunned` (`duration` minus 2,000 ms) to the target.

list.name: revive
list.when: If the target is dead with full HP, it gets a `revival` channel of 8,000 ms. Then it is alive.

list.name: cburst
list.when: One projectile for each pair, with damage from its MP. It skips duplicates, MP of 0, invisible or invincible targets, you, and targets out of range.

list.name: partyheal
list.when: A heal to each party member (to you without a party). The server does not check their distance.

list.name: Area buff
list.when: Adds the condition to each character within `range`. On a PvP map, only to characters that pass `is_same` level 1.

list.name: Multi-shot
list.when: One projectile for each kept id. It skips duplicates, missing, dead, invisible or invincible targets, you, and targets out of range.

list.name: track
list.when: You get `track`.

list.name: agitate
list.when: Monsters within `range` that have no target, or that target a character that passes `is_same` level 1, start to attack you.

list.name: absorb
list.when: Monsters that attack the target attack you instead. On a target that fails `is_same` level 1, it needs level 75 and 6 times the MP, and works only 5% of the time.

list.name: stomp
list.when: Adds `stunned` to monsters within `range`, and in PvP to characters that fail `is_same` level 1.

list.name: scare
list.when: Monsters that attack you stop.

list.name: huntersmark
list.when: Adds `marked` to the target.

list.name: charm
list.when: Adds `charmed` to the monster with a chance of `player.a.charm.attr0` percent.

list.name: Cleave
list.when: One projectile for each monster within `range`, and in PvP each character that fails `is_same` level 1. With no hit, the reply is the default success.

list.name: magiport
list.when: Offer path (not PvP, `mode.pve_safe_magiports` on): the target gets `magiport` and accepts it with the `magiport` event. Other path: the server pulls the target to you.

list.name: blink
list.when: Teleports you to a safe spot near the point on your map, after 200 ms. A GM pays no MP.

list.name: warp
list.when: As `blink`, but to the instance `in`.

list.name: Target buff
list.when: Adds the condition of the skill to the target. `mluck`: not when the target has a `strong` `mluck` from another merchant; the buff is `strong` when the target is on your account.

list.name: energize
list.when: Moves MP from you to the target, and adds `energized`.

list.name: alchemy
list.when: Removes one unit of the first item without `l`, and gives you its value times the rate in gold.

list.name: temporalsurge

EntityId.title: EntityId
EntityId.description: A monster id or a character name. Monster ids are strings of digits (`++total_monsters + ""`, node/server.js:13417). A character's id is its name (node/server.js:11779). The server finds an entity by object key, so the number `48213` and the string `"48213"` find the same monster. `skill` (and so `attack` and `heal`) treats an id as a monster id when `"" + parseInt(id) === "" + id`, else as a character name (node/server.js:9903).

CharacterName.title: CharacterName
CharacterName.description: The name of a character. It is also the `id` of that character.

InventoryIndex.title: InventoryIndex
InventoryIndex.description: An index into `items` of the character: 0 to 41. The inventory has 42 slots (`isize`, node/server.js:1456). Each field that takes an index says how the handler reads it. Some handlers use the value as an array key with no conversion. Then the string `"3"` works the same as `3`.

x-al-confirm.liveNeeded: The set of names is G.items, game data that the code does not fix.
The set of names is G.skills, game data that the code does not fix.
The set of names is G.maps, game data that the code does not fix.

InstanceName.title: InstanceName
InstanceName.description: The instance that an entity is in. For a normal map it is the map name. A private instance has a random 24-character name.

Milliseconds.title: Milliseconds
Milliseconds.description: A duration in milliseconds. It can have a fraction.

x-al-confirm.note: Durations are computed (`expires - now`, timers), so they can have a fraction.

ItemInstance.title: ItemInstance
ItemInstance.description: One item as the server sends it: an inventory slot, an equipment slot, or an item in an event. The server builds it with `cache_item`. It removes `grace, giveaway, gf, price, want, b, rid, list, o, oo, src` (node/server_functions.js:4190-4202, 4234-4261). A merchant stand slot keeps more fields (`price`, `b`, `rid`, `giveaway`, `list`); see `trade_sell`.

name.description: The item. `"placeholder"` while an upgrade or a compound of this slot runs; see `PlaceholderItem`.

q.description: The quantity. Only for stackable items (`G.items[name].s`).

level.description: The upgrade or compound level. New items that can be upgraded or compounded get `0` (node/server.js:1986-1988).

p.description: A special property, for example `"shiny"`, `"lucky"`, `"glitched"`. A placeholder holds an object here. Can be `null`: a compound sets `item0.p = item0.p || item1.p || item2.p` even when no input had one (node/server.js:7073-7077), and the stored `undefined` comes back as `null`. Live captures show `p: null` on compounded rings, earrings, belts, amulets and orbs.

stat_type.description: The stat from a `pscroll`, for example `"str"`.

l.description: The lock state from `locksmith` (node/server.js:6820-6855). A locked item cannot be sent or upgraded with a `uscroll`.

ld.description: The end of the unseal wait: `JSON.stringify` of a `Date` 2 days in the future, so the string holds a quoted ISO 8601 date (for example `"\"2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z\""`). `locksmith` `unlock` sets it on a sealed item (`l: "s"` becomes `"u"`) and reads it with `JSON.parse` on the next `unlock` (node/server.js:6819-6823). The server does not delete it when the unseal completes.

m.description: The merchant whose luck made the item.

v.description: A date string. The item came from PvP.

acl.description: Account locked: only characters of the same owner can get the item. The server tests it as true or false; the value type is unclear from the source.

expires.description: An ISO 8601 date string (a `Date` from `future_s`). The item expires at this time. The `elixir` slot always has it (node/server.js:7797-7799).

gift.description: The item was a gift. The value type is unclear from the source.

charges.description: Charges of an item that skills use.

data.description: Free data of some items, for example a `cxjar`.

ach.description: The item achievement this item counts toward (a key of `G.achievements`); `item_achievement_increment` sets it and deletes it when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5846-5868).

acc.description: The progress count of that item achievement. Deleted when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5850-5865). Live captures show it without `ach` on some items.

ex.description: Only on the item in the `elixir` slot: `use` of an elixir sets `{name, expires, ex: true}` (node/server.js:7799). Renewing the same elixir keeps the object and only moves `expires` (node/server.js:7797).

ps.description: Every property the item has had, in order: `add_item_property` pushes the old `p` and the new one (node/server_functions.js:3220-3233). `cache_item` keeps it.

x-al-confirm.note: `cache_item` copies every stored key except the ignored ones, so rarer stored keys can appear; the fields listed are those the code writes.

PlaceholderItem.title: PlaceholderItem
PlaceholderItem.description: The item in an inventory slot while an `upgrade` or a `compound` of that slot runs. The server puts it in the slot of the item when the request succeeds. When the timer ends, the slot gets the result item. If the upgrade destroyed the item, the slot gets `null`.

name.description: Always `"placeholder"`.

PlaceholderState.title: PlaceholderState
PlaceholderState.description: The `p` object of a `PlaceholderItem`: the chance and the roll digits so far.

name.description: The item that is in the upgrade.

level.description: The level of the item before the action. A compound always has it (`item0.level || 0`, node/server.js:7057); an upgrade copies `item.level`.

scroll.description: The scroll. `null` for an offering without a scroll. Absent from JSON when the value is `undefined`.

offering.description: The offering, if any: `offering && offering.name` (node/server.js:7059, 7449, 7555). `null` when the request's `offering_num` points at an empty slot; absent without `offering_num`.

nums.description: The digits of the roll that the server showed so far, 0 to 4 of them.

success.description: Set near the end of the timer when the result is a success.

failure.description: Set near the end of the timer when the result is a failure.

QueueEntry.title: QueueEntry
QueueEntry.description: One timer in `q`, the queue of upgrade, compound and exchange actions of a character.

len.description: The full length of the timer.

num.description: The slot of the placeholder. It is the value from the request (`data.item_num` or `data.items[0]`) with no conversion, so a numeric string in the request stays a string here. `exchange` sets its own integer (node/server.js:6669).

silent.description: The server does not announce the result (a shiny attempt with an offering, node/server.js:7255).

stale.description: The character left the game while the timer ran (node/server_functions.js:4512).

nums.description: Only on a `compound` timer: always `[]` (node/server.js:7051). The server never fills it. The digits of the roll (0 to 9 each, up to 4) go in `p.nums` of the `PlaceholderItem` (node/server.js:14740-14798).

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description: One condition in `s` (a buff, a debuff or a state), keyed by its name. Almost every condition has `ms`, the time left. `encouragement_lonewolf` has none: it is `{gold_multiplier: 3, xp_multiplier: 3, luck_multiplier: 3}` with no `expires`, and only a condition with `expires` gets `ms` (node/logic/encouragement.js:270-277). Many conditions have more fields, for example `f` (the character that caused it). The fields of each condition are in `G.conditions` and in the `skill` entry.

x-al-confirm.note: Each condition's other keys come from where it is added (`add_condition`, skills, encouragement); the type is open.

LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText
LocalizedText.description: A text message in a form that the client can translate.

phrase.description: The key of the phrase in the language files.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

x-al-confirm.note: `message(id, parameters, fields)` returns `Object.assign({}, fields, {message, phrase, phrase_args: parameters || {}})`: the three keys always exist, and `fields` cannot override them.

Hitchhiker.title: Hitchhiker
Hitchhiker.description: An event that rides inside a `player` event: `[event name, payload]`. The server adds these pairs to `player.hitchhikers`. The next `player` event carries them as `hitchhikers` and clears the list (node/server.js:4579-4581). The official client replays each pair as a socket event. Treat each pair as if the server sent that event.

GameResponseFailure.title: GameResponseFailure
GameResponseFailure.description: The `game_response` object of `fail_response`: a request failed. `place` is the event name of the request, or the skill name for skills. The extra fields of each code are in the entry of the request that sends it.

response.description: The code. Each code has its own entry.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

GameResponseSuccess.title: GameResponseSuccess
GameResponseSuccess.description: The `game_response` object of `success_response`: a request succeeded. The extra fields of each code are in the entry of the request that sends it.

response.description: The code. `"data"` when the handler sends only data.

success.description: `true`, or `false` when the handler sets it (for example `in_progress` work).

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

Action.title: Action
Action.description: One attack, heal or skill projectile, as `commence_attack` builds it. The same object goes to clients nearby as `action`, and to the attacker as the `game_response` result (with `response` and `place` added).

x.description: The position of the target at the start.

y.description: The position of the target at the start.

eta.description: Milliseconds until the hit: `floor(1000 * distance / G.projectiles[projectile].speed)`. Always present: the object starts with `eta: 0` (node/server.js:3546-3556), and an instant projectile keeps `0` and gets `instant: true` (node/server.js:3582-3586).

m.description: The map-change counter of the target.

pid.description: The projectile id, 6 random characters. The later `hit` carries it.

projectile.description: A key of `G.projectiles`. Always present: `commence_attack` reads `G.projectiles[def.projectile].speed` (node/server.js:3582-3583), which throws when it is `null`, so every sent `action` has one (node/server.js:3564-3565).

instant.description: The projectile has no travel time.

damage.description: The damage before the defenses of the target. Absent for a heal and for 0 damage.

heal.description: The heal amount, for a heal.

positive.description: The action helps the target (a heal or a buff).

conditions.description: Conditions that the hit can apply, for example `"poisoned"`, `"frozen"`.

origin_offset.description: Cavalry volleys only: the side offset of this shot in px, `-16` or `16` (`npc.volley_offset`, node/logic/cavalry.js:484; `0` is not sent, node/server.js:3562).

response.description: `commence_attack` adds it after it sends `action` to clients nearby, for the `game_response` to the attacker (node/server.js:3609). The server keeps the same object, so a reflected `action` also has it.

place.description: The same as `type`. Added with `response` (node/server.js:3610); a reflected `action` also has it.

map.description: The map of the attacker when the projectile hits. The server sets it at the hit (node/server.js:3733), so only a reflected `action` has it.

in.description: The instance of the attacker when the projectile hits (node/server.js:3734). Only a reflected `action` has it.

reflect.description: Only on a reflected `action`: the damage of the reflection, `ceil(attack * (0.9 to 1.1))`. The target reflected a magical attack (`reflection`), so `attacker` and `target` change places, `pid` is new, `x`, `y` and `m` are of the old attacker. `eta` keeps the value of the first action: the server does not change it (node/server.js:3775-3809).

Character.title: Character
Character.description: The full state of your character, as `player_to_client` builds it. `player` sends it to its owner. With `stranger` set, the server leaves out the second group of fields (stats, inventory, gold) and uses it for other characters in `entities`. A field with the value `undefined` is absent from the JSON.

xp.description: Experience in this level. Can be fractional: XP gains are not rounded, for example a merchant gets `tax * 3.2` per sale (node/server_functions.js:750); seen live as `106466429.2`.

level.description: The level.

m.description: The map-change counter. `move` must send this value.

abs.description: The position is absolute (after a teleport).

angle.description: Set by cave logic on actors. Not set for a normal character.

position_id.description: Set for NPC characters. Not set for a normal character.

motion.description: Set for NPC characters with a scripted motion; `age` is its age in ms (node/server.js:857-858).

c.description: Channeled actions (for example `town`, `fishing`), keyed by name. Each has `ms`, the time left.

q.description: `player.q`: the timers of `upgrade`, `compound` and `exchange`, and the spins of the tavern `wheel` and `slots`, keyed by that name (node/server.js:6669, 7051, 7438; node/logic/tavern_wheel.js:27, node/logic/tavern_slots.js:54).

b.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

rip.description: The character is dead. A gravestone cosmetic replaces `true` with its name (node/server.js:915-917). `false` after a revive or a state restore (node/server.js:1122, 6292, 15108); `null` is seen live on characters whose stored record holds it.

afk.description: `"code"` when the character logged in with `no_html` (a code client).

controller.description: Only when `afk` is `"code"`: the character whose code controls this one, or `""`.

code.description: The last `code` event said that code runs.

party.description: The leader of the party. `null` after leaving a party (node/server_functions.js:3608, 3618, 3633): `player_to_client` copies any value that is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905).

team.description: The team in a team event.

guild.description: The guild: the guild's short name when the account is in one (node/server.js:11732, 11820-11823), else the character record's value, which is `""` or `null`. `player_to_client` copies it whenever it is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905), so `null` arrives (seen live).

allow.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

age.description: The age of the character in days (node/server.js:11808).

cid.description: The change id. It goes up when the character changes.

stand.description: From `p.stand`: the merchant stand is open (the stand item name), or `false`.

tp.description: The character just appeared after a teleport.

slots.description: Equipped items, keyed by slot name (see Units and conventions). A trade slot (`trade1`, `trade2`, ...) of a merchant stand holds a `TradeSlotItem`: `reslot_player` builds it with `cache_item(item, 1)`, which keeps `price`, `rid` and the other trade fields.

owner.description: The user id of the owner, or `""` for a private character.

mp_reduction.description: Percent reduction of skill MP costs.

items.description: The inventory. `null` is an empty slot. A slot in an upgrade holds a `PlaceholderItem`.

gold.description: Gold.

targets.description: How many monsters target the character.

xrange.description: Range leeway in px, up to 25. Each use of it goes down; it comes back at 5 px per second (node/server.js:16240).

tax.description: The tax rate of the merchant stand, 0.01 to 0.05 by level (node/server.js:1718).

user.description: Only in the bank: the bank packs `items0` to `items47` and `gold`.

cc.description: The call cost of the socket now. The server disconnects above 200 in 4 s.

TradeSlotName.title: TradeSlotName
TradeSlotName.description: A trade slot of a merchant stand: `"trade1"` to `"trade48"`. The list is `trade_slots` (js/old_common_functions.js:52-53). How many of them are open depends on the stand and the class: see `get_trade_slots` (node/server_functions.js:4282-4299).

x-al-confirm.note: Every handler that reads a slot checks it with `in_arr(data.slot, trade_slots)`.

TradeSlotItem.title: TradeSlotItem
TradeSlotItem.description: An item in a trade slot of a merchant stand, or an item in a trade `ui` event. It keeps the trade fields that `ItemInstance` removes. The server builds it with `cache_item(item, true)`, which removes only `grace`, `o`, `oo` and `src` (node/server_functions.js:4203, 4234-4261). A listing has `price` (a sale or a buy order) or `want` (a trade offer).

name.description: The item. `"placeholder"` while an upgrade or a compound of this slot runs; see `PlaceholderItem`.

q.description: The quantity. Only for stackable items (`G.items[name].s`).

level.description: The upgrade or compound level. New items that can be upgraded or compounded get `0` (node/server.js:1986-1988).

p.description: A special property, for example `"shiny"`, `"lucky"`, `"glitched"`. A placeholder holds an object here. Can be `null`: a compound sets `item0.p = item0.p || item1.p || item2.p` even when no input had one (node/server.js:7073-7077), and the stored `undefined` comes back as `null`. Live captures show `p: null` on compounded rings, earrings, belts, amulets and orbs.

stat_type.description: The stat from a `pscroll`, for example `"str"`.

l.description: The lock state from `locksmith` (node/server.js:6820-6855). A locked item cannot be sent or upgraded with a `uscroll`.

ld.description: The end of the unseal wait: `JSON.stringify` of a `Date` 2 days in the future, so the string holds a quoted ISO 8601 date (for example `"\"2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z\""`). `locksmith` `unlock` sets it on a sealed item (`l: "s"` becomes `"u"`) and reads it with `JSON.parse` on the next `unlock` (node/server.js:6819-6823). The server does not delete it when the unseal completes.

m.description: The merchant whose luck made the item.

v.description: A date string. The item came from PvP.

acl.description: Account locked: only characters of the same owner can get the item. The server tests it as true or false; the value type is unclear from the source.

expires.description: An ISO 8601 date string (a `Date` from `future_s`). The item expires at this time. The `elixir` slot always has it (node/server.js:7797-7799).

gift.description: The item was a gift. The value type is unclear from the source.

charges.description: Charges of an item that skills use.

data.description: Free data of some items, for example a `cxjar`.

ach.description: The item achievement this item counts toward (a key of `G.achievements`); `item_achievement_increment` sets it and deletes it when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5846-5868).

acc.description: The progress count of that item achievement. Deleted when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5850-5865). Live captures show it without `ach` on some items.

ex.description: Only on the item in the `elixir` slot: `use` of an elixir sets `{name, expires, ex: true}` (node/server.js:7799). Renewing the same elixir keeps the object and only moves `expires` (node/server.js:7797).

ps.description: Every property the item has had, in order: `add_item_property` pushes the old `p` and the new one (node/server_functions.js:3220-3233). `cache_item` keeps it.

price.description: The gold for one unit. On a sale or a buy order. A giveaway has `price: 1` (node/server.js:7697-7699).

b.description: The listing is a buy order (`trade_wishlist`, node/server.js:8804-8809): the owner buys this item. A buy order always has `q`, also for an item that does not stack: `min(99, q)` for an upgrade or compound item, else `q` up to 9999 (node/server.js:8795, 8811-8816).

want.description: The listing is a trade offer: the owner gives the item for the item in `want`.

rid.description: A random id: 4 characters on a listing or a buy order (node/server.js:7710, 7753, 8807). An item bought from `secondhands` or `lostandfound` keeps its 5-character `rid` (node/server_functions.js:614, 645) until it is listed again. A new listing gets a new `rid`.

giveaway.description: The listing is a giveaway that lasts this many minutes.

list.description: The names that joined the giveaway. Only on a giveaway.

registry.description: Only on a giveaway that someone joined: the `auth_id` of each account that joined, mapped to the name of its character (node/server.js:8774-8776). `cache_item(item, true)` does not remove it, so the minute timer (node/server.js:16215) and `reslot_player` (node/server_functions.js:4308) send it to every client that sees the stand. A server bug: it leaks the `auth_id` of each participant.

gf.description: The item was won in a giveaway from this character (node/server.js:16121). `ItemInstance` removes it; the trade cache keeps it when the item is listed again.

TradeWant.title: TradeWant
TradeWant.description: What a swap listing asks for in return: an item, the lowest level, a title and a quantity. The server normalizes it with `trade_want_normalize`. `name` must be a key of `G.items` and not `placeholder`, else the listing fails with `trade_offer_invalid`. `level` stays only for an upgrade or compound item when `parseInt(level) > 0`, at most 12. `p` must be a key of `G.titles`; `null` or `""` means any title. `q` stays only for a stackable item: `min(G.items[name].s === true ? 9999 : G.items[name].s, max(1, parseInt(q) || 1))` (js/old_common_functions.js:479). An absent `level` or `p` accepts any. A `want` sent as a plain string is read as `{name: want}` (js/old_common_functions.js:471).

name.description: The item that the buyer must give.

level.description: The lowest level that the buyer can give, 1 to 12.

p.description: The title that the item must have, a key of `G.titles`.

q.description: The quantity of a stackable item.

BankPackName.title: BankPackName
BankPackName.description: A bank pack: a key of `bank_packs`, `"items0"` to `"items47"`. `bank_packs` (js/old_common_functions.js:54-102) maps each pack to `[bank map, gold price, shell price]`. `items0`-`items7` are on `bank`, `items8`-`items23` on `bank_b`, `items24`-`items47` on `bank_u`. A pack that you unlocked is an array of up to 42 items in `player.user`.

CaveVisitInfo.title: CaveVisitInfo
CaveVisitInfo.description: The daily visit state of the Cave of Many Dreams for your account.

available.description: `true` when the account has not used its daily opening.

resets.description: When the daily opening resets: a time in ms since 1970.

home.description: The home server of the account (`p.home`, or this server), for example `"EUI"`. The daily window follows its region.

server_time.description: The time on the server in ms since 1970.

unlimited.description: A dev server: visits are not counted.

resume.description: A run that you can join again: `{run, server, remaining_ms}`. `server` is the server id without its `SR_` prefix (`server_id.slice(3)`, node/logic/generated_maps.js:648, 654). `remaining_ms` is there only when the run is on this server.

x-al-confirm.note: `home` is `player.p.home || region + server_name` (e.g. `"EUI"`); `resume.server` is `server_id.slice(3)`

CaveState.title: CaveState
CaveState.description: The snapshot of a Cave of Many Dreams run for one character (`cave_snapshot`). The server also keeps it in `player.cave`.

run.description: The run key: 24 hex characters. The name of each floor map is `zone_<run>_<floor>`.

expires.description: The end of the run, in ms since 1970. A pause moves it later.

server_time.description: `Date.now()` on the server when it built the snapshot, in ms since 1970.

remaining_ms.description: The time left in the run. It does not go down during a pause.

paused.description: `true` while a vote pauses the run.

paused_at.description: The start of the pause, in ms since 1970.

rewards.description: The last 12 rewards of the run, oldest first.

level.description: The level of the run: the highest level of the party at the start. Monsters scale with it.

floor.description: Your floor: 0, 1 or 2. Absent when you are not on a floor of the run (`generated_entry(player)` finds none, node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:1720).

gold.description: The shared cave gold of the party. It stays in the run.

amber.description: The shared Amber of the party. Unspent Amber leaves the cave as `cave_amber` items.

limits.description: The caps on cave gold and Amber, and what the run gave so far.

supplies.description: The supply flags that the party has now.

roster.description: Each member who entered the run.

objectives.description: The rooms that the map shows: required rooms, farms and shops of your floor, and rooms that an encounter revealed (on any floor).

choice.description: The current vote. After it ends, the vote of the room that you talked to, if any. `null` when there was no vote.

CaveLimits.title: CaveLimits
CaveLimits.description: The caps on the shared currency of a cave run.

gold.description: The most cave gold that a run can give: `G.events.dreams.gold_limit` (60,000).

amber.description: The most Amber that a run can give: `G.events.dreams.amber_limit` (36).

gold_spawned.description: The cave gold that the run put in chests so far.

amber_spawned.description: The Amber that the run put in chests so far.

x-al-confirm.liveNeeded: The caps come from G (`events.dreams.gold_limit` 60000, `amber_limit` 36 in G_17478).

CaveReceipt.title: CaveReceipt
CaveReceipt.description: One reward of a cave run: a chest of shared currency, or an item for one member.

id.description: A serial number in the run.

where.description: `"purse"`: a chest of cave gold and Amber went to the shared purse. For an item: `"inventory"`, `"mail_pending"` (the mail is not sent yet) or `"mail"`.

gold.description: Purse only: the cave gold.

map.description: Purse only: the map of the chest.

x.description: Purse only: the position of the chest.

y.description: Purse only: the position of the chest.

item.description: Item only: a copy of the item, with `p: "cavefound"`.

recipient.description: Item only: the member who gets it. The server picks one member of the roster at random.

slot.description: Item only, when `where` is `"inventory"`: the inventory slot.

x-al-confirm.note: `slot` is the return of `add_item` (the slot index); `where` moves from `mail_pending` to `mail` when the mail is sent

CaveRosterEntry.title: CaveRosterEntry
CaveRosterEntry.description: One member of a cave run.

name.description: The character.

left.description: `true` after the member left the run. A member who left cannot come back.

disconnected.description: `true` while the member is offline and can still come back.

CaveDoor.title: CaveDoor
CaveDoor.description: One door on your floor of a cave run.

id.description: The index of the door in the floor map.

x.description: The landing point of the door.

y.description: The landing point of the door.

to.description: The map behind the door: another floor (`zone_<run>_<floor>`) or the exit map.

down.description: `true` when the door goes to a deeper floor.

locked.description: `true` when the door goes down and the required rooms of this floor are not all done.

CaveObjective.title: CaveObjective
CaveObjective.description: One room that the map of a cave run shows.

id.description: The room id, for example `"0:2"`, `"0:shop"`, `"0:farm:14"` or `"0:farm:14:traveler"` (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:206). The interactions `talk` and `buy` take it as `room`.

x.description: The position of the room. For a traveler (`citizen`), the position of the traveler.

done.description: The room is complete. For a shop: the party bought its item.

floor.description: The floor of the room: 0, 1 or 2.

kind.description: The kind of room: `"fight"`, `"encounter"` (shops too), `"boss"`, `"farm"` or `"citizen"` (a traveler that an encounter revealed). Other room kinds never pass the filter (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:1752-1755).

required.description: The way down opens when the party completes every required room of the floor.

waves.description: Farms only: the waves cleared so far.

name.description: The name of the encounter, traveler or camp. A fight room without a name is `"Guard camp"`.

name_message.description: `name` as a phrase. A fight room has `{phrase: "server.cave.guard_camp"}`; a farm has its camp phrase. Absent for boss and traveler rooms, and for an encounter without a phrase in the language file (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:1772-1776).

CaveChoice.title: CaveChoice
CaveChoice.description: The vote of the party on an encounter, with the scene and the replies.

id.description: The vote id: `<run>:<serial>`. The `vote` interaction sends it as `choice`.

title_message.description: `title` as a phrase. Absent when the language file has no phrase for it.

kind.description: The kind of encounter (`G.events.dreams.encounters[].kind`), for example `"dice"` or `"merchant"`. Absent for the revival vote.

danger.description: `true` for an encounter of the group `"bad"`.

scene.description: Up to 10 living actors of the room.

text.description: What the actor says, with the names filled in.

deadline.description: The end of the vote, in ms since 1970. A vote lasts `G.events.dreams.vote_ms` (60,000 ms).

result.description: After the vote: the id of the reply that won, or `"fallback"`.

result_label.description: After the vote: the label of the reply that won, or `"No reply was chosen."` (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:832).

result_message.description: After the vote: `result_label` as a phrase.

summary.description: After the vote: the log lines of the result. Empty before.

summary_messages.description: The lines of `summary` as phrases, or `null` for a line without a phrase.

votes.description: Character name to the id of the reply that the character chose.

fallback.description: What happens when no reply wins, for example `"Walk away"` or `"Wait and lose 45 seconds"`.

skin.description: The skin of the main actor, when the room has one.

cx.description: The cosmetics of the main actor.

people.description: The main actor and the rival of the room, when they exist.

shop.description: The item for sale, for a shop room.

examples.title: Dice in a Tin Cup
examples.text: Pick your bet, then roll once for the whole party.

options.label: Bet 2,000 shared gold; roll 4–6 to get 4,000
Roll 4–6 for a helper; 1–3 brings two guards

x-al-confirm.note: `kind` is absent for the revival vote, whose encounter has no `kind`; `result` is the option id or `"fallback"`

CaveSceneActor.title: CaveSceneActor
CaveSceneActor.description: One actor in the scene of a cave vote.

id.description: The monster id of the actor.

name.description: The name of the actor.

skin.description: The skin: the actor skin, else the monster skin, else the monster type.

side.description: The side of the actor now.

slots.description: The equipment that the client draws, for example `{mainhand: {name: "blade", level: 0}}`.

CaveOption.title: CaveOption
CaveOption.description: One reply in a cave vote.

id.description: The reply id. The `vote` interaction sends it as `option`.

label.description: The text of the reply, with the names filled in.

cost.description: The cave gold that the reply costs, or 0.

amber.description: The Amber that the reply costs, or 0.

unavailable.description: Why the party cannot choose it now (no tool, not enough in the purse, too many helpers), as text. `null` when it is available.

unavailable_message.description: `unavailable` as a phrase. Absent when the reply is available.

examples.label: Bet 5,000 shared gold; roll 4–6 to get 10,000
examples.unavailable: Not enough in the shared purse.

x-al-confirm.note: `unavailable` is `localization.phrase` of `server.cave.need_tool`, `server.cave.purse_short` or `server.cave.helpers_limit`

CavePerson.title: CavePerson
CavePerson.description: The main actor or the rival of a cave encounter, as the vote panel shows it.

name.description: The name.

cargo.description: Main actor of a rescue only: the items that the actor carries.

CaveShop.title: CaveShop
CaveShop.description: The one item for sale in a cave shop room.

room.description: The room id. The `buy` interaction takes it as `room`.

nearby.description: `true` when you are on the map of the shop and within 160 px of the seller.

name.description: The item, from `G.events.dreams.merchant_stock`.

x-al-confirm.liveNeeded: `name` and `price` come from G `events.dreams.merchant_stock`.

CaveHunt.title: CaveHunt
CaveHunt.description: One open hunt in a cave run.

deadline.description: The end of the hunt, in ms since 1970.

CavePractice.title: CavePractice
CavePractice.description: One open practice fight in a cave run.

name.description: The name of the opponent.

hp.description: The HP of the opponent now.

deadline.description: The end of the practice, in ms since 1970.

CaveChat.title: CaveChat
CaveChat.description: What a traveler of the Cave of Many Dreams says in a cave run.

name.description: The name of the traveler (`G.events.dreams.travelers`).

CavePhrase.title: CavePhrase
CavePhrase.description: A text of the cave as a phrase key, without the English text: `{phrase, phrase_args?}`.

phrase.description: The key of the phrase in the language files.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase. A value is a string, a number (for example `amber` of `server.cave.revive_here`, node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:854) or another `{phrase}` object.

ChestOpenedResult.title: ChestOpenedResult
ChestOpenedResult.description: The loot of an opened chest, as one receiver sees it.

id.description: The chest id, as the `open_chest` request gave it.

opener.description: The character that opened the chest.

goldm.description: The gold multiplier: `goldm` of the opener, or `1` for an encouragement chest, a `dry` or `stale` open, and a cave chest.

gold.description: The gold that this receiver got, after the server tax, plus its encouragement gold. `0` for a cave chest.

items.description: Each item from the chest and who got it. Absent when empty, except on the party and cave forms.

dry.description: The opener was more than 400 from the chest, so `goldm` is `1`.

stale.description: The chest was older than 8 minutes (`msince(chest.date) > 8`), so `goldm` is `1`.

cave.description: Only for a cave chest: what went to the purse of the run.

ChestOpenedItem.title: ChestOpenedItem
ChestOpenedItem.description: One item from an opened chest: the cached item plus who got it.

name.description: The item. `"placeholder"` while an upgrade or a compound of this slot runs; see `PlaceholderItem`.

q.description: The quantity. Only for stackable items (`G.items[name].s`).

level.description: The upgrade or compound level. New items that can be upgraded or compounded get `0` (node/server.js:1986-1988).

p.description: A special property, for example `"shiny"`, `"lucky"`, `"glitched"`. A placeholder holds an object here. Can be `null`: a compound sets `item0.p = item0.p || item1.p || item2.p` even when no input had one (node/server.js:7073-7077), and the stored `undefined` comes back as `null`. Live captures show `p: null` on compounded rings, earrings, belts, amulets and orbs.

stat_type.description: The stat from a `pscroll`, for example `"str"`.

l.description: The lock state from `locksmith` (node/server.js:6820-6855). A locked item cannot be sent or upgraded with a `uscroll`.

ld.description: The end of the unseal wait: `JSON.stringify` of a `Date` 2 days in the future, so the string holds a quoted ISO 8601 date (for example `"\"2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z\""`). `locksmith` `unlock` sets it on a sealed item (`l: "s"` becomes `"u"`) and reads it with `JSON.parse` on the next `unlock` (node/server.js:6819-6823). The server does not delete it when the unseal completes.

m.description: The merchant whose luck made the item.

v.description: A date string. The item came from PvP.

acl.description: Account locked: only characters of the same owner can get the item. The server tests it as true or false; the value type is unclear from the source.

expires.description: An ISO 8601 date string (a `Date` from `future_s`). The item expires at this time. The `elixir` slot always has it (node/server.js:7797-7799).

gift.description: The item was a gift. The value type is unclear from the source.

charges.description: Charges of an item that skills use.

data.description: Free data of some items, for example a `cxjar`.

ach.description: The item achievement this item counts toward (a key of `G.achievements`); `item_achievement_increment` sets it and deletes it when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5846-5868).

acc.description: The progress count of that item achievement. Deleted when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5850-5865). Live captures show it without `ach` on some items.

ex.description: Only on the item in the `elixir` slot: `use` of an elixir sets `{name, expires, ex: true}` (node/server.js:7799). Renewing the same elixir keeps the object and only moves `expires` (node/server.js:7797).

ps.description: Every property the item has had, in order: `add_item_property` pushes the old `p` and the new one (node/server_functions.js:3220-3233). `cache_item` keeps it.

looter.description: The character that got the item. `null` when nobody had space and the item went to the lost and found.

pvp_loot.description: The item came from a character killed in PvP.

lostandfound.description: Nobody had space. The item went to the lost and found (`lostandfound_logic`).

x-al-confirm.note: `cache_item(item)` of the item after `add_item`, plus `looter` and the flags; `item_p_ignore` strips `src`, `o`, `oo`, `b`, `rid`, `price` and the rest

ChestOpenedGone.title: ChestOpenedGone
ChestOpenedGone.description: The reply to `open_chest` when no chest has that id.

id.description: The chest id, as the request gave it.

ChestOpenedCave.title: ChestOpenedCave
ChestOpenedCave.description: What a cave chest put into the purse of the run.

gold.description: The gold that went to the purse.

amber.description: The amber that went to the purse.

shared.description: Always `true`: all members of the run share the purse.

ItemAnnouncement.title: ItemAnnouncement
ItemAnnouncement.description: The `server_message` that tells every player on the server that a character got or lost an item. `add_item` sends it for a rare item: the count of announcements of this item on the server (`a_score`, +1.05 each) is below `G.items[name].a`, or the item got `p: "shiny"`. An `add_item` call with `announce: false` sends none. The timer results of `upgrade` and `compound`, and the level-13 roll of `destroy`, send the same shape with their own `type`. The server sends none for a `stealth` character.

phrase.description: The key of the phrase in the language files.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

type.description: `"server_found"` or `"server_received"` from `add_item`; `"server_usuccess"`, `"server_ufail"`, `"server_csuccess"` or `"server_cfail"` from the upgrade and compound timers (and `"server_usuccess"` from `destroy`, node/server.js:8727).

item.description: The item.

name.description: The character.

event.description: `G.items[name].event`, when the item has one (only `add_item` sends it). Every item in G 17478 that has it has `true`; the server copies the G value.

x-al-confirm.note: `args.phrase` is only `Fished`, `Mined` or `Glitched` (node/server.js:15036, 15073; node/server_functions.js:4121), so `item_action` is always set and every announcement is a `LocalizedText`.

EquipBatchEntry.title: EquipBatchEntry
EquipBatchEntry.description: One entry of the `equip_batch` payload: an item to equip.

num.description: The slot of the item.
num.x-al-coerce: `to_number`: `round(parseInt(num))`. A negative value, a missing value or `NaN` becomes 0, so the server uses slot 0

slot.description: The equipment slot, for example `"mainhand"` or `"ring1"`. When absent or falsy, the server uses the type of the item. `can_equip_item` can change it, for example `weapon` to `offhand`.

x-al-confirm.note: An entry that is `null` or not an object makes `equip_def.num = ...` throw (node/server.js:7580-7581); the handler then sends nothing.

EquipBatchResult.title: EquipBatchResult
EquipBatchResult.description: One element of `slots` in the `equip_batch` reply: an item that the server equipped.

num.description: The inventory slot, after `to_number`. It now holds the item that was in the equipment slot, or `null`.

slot.description: The equipment slot that got the item.

ServerInfoState.title: ServerInfoState
ServerInfoState.description: S, the event state of the game server (`E` on the server). Every key is optional and depends on the events that run now. Each message carries the whole object, never a diff. When a key is not in the new object, the server removed it. The full reference, with every key and when it appears, is [S](#s-what-s-is) and [Every key](#s-every-key).

schedule.description: Every server except HARDCORE: there `init_server` replaces E with `{rewards, minutes}` (node/server_functions.js:3105-3136), so `schedule` is absent. See [schedule](#s-key-schedule). A server bug: on HARDCORE `event_loop` reads `E.schedule.time_offset` (node/server_functions.js:2378), throws every second and is caught (node/server_functions.js:3023-3025), so nothing after `anniversary_tick` runs there.

crabxx.description: The daily boss, only while it lives. See [crabxx](#s-key-crabxx).

franky.description: The nightly boss, only while it lives. See [franky](#s-key-franky).

icegolem.description: The nightly boss, only while it lives. See [icegolem](#s-key-icegolem).

slenderman.description: Seasonal boss (`halloween`). The live form has no `x`/`y`. See [slenderman](#s-key-slenderman).

snowman.description: Seasonal boss (`holidayseason`), and off season while one lives. See [snowman](#s-key-snowman).

tiger.description: Only while a tiger lives. No live code spawns one. See [tiger](#s-key-tiger).

duels.description: Instance name to duel. Created on the first duel and never deleted, so it can be `{}`. See [duels](#s-key-duels).

blessed_minutes.description: The minutes left in the server blessing. See [blessed_minutes](#s-key-blessed_minutes).

blessed_by.description: The character who blessed the server. See [blessed_by](#s-key-blessed_by).

rewards.description: HARDCORE only: reward slot to the character that won it, or `null`. The key `"!participation"` holds a text. See [rewards](#s-key-rewards).

minutes.description: HARDCORE only: minutes left in the round. See [minutes](#s-key-minutes).

x-al-confirm.note: Every key that the code writes into E is a field here; no other key is set.

ServerInfoSchedule.title: ServerInfoSchedule
ServerInfoSchedule.description: The `schedule` entry of S: the server clock and the hours of daily and nightly events.

time_offset.description: Hours from UTC for the region: EU 1, US -5, ASIA 7 (node/server.js:339-343).

dailies.description: Local hours at which a daily event starts.

nightlies.description: Local hours at which a nightly event starts.

ServerInfoBoss.title: ServerInfoBoss
ServerInfoBoss.description: A boss entry of S: the live form (`live: true`) or the waiting form of a seasonal boss (`live: false`, `spawn`).

spawn.description: Waiting form only: the next spawn time, as an ISO-8601 date string.

map.description: Live form only: the map of the boss.

hp.description: Live form only: the HP now.

max_hp.description: Live form only: the maximum HP.

target.description: Live form only: the target of the boss. A truthy `target` makes the server send S every second. Absent when the monster has no target (`monster.target` is then `undefined`; seen live for `mrpumpkin` and `slenderman`).

x.description: Live form only: the position. Absent for `slenderman` and `tiger`.

end.description: `crabxx`, `franky`, `icegolem` only: the event timeout, as an ISO-8601 date string.

x-al-confirm.note: Live captures have a live `mrpumpkin` and `slenderman` without `target` (`monster.target` undefined).

challenger.description: The character who sent the challenge.

a.description: Team A: the party of the challenger. When the countdown ends, the event loop replaces it with the members of team A still in the duel (node/server_functions.js:2933-2942).

b.description: Team B: the party of the opponent. When the countdown ends, the event loop replaces it with the members of team B still in the duel (node/server_functions.js:2943-2949).

seconds.description: 60 (20 on a Dev server). The next pass of the duel loop removes it. The loop copies `instance.seconds`, which does not exist (node/server_functions.js:3010).

active.description: `false` at the start. The duel loop copies `instance.active`, which does not exist, so the key goes away (node/server_functions.js:3009). It is never `true`.

end.description: The end of the event, as an ISO-8601 date string.

ServerInfoAbtesting.title: ServerInfoAbtesting
ServerInfoAbtesting.description: The `abtesting` entry of S: the daily team battle.

end.description: The end of the event, as an ISO-8601 date string.

signup_end.description: The start plus 60 s, as an ISO-8601 date string.

A.description: The score of team A: 1 for each PvP kill.

ServerInfoAnniversary.title: ServerInfoAnniversary
ServerInfoAnniversary.description: The `anniversary` entry of S. The round fields are present only while a round has a target.

live.description: `true` while a round has a target.

next.description: The start of the next 30-minute slot, in ms since 1970.

expires.description: The end of the round window, in ms since 1970.

available.description: `true` while visitors can still claim a reward from the target.

x.description: The position of the target, rounded.

y.description: The position of the target, rounded.

QDataQueue.title: QDataQueue
QDataQueue.description: The timers of a character (`player.q`), keyed by the action. Each key is absent when that action does not run.

upgrade.description: An `upgrade` timer: `{ms, len, num}`, plus `silent: true` for a shiny attempt (node/server.js:7255, 7302, 7438, 7547).

wheel.description: A spin of the tavern wheel (node/logic/tavern_wheel.js:27-39).

slots.description: A spin of the tavern slots (node/logic/tavern_slots.js:54-65).
