x-al-confirm.note: These are the only places that create a `q` entry.

len.description: The full length of the timer.

num.description: The slot of the placeholder. It is the value from the request (`data.item_num` or `data.items[0]`) with no conversion, so a numeric string in the request stays a string here. `exchange` sets its own integer (node/server.js:6669).

silent.description: The server does not announce the result (a shiny attempt with an offering, node/server.js:7255).

stale.description: The character left the game while the timer ran (node/server_functions.js:4512).

nums.description: Always `[]`. The digits of the roll are in `p.nums` of the placeholder, not here.

len.description: The full length of the timer.

num.description: The slot of the placeholder. It is the value from the request (`data.item_num` or `data.items[0]`) with no conversion, so a numeric string in the request stays a string here. `exchange` sets its own integer (node/server.js:6669).

silent.description: The server does not announce the result (a shiny attempt with an offering, node/server.js:7255).

stale.description: The character left the game while the timer ran (node/server_functions.js:4512).

nums.description: Only on a `compound` timer: always `[]` (node/server.js:7051). The server never fills it. The digits of the roll (0 to 9 each, up to 4) go in `p.nums` of the `PlaceholderItem` (node/server.js:14740-14798).

name.description: The item that the character exchanges.

id.description: The drop table of the exchange: the item name, plus the level for an item with `upgrade` or `compound` in G (node/server.js:6641-6642).

q.description: The quantity that the exchange used (`G.items[name].e`).

s.description: The level suffix of `id`. Only for an item with `upgrade` or `compound` in G, and only when the level is not 0 (level 1 or more).

v.description: The `v` (PvP date) of the item, when it had one. The result items get it.

qs.description: The quest of the item (`G.items[name].quest`). At the end, the server sends `game_response` `<qs>_success` instead of the `upgrade` animation.

QDataWheel.title: QDataWheel
QDataWheel.description: A spin of the tavern wheel in `q`. It holds the result before the spin ends.

ms.description: The time left (`G.games.wheel.spin` at the start). There is no `len`.

gold.description: The stake.

cut.description: The cut of the house on a win: `ceil(gold * edge / 100)`.

net.description: The profit on a win: `gold - cut`.

index.description: The slice that the spin drew, an index into `G.games.wheel.slices`.

request_id.description: The `request_id` of the `bet` request, when it had one.

stale.description: Set by `init_player_exit` on every timer when the character leaves the game (node/server_functions.js:4509-4513), as on `QueueEntry`. The disconnect path normally deletes these entries first.

QDataSlots.title: QDataSlots
QDataSlots.description: A spin of the tavern slots in `q`. It holds the result before the spin ends.

ms.description: The time left (`G.games.slots.spin` at the start). There is no `len`.

prize.description: The gross prize. `0` when the spin drew no prize.

won.description: `true` when the spin drew a prize.

request_id.description: The `request_id` of the `bet` request, when it had one.

stale.description: Set by `init_player_exit` on every timer when the character leaves the game (node/server_functions.js:4509-4513), as on `QueueEntry`. The disconnect path normally deletes these entries first.

MerritStatusReceipt.title: MerritStatusReceipt
MerritStatusReceipt.description: The receipt of one gift from Merrit: a `marketparcel`, and sometimes 1 shell.

at.description: The time of the gift, in ms since the Unix epoch.

character.description: The database id of the character (`get_id(player)`, its `_id`: `"CH_"` and digits; common:mongodb_functions.js:29-31).

name.description: The character that got the gift.

item.description: Always `"marketparcel"`.

shells.description: `1` when the gift included a shell. The chance falls as the shell balance of the account goes up to 10 (`shellChance`, node/logic/market_patron.js:48-51).

examples.name: Merchant
examples.reason: Your shop stayed stocked for two minutes and left the neighbors room.

PartyUpdateMember.title: PartyUpdateMember
PartyUpdateMember.description: One member of a party, as `party_to_client` builds it. The party bonuses are the same in each member.

skin.description: The skin. A temporary skin (`tskin`) replaces it.

level.description: The level.

share.description: The part of the party loot for this member, 0 to 1. A merchant gets 0, except in a party of only merchants. Characters of one account get equal parts of the account total (node/server.js:1177-1184).

pdps.description: The contribution score of the member: damage, healing, tanking and skills (`add_pdps`). It sets `share`.

l.description: The number of members online that are not merchants. It sets the party bonuses.

xp.description: The XP bonus of the party in percent. For `l` = 0 to 8: 0, 0, 10, 16, 20, 24, 25, 30, 36; 40 for 9 and more (a party has at most 10 members) (node/server.js:1188).

luck.description: The luck bonus of the party: 10 for each member below level 60 that is not a merchant.

gold.description: The gold bonus of the party in percent. Always 5.

rip.description: Only when the member is dead. A gravestone cosmetic replaces `true` with its name.

cx.description: Cosmetics, keyed by slot. Only when the member has at least one; left out when `tcx` exists but is empty, even if `cx` has keys (`Object.keys(player.tcx || player.cx)`, node/server.js:1207-1209).

PokerState.title: PokerState
PokerState.description: The public state of the poker table in the tavern: the `poker` event with `event: "state"`.

tier.description: The key of the blinds in `G.games.poker.blinds`: the server name (`"I"`, `"II"`, ...) when that object has it, `"PVP"` on a PvP server (when the object has `PVP`), else `"IV"` (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:14-19). In G 17478 the keys are `"I"`, `"II"`, `"III"`, `"IV"` and `"PVP"`; the type is `string` because the set comes from G, not from the code.

blinds.description: The small blind and the big blind, in gold.

buyin.description: The smallest and the largest buy-in, in gold: `G.games.poker.buyin` (40 and 200) times the big blind.

stools.description: The position of each seat (stool), as an offset from `x`, `y`. The index is the seat index.

reach.description: How near a stool (px) the character must stand to sit on it with `join`: `G.games.poker.reach`, 40 in G.

rake.description: The rake of the house in percent of each pot that has a winner: `G.games.poker.rake`, 2 in G.

rake_cap.description: The largest rake of one pot, in gold: `G.games.poker.rake_cap` (10) times the big blind.

action_ms.description: The time for one decision: `G.games.poker.action_ms`, 20,000 in G.

bank_ms.description: The time bank: extra time that a seat gets once per hand, when `action_ms` ends. `G.games.poker.bank_ms`, 30,000 in G.

x.description: The x position of the table on the `tavern` map.

y.description: The y position of the table on the `tavern` map.

button.description: The seat index of the dealer button. `-1` before the first hand.

hands.description: The number of hands that the table dealt since the server started.

now.description: The time of the server (`Date.now()`, node/logic/tavern_poker.js:10-12), in ms since the Unix epoch. Compare it with `hand.deadline`.

next.description: The time until the next hand can start. `0` when it can start now.

log.description: The last 6 events of the table, oldest first. The server keeps 8 (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:313).

seats.description: One entry per seat (5). `null` is an empty seat.

hand.description: The hand in play, or the last hand while its result shows. `null` before the first hand.

PokerSeat.title: PokerSeat
PokerSeat.description: One occupied seat of the poker table.

name.description: The character in the seat.

stack.description: The gold of the seat that is not in the pot (the gold in front of the seat).

bet.description: The bet of the seat on this street. Between hands it keeps its value from the last street of its last hand (only a new street or a new deal resets it, node/logic/tavern_poker.js:713, 861).

out.description: The seat sits out: it gets no cards.

dc.description: The character left the game (disconnect). The seat waits for `grace_ms` (5 min in G).

leaving.description: The seat leaves when the hand ends (the character walked away from the stool, or asked to leave).

folded.description: The seat folded in the hand. A new seat starts with `true` (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:605); a seat that is not in the hand keeps the value from its last hand, so it can be `false` (only the deal resets it, node/logic/tavern_poker.js:715).

allin.description: The seat has all its gold in the pot.

can_raise.description: The seat can raise now (a hand runs, the seat is active, and the betting is open to it).

cards.description: The number of hole cards, not the cards: `2` for a seat in the hand, else `0`. The cards come in a `cards` event.

shown.description: Only after a showdown: the hole cards of this seat.

PokerHand.title: PokerHand
PokerHand.description: The public state of one poker hand.

n.description: The hand number: `hands` when it was dealt.

street.description: The betting round. `"showdown"` when the hand is over.

pot.description: All gold that the seats put in this hand.

bet.description: The largest bet on this street.

min_raise.description: The smallest raise: a bet must be at least `bet + min_raise`.

acting.description: The seat index that must act. `-1` when no seat must act.

settling.description: The server calculated the result and saves it. The result shows when `over` is `true`.

deadline.description: The time limit of the seat that acts, in ms since the Unix epoch: `Date.now()` plus `action_ms`, or plus `bank_ms` when the time bank starts (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:754, 897). The deal arms it at once (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:735-737, 838-844), so it is `0` only when the blinds put every seat all in; when `acting` goes to `-1` it keeps its last value.

banked.description: The seat that acts uses its time bank now.

over.description: The hand is over and `results` holds the result.

rake.description: The gold that the house took from this hand. `0` until the hand is over.

commit.description: `HMAC-SHA256(key, order.join(","))` as 64 hex characters. It fixes the deck before the deal, and it is public before the deal.

key.description: Only when `over` is `true`: the HMAC key, 32 hex characters.

order.description: Only when `over` is `true`: the full deck (52 cards) in the order of the shuffle. The server deals from the end (`pop`).

PokerResults.title: PokerResults
PokerResults.description: The result of a poker hand, in `hand.results` after the hand. The keys of the objects are seat indexes, as strings.

winners.description: The gold that each seat won from the pots, after the rake.

returned.description: The gold that came back to a seat because no other seat matched it (an uncalled bet). No rake.

hands.description: The hand of each live seat, a value of `G.games.poker.hands` (for example `"two_pair"`). Always present; empty unless 2 or more seats reached the showdown (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:1003-1007).

shown.description: The hole cards of each live seat. Always present; empty unless 2 or more seats reached the showdown (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:1003-1007).

pots.description: Each pot, from the main pot to the side pots.

voided.description: The hand was voided: a seat's saved escrow no longer matched (for example the character logged in on another server), the awards did not conserve gold, or the shutdown of the server started (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:225, 231, 243-244, 278). Each seat gets back its opening stack, with no rake. The other objects are empty. A failed save does not void the hand: the next tick tries again (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:918-919, 1273).

PokerPot.title: PokerPot
PokerPot.description: One pot of a poker hand: won by one or more seats, or returned to one seat.

gold.description: The gold of the pot, after the rake.

rake.description: The rake of this pot: `rake` percent (2 in G), at most `rake_cap` (10 big blinds). Absent on a returned pot.

winners.description: The seat indexes that share the pot, in clockwise order from the first seat after the button. The gold that does not divide evenly goes 1 gold each to the first ones in this list (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:983-994). Absent on a returned pot.

returned.description: Only on a returned pot (an uncalled bet): the seat index that gets it back, with no rake.

PokerLogEntry.title: PokerLogEntry
PokerLogEntry.description: One event in the log of the poker table.

t.description: The kind. `join`: a buy-in or a top-up. `out`, `in`: sit out, sit in (`out` also when a seat goes broke after a hand, node/logic/tavern_poker.js:1083). `deal`: a new hand. `act`: a decision. `void`: a voided hand. `win`: a seat won gold. `leave`: a cash-out. `back`: a reconnect. `dc`: a disconnect.

at.description: The time of the event, in ms since the Unix epoch (`Date.now()`, node/logic/tavern_poker.js:10-12, 311).

name.description: The character. All kinds except `deal` and `void`.

g.description: Gold. `join`: the buy-in or the top-up. `leave`: the cash-out (the stack). `win`: the gold won. `act`: the call, or the total street bet of a bet, raise or all-in (`0` for a check or a fold).

auto.description: Only `act`: `true` when the clock ran out and the server checked or folded (the clock made the decision).

street.description: Only `act`: the street of the decision.

h.description: Only `win`: the hand name, or `null` when the others folded.

PokerCard.title: PokerCard
PokerCard.description: One playing card of Tavern Hold'em: `"<rank>_<suit>"`, for example `"10_hearts"` or `"A_spades"`. The ranks are `G.games.poker.ranks` (`"2"` to `"10"`, `"J"`, `"Q"`, `"K"`, `"A"`). The suits are `G.games.poker.suits` (`hearts`, `diamonds`, `clubs`, `spades`).

PokerCards.title: PokerCards
PokerCards.description: Your hole cards in a poker hand. Only the seat owner gets them.

PokerTableView.title: PokerTableView
PokerTableView.description: The poker state that `poker` `info` returns in `table`: the public state plus your seat and cards.

tier.description: The key of the blinds in `G.games.poker.blinds`: the server name (`"I"`, `"II"`, ...) when that object has it, `"PVP"` on a PvP server (when the object has `PVP`), else `"IV"` (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:14-19). In G 17478 the keys are `"I"`, `"II"`, `"III"`, `"IV"` and `"PVP"`; the type is `string` because the set comes from G, not from the code.

blinds.description: The small blind and the big blind, in gold.

buyin.description: The smallest and the largest buy-in, in gold: `G.games.poker.buyin` (40 and 200) times the big blind.

stools.description: The position of each seat (stool), as an offset from `x`, `y`. The index is the seat index.

reach.description: How near a stool (px) the character must stand to sit on it with `join`: `G.games.poker.reach`, 40 in G.

rake.description: The rake of the house in percent of each pot that has a winner: `G.games.poker.rake`, 2 in G.

rake_cap.description: The largest rake of one pot, in gold: `G.games.poker.rake_cap` (10) times the big blind.

action_ms.description: The time for one decision: `G.games.poker.action_ms`, 20,000 in G.

bank_ms.description: The time bank: extra time that a seat gets once per hand, when `action_ms` ends. `G.games.poker.bank_ms`, 30,000 in G.

x.description: The x position of the table on the `tavern` map.

y.description: The y position of the table on the `tavern` map.

button.description: The seat index of the dealer button. `-1` before the first hand.

hands.description: The number of hands that the table dealt since the server started.

now.description: The time of the server (`Date.now()`, node/logic/tavern_poker.js:10-12), in ms since the Unix epoch. Compare it with `hand.deadline`.

next.description: The time until the next hand can start. `0` when it can start now.

log.description: The last 6 events of the table, oldest first. The server keeps 8 (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:313).

seats.description: One entry per seat (5). `null` is an empty seat.

hand.description: The hand in play, or the last hand while its result shows. `null` before the first hand.

cards.description: Your hole cards in the current hand, or `[]`.

PlayersEntry.title: PlayersEntry
PlayersEntry.description: One online character in the reply to `players`. On a normal server, characters in a PvP instance are not in the list (`is_in_pvp`, node/server.js:12941).

name.description: The character name. `"Hidden"` on a PvP server.

map.description: The map name (a key of `G.maps`). `"Unknown"` on a PvP server.

age.description: The age of the character in days, rounded up: `ceil(hours since created / 24)` (node/server.js:12928).

level.description: The level.

afk.description: 1 when the character has a true `afk` (`true`, `"bot"` or `"code"`): a character of a code client also has 1 (node/server.js:12937, :12948).

party.description: The party name: the name of the party leader. `""` when the character is not in a party. On a PvP server, `"Hidden"` for any party, else `""` (node/server.js:12938).

kills.description: Only on a PvP server: the PvP kills of the character since its login (`kills` is 0 at login, node/server.js:11790; +1 per kill, node/server.js:3015). Kills of a character of the same owner, kills in `duelland` and team kills in `abtesting` do not count (node/server.js:2934-2947, 3014-3016).

NewMapData.title: NewMapData
NewMapData.description: The `new_map` payload: you (a character or an observer) are on another map or instance, with a full entity snapshot. `transport_player_to` sends it to a character (node/server.js:4744-4755), and `transport_observer_to` to an observer (node/server.js:4627-4637). A cave floor sends `map_chunk` events first.

name.description: The map of the destination.

x.description: The new position. A spawn with a scatter value adds a random offset.

direction.description: The facing direction, 0 to 3. From a point (`point[2] || 0`, always present) or from a spawn (`spawns[s][2]`); absent only when the spawn has no direction (101 of 154 spawns in G) (node/server.js:4686-4697). Observers always get `0`.

effect.description: The effect to draw. `0`: none. `1`: a teleport (town, respawn, cave doors). `"blink"` and `"magiport"`: those skills (node/server.js:14698, 14717). No other caller of `transport_player_to` passes another value.

info.description: `instance.info` of the destination, for example the state of an event map. `{}` for most instances (node/server_functions.js:1901).

m.description: The new map-change counter (`player.m`). Send it with each `move`. Observers get `0`.

entities.description: A `type: "all"` frame of the entities in view at the new position.

x-al-confirm.note: The player form also lists `eval: EV`, but `EV` is only assigned inside a dead `if (0 && ...)` block (node/server.js:4727-4737), so it is `undefined` and never sent

NewMapTavernInfo.title: NewMapTavernInfo
NewMapTavernInfo.description: `instance.info` of the `tavern` instance: the state of the dice game.

dice.description: The phase of the dice game: bets are open, the dice roll, or the result is locked.

num.description: The result of the last roll, for example `"42.17"`. Absent while the dice roll (node/server_functions.js:1412); during `"bets"` it still holds the previous result (node/server_functions.js:1419, 1558).

seconds.description: Seconds since the bets opened. The bets close at 30.

NewMapZoneInfo.title: NewMapZoneInfo
NewMapZoneInfo.description: `instance.info` of a floor of the Cave of Many Dreams (a generated map).

NewMapZone.title: NewMapZone
NewMapZone.description: The `zone` field of `NewMapZoneInfo`: the dream cave run that owns a floor.

run.description: The key of the run: `crypto.randomBytes(12).toString("hex")`, 24 hex characters (node/logic/generated_maps.js:473).

floor.description: The floor index, from 0 (`floor: i`, node/logic/dream_layout.js:1254).

expires.description: When the run ends: milliseconds since the Unix epoch, `Date.now()` + 24 minutes at the start of the run (node/logic/generated_maps.js:545).

EntitiesFrame.title: EntitiesFrame
EntitiesFrame.description: The payload of `entities`: the players and monsters in view. `new_map` and `start` carry one in their `entities` field. Each entity is a complete object, not a change (node/server.js:13705). The view is the vision box of the receiver (`B.vision`, 700 x 500 px each way, node/server.js:217). The receiver itself is in `players` only in a `type: "all"` frame: `send_xy_updates` skips it (node/server.js:13695), `send_all_xy` does not (node/server_functions.js:3679-3685). Before an `"all"` frame, the server sends `disappear` `{id, outside: true}` for each entity that the receiver saw before and that is not in the frame (node/server_functions.js:3696-3700), so a client can drop the entities that it holds and that are not in it.

type.description: `"all"`: a full snapshot of everything in view (`send_all_xy`); `send_updates`, `loaded`, `new_map` and `start` carry this form. `"xy"`: the entities that changed in this tick of the instance (`send_xy_updates`).

players.description: Characters and NPCs in view, from `player_to_client(p, 1)`: the stranger form of `Character` (no inventory, gold or detailed stats). Dead and invisible characters are not in the list.

monsters.description: Monsters in view, from `monster_to_client`. Dead and invisible monsters are not in the list.

xy.description: Only when `mode.xyinf` is on and the receiver moves. The default is off (node/server.js:274), so the live server does not send it (node/server.js:13750, node/server_functions.js:3705).

EntitiesXy.title: EntitiesXy
EntitiesXy.description: The position of the receiver in an `entities` frame.

EntitiesPlayer.title: EntitiesPlayer
EntitiesPlayer.description: A character or an NPC as other clients see it: the stranger form of `player_to_client`. The first group of `player_to_client` fields (node/server.js:859-901), then `stand`, `controller`, `skin`, `cx`, `slots`, `tp`, `ctype` and `owner` (node/server.js:905-924). A field with the value `undefined` is absent. A stranger gets no `map`, `in`, stats, items or gold (node/server.js:938-989). NPCs (citizens, cavalry, event NPCs) are in the same list. They can lack some stat fields, and they add `name` (node/server.js:926-934).

id.description: The name of the character. An NPC has `"$"` and its name, for example `"$Venn"` (node/server_functions.js:1808).

max_mp.description: Maximum mana points. An NPC can lack it.

xp.description: Experience in this level. Can be fractional: XP gains are not rounded, for example a merchant gets `tax * 3.2` per sale (node/server_functions.js:750); seen live as `106466429.2`.

frequency.description: Attacks per second. An NPC can lack it.

resistance.description: Resistance. An NPC can lack it.

level.description: The level.

party.description: The leader of the party. `null` after leaving a party (node/server_functions.js:3608, 3618, 3633): `player_to_client` copies any value that is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905).

rip.description: `true` when the character is dead, `false` after a revive or a state restore (node/server.js:1122, 6292, 15108), absent if never set; `null` is seen live on other players (the stored record's value). With a gravestone cosmetic it becomes the gravestone name, but only from the next payload: the server changes `player.rip` after it copies it (node/server.js:915-917).

npc.description: Only for NPCs: the id of the NPC in the map definition, for example `"pokerdealer"` (node/server_functions.js:1803).

allow.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

code.description: The last `code` event said that code runs.

afk.description: `"code"` when the character logged in with `no_html` (a code client).

c.description: Channeled actions (for example `town`, `fishing`), keyed by name. Each has `ms`, the time left.

q.description: `player.q`: the timers of `upgrade`, `compound` and `exchange`, and the tavern spins, keyed by that name. `player_to_client` sends it also to strangers (node/server.js:884).

b.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

age.description: The age of the character in days. NPCs do not have it.

abs.description: The position is absolute (after a teleport).

position_id.description: Set for NPC characters. It goes up each time the NPC jumps to a new place.

angle.description: Set by cave logic on actors. Not set for a normal character.

cid.description: The change id. It goes up when the character changes.

guild.description: The guild: the guild's short name when the account is in one (node/server.js:11732, 11820-11823), else the character record's value, which is `""` or `null`. `player_to_client` copies it whenever it is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905), so `null` arrives (seen live).

team.description: The team in a team event or a duel (`"A"` or `"B"`).

motion.description: Only for NPCs with a scripted motion: a copy of `player.motion` with `age` (ms since the start) and without `started` (node/server.js:857-858).

stand.description: From `p.stand`: the merchant stand is open (the stand item name), or `false`.

controller.description: Only when `afk` is `"code"`: the character whose code controls this one, or `""`.

cx.description: Cosmetics, keyed by slot (or the temporary cosmetics).

slots.description: Equipped items, keyed by slot name: `player.cslots` (node/server.js:920). Absent when `cslots` was never built: citizen NPCs are created without it (node/server_functions.js:1785-1830; only `cache_player_items` and cavalry set it, node/server_functions.js:4320, node/logic/cavalry.js:254); seen live. Otherwise the same object as `Character.slots`. A trade slot (`trade1`, `trade2`, ...) of a merchant stand holds a `TradeSlotItem`: `reslot_player` builds it with `cache_item(item, 1)`, which keeps `price`, `rid` and the other trade fields (node/server_functions.js:4301-4310).

tp.description: For 500 ms after a transport with an effect: the character just appeared. Always `true`, never the effect (node/server.js:920-922, 4706-4718).

owner.description: The user id of the owner, or `""` for a private character.

name.description: Only for NPCs: the display name, for example `"Venn"`.

direction.description: Only for NPCs that face a fixed direction: 0 to 3 (node/server.js:931-934).

x-al-confirm.note: The stranger form of `player_to_client`; citizen NPCs have no `cslots`, so no `slots`.

EntitiesMonster.title: EntitiesMonster
EntitiesMonster.description: A monster as `monster_to_client` builds it. Most stats are only present when they differ from `G.monsters[type]`. Take the missing values from G: a monster at full health has no `hp` (node/server.js:1006-1028).

id.description: The monster id, a string of digits.

type.description: The monster type, a key of `G.monsters`.

abs.description: The position is absolute (after a teleport).

angle.description: The facing angle in degrees. Cave actors have it.

cid.description: The change id. It goes up when the monster changes.

target.description: The character that the monster attacks.

level.description: The level. Only when it is above 1.

speed.description: Only when it differs from G.

hp.description: Hit points. Only when they differ from `G.monsters[type].hp`.

mp.description: Only when it differs from G.

max_mp.description: Only when it differs from G.

attack.description: Only when it differs from G.

xp.description: Only when it differs from G.

frequency.description: Only when it differs from G.

armor.description: Only when it differs from G.

resistance.description: Only when it differs from G.

1hp.description: Each hit does 1 damage. Only when it differs from G.

skin.description: Only when it differs from G.

cooperative.description: Only when it differs from G.

drops.description: Only when it differs from G. Unclear from the source: no code in `node/` sets `monster.drops` (the `data.drops =` lines at node/server.js:5469-5472 are another payload), so in practice it is never sent.

slots.description: Only for cave actors: equipped items.

name.description: Only for cave actors and pets: the display name.

cave.description: Only for actors in the Cave of Many Dreams.

owner.description: Only for pets and traps: the character that owns it.

events.description: Only in an `"xy"` frame, when the monster did something in this tick. Handle each pair in order.

EntitiesMonsterCave.title: EntitiesMonsterCave
EntitiesMonsterCave.description: The `cave` field of a monster in the Cave of Many Dreams.

room.description: The room id, for example `"0:shop"`, `"1:patrol:3"`, `"2:farm:4"`, `"1:2"`, `"rescue:5"` or `"follower:<monster id>"` (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:128, 147, 163, 183, 205, 2078, 2120).

side.description: The side of the actor: `"enemy"`, `"predator"` or `"neutral"` (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:250-270), or `"ally"`, `"victim"`, `"duel_left"`, `"duel_right"` from `cave_set_side` (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:435, 929, 946-947, 1119, 1187-1189).

citizen.description: The actor is the NPC of a citizen room.

EntitiesMonsterEvent.title: EntitiesMonsterEvent
EntitiesMonsterEvent.description: One thing that a monster did in a tick: an `[event, payload]` pair inside `entities`. Handle it as if the server sent that event. `["hit", def]` is a monster attack, with the `hit` payload (node/server.js:4342-4346). The default `mode.instant_monster_attacks: 1` (node/server.js:292) sends `hit` directly instead, so the live server only puts `["ui", ...]` pairs here (node/server.js:14106, 14121).

EntitiesMheal.title: EntitiesMheal
EntitiesMheal.description: The `ui` payload of a monster heal, inside `EntitiesMonsterEvent`.

type.description: A monster healed itself or another monster.

heal.description: The hit points that it got back.

CallLogEntry.title: CallLogEntry
CallLogEntry.description: One entry of the call-cost log of a socket: `[time, event name, cost]`. `add_call_cost` keeps these in `socket.calls` and drops entries older than 4 s when the next cost comes. The time is a `Date` on the server, so it arrives as an ISO 8601 string. The name is the event of the handler, or a label that some costs use (`cm_data`, `bank`, `transport`). Each event starts a new entry with cost 1 (`add_call_cost(-1)`, node/server.js:4897). An extra cost with the same name as the last entry (from `CC`, or from `resend`) adds to that entry. The cost is a number and can have a fraction (`cm_data` to more than one target multiplies by 0.8, node/server.js:4930-4933). `reduce_call_cost` lowers the cost of the last entry and removes it at 0 or below. A cost of 0 or none counts as 1 (`if (!num) num = 1`, node/server_functions.js:5347-5349).

x-al-confirm.note: Live: ccreport and limitdcreport samples have [ISO string, name, number] entries.

TrackEntry.title: TrackEntry
TrackEntry.description: One character that the ranger skill `track` found: no name, only a class sound, a distance and invisibility.

sound.description: `"rr"` for a rogue or a ranger, `"pm"` for a priest or a mage, `"wmp"` for every other class.

dist.description: The distance from you in px. It is less than `G.skills.track.range` (1,440).

DropRow.title: DropRow
DropRow.description: One row of a drop table: `[chance, what, ...]`. The first element is a chance. In `maps`, `drops`, `monsters_home_server` and `global*`, the entry drops when a random number divided by the luck factors is below it (node/server.js:2288-2370). In `tables`, it is a weight: one entry wins, with the chance weight / sum of weights (`exchange`, node/server_functions.js:4029-4149). The second element tells the kind. It is an item name, `"open"` (roll the table that the third element names), `"gold"`, `"shells"`, `"empty"`, `"cx"` or `"cxbundle"` (a cosmetic), or `"cxjar"`. For an item, the third element is the quantity and a fifth element is a property such as `"lucky"` (node/server_functions.js:4117-4119). `cxjar` is `[chance, "cxjar", 1, cosmetic]`. The forms in `design/drops.js` are exactly these.

x-al-confirm.note: Every row of design/drops.js (and the `exchange` list of citizen22 that `marketparcel` uses, design/npcs.js:756) has one of these forms.

TrackerMax.title: TrackerMax
TrackerMax.description: The best values of all characters of an account, from the login (`player.max_stats`): the best character of the account for each monster type.

monsters.description: Monster type to `[best count, character]`. The count is `monsters + monsters_diff` of the best character (node/server.js:11665-11674).

level.description: The highest level of the account. Can be absent after a HARDCORE reset (node/server_functions.js:549).

TradeHistoryEntry.title: TradeHistoryEntry
TradeHistoryEntry.description: One line of the trade history of a character: `[event, other character, item, price]`, plus the received item for a swap. `add_to_trade_history` writes it, at most 40 lines (node/server_functions.js:342-363). `buy` and `sell`: the price is the total gold of the trade, before the tax of the seller: the unit price (an integer, node/server.js:7682, 8808) times the quantity. `swap`: `["swap", partner, given, 0, received]`: index 2 is the item that the character gave, index 4 the item that it got. `giveaway`: only the giver records it, with the winner as the other character and no price (`undefined` in the array becomes `null` in JSON; node/server.js:16124, 16201). A trade can go into the last line (not for a swap). This occurs when the event, the other character, the item name and the level are the same. Then the server adds the quantity to `q` and the price to index 3.

TradeHistoryItem.title: TradeHistoryItem
TradeHistoryItem.description: The item of a trade, in the trade view (`cache_item(item, true)`). The trade view keeps all keys of the item except `grace`, `o`, `oo` and `src` (node/server_functions.js:4203, 4234-4261). So a stand item keeps its `price`, `rid` and other trade keys (see `TradeSlotItem`). `q` is the quantity of this trade. The `sell`/`buy` lines of a buy order (`trade_sell`, node/server.js:8892-8894) copy the inventory item of the seller, so they have no `price`/`rid`.

name.description: The item. `"placeholder"` while an upgrade or a compound of this slot runs; see `PlaceholderItem`.

q.description: The quantity. Only for stackable items (`G.items[name].s`).

level.description: The upgrade or compound level. New items that can be upgraded or compounded get `0` (node/server.js:1986-1988).

p.description: A special property, for example `"shiny"`, `"lucky"`, `"glitched"`. A placeholder holds an object here. Can be `null`: a compound sets `item0.p = item0.p || item1.p || item2.p` even when no input had one (node/server.js:7073-7077), and the stored `undefined` comes back as `null`. Live captures show `p: null` on compounded rings, earrings, belts, amulets and orbs.

stat_type.description: The stat from a `pscroll`, for example `"str"`.

l.description: The lock state from `locksmith` (node/server.js:6820-6855). A locked item cannot be sent or upgraded with a `uscroll`.

ld.description: The end of the unseal wait: `JSON.stringify` of a `Date` 2 days in the future, so the string holds a quoted ISO 8601 date (for example `"\"2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z\""`). `locksmith` `unlock` sets it on a sealed item (`l: "s"` becomes `"u"`) and reads it with `JSON.parse` on the next `unlock` (node/server.js:6819-6823). The server does not delete it when the unseal completes.

m.description: The merchant whose luck made the item.

v.description: A date string. The item came from PvP.

acl.description: Account locked: only characters of the same owner can get the item. The server tests it as true or false; the value type is unclear from the source.

expires.description: An ISO 8601 date string (a `Date` from `future_s`). The item expires at this time. The `elixir` slot always has it (node/server.js:7797-7799).

gift.description: The item was a gift. The value type is unclear from the source.

charges.description: Charges of an item that skills use.

data.description: Free data of some items, for example a `cxjar`.

ach.description: The item achievement this item counts toward (a key of `G.achievements`); `item_achievement_increment` sets it and deletes it when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5846-5868).

acc.description: The progress count of that item achievement. Deleted when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5850-5865). Live captures show it without `ach` on some items.

ex.description: Only on the item in the `elixir` slot: `use` of an elixir sets `{name, expires, ex: true}` (node/server.js:7799). Renewing the same elixir keeps the object and only moves `expires` (node/server.js:7797).

ps.description: Every property the item has had, in order: `add_item_property` pushes the old `p` and the new one (node/server_functions.js:3220-3233). `cache_item` keeps it.

b.description: The listing is a buy order (`trade_wishlist`, node/server.js:8804-8809): the owner buys this item. A buy order always has `q`, also for an item that does not stack: `min(99, q)` for an upgrade or compound item, else `q` up to 9999 (node/server.js:8795, 8811-8816).

want.description: The listing is a trade offer: the owner gives the item for the item in `want`.

giveaway.description: The listing is a giveaway that lasts this many minutes.

list.description: The names that joined the giveaway. Only on a giveaway.

registry.description: Only on a giveaway that someone joined: the `auth_id` of each account that joined, mapped to the name of its character (node/server.js:8774-8776). `cache_item(item, true)` does not remove it, so the minute timer (node/server.js:16215) and `reslot_player` (node/server_functions.js:4308) send it to every client that sees the stand. A server bug: it leaks the `auth_id` of each participant.

price.description: The price of one unit on the stand, when the item was on a stand.

rid.description: The id of the stand listing, when it had one.

gf.description: Only for a giveaway: the giver.

MapInfoDuel.title: MapInfoDuel
MapInfoDuel.description: `instance.info` of a duel instance: the countdown and the two teams. The `duel` handler builds it when a challenge is accepted (node/server.js:12238-12246). The `enter` form of `duel` adds a party member to `A` or `B` (node/server.js:12338-12345). The event loop refreshes it each second (node/server_functions.js:2899-2932). `new_map` and `start` carry the same object in `info`.

seconds.description: Seconds until the fight starts: 60 at the start (20 on a Dev server), 1 less on each pass of the event loop, then 0.

active.description: `false` during the countdown. `true` when the fight started.

A.description: Team A: the challenger and the challenger's party members that entered.

B.description: Team B: the challenged character and that character's party members that entered.

id.description: The duel instance: a random 20-character name (`randomStr(20)`, node/server.js:12234).

skin.description: The skin, or the temporary skin.

level.description: The level.

name.description: The character.

rip.description: Only when the character is dead: the gravestone cosmetic name, or `true`.

cx.description: Cosmetics, keyed by slot (the temporary cosmetics when there are some). `{}` when there are none.

active.description: The character is still in the duel. `false` when it died, left the instance or disconnected. The server then stops the refresh of this summary, so the other fields keep their last values.

PlayerSummary.title: PlayerSummary
PlayerSummary.description: A short form of a character, as `player_to_summary` builds it: in `observer_broadcast` and in the teams of a duel.

skin.description: The skin, or the temporary skin.

level.description: The level.

name.description: The character.

rip.description: Only when the character is dead: the gravestone cosmetic name, or `true`.

cx.description: Cosmetics, keyed by slot (the temporary cosmetics when there are some). `{}` when there are none.

GameLogText.title: GameLogText
GameLogText.description: A localized `game_log` line, with optional style fields.

phrase.description: The key of the phrase in the language files.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

color.description: A CSS color (`"#F12F02"`) or a color name of the client (`"gold"`, `"gray"`).

confetti.description: Only on a giveaway result: the winner. The official client shows confetti on that character (node/server.js:16131, 16208).

x-al-confirm.note: Every game_log call site that builds a localized object passes only `color`, or `color` and `confetti` (the giveaway lines), as the extra `fields` of `localization.message`.

ResaleItem.title: ResaleItem
ResaleItem.description: An item in the list of Ponty (`secondhands`) or of Lost and Found (`lostandfound`). The server builds it with `cache_item(item, true)`: the trade view, without `grace`, `o`, `oo` and `src` (node/server_functions.js:4203, 4234-4261). A secondhands item has no `v` (node/server_functions.js:613); a lost and found item keeps it. Each list keeps at most 400 items and at most 5 for each name and level; a titled item can replace an untitled one at that cap. When a list has 400 items, a new item replaces the item at index 0. Items with `cash`, `expires` or `acl` do not go into the list of Ponty. In the list of Ponty, items that an NPC sells go in only at level 7 or more (upgrade) or 2 or more (compound).

name.description: The item. `"placeholder"` while an upgrade or a compound of this slot runs; see `PlaceholderItem`.

q.description: The quantity. Only for stackable items (`G.items[name].s`).

level.description: The upgrade or compound level. New items that can be upgraded or compounded get `0` (node/server.js:1986-1988).

p.description: A special property, for example `"shiny"`, `"lucky"`, `"glitched"`. A placeholder holds an object here. Can be `null`: a compound sets `item0.p = item0.p || item1.p || item2.p` even when no input had one (node/server.js:7073-7077), and the stored `undefined` comes back as `null`. Live captures show `p: null` on compounded rings, earrings, belts, amulets and orbs.

stat_type.description: The stat from a `pscroll`, for example `"str"`.

l.description: The lock state from `locksmith` (node/server.js:6820-6855). A locked item cannot be sent or upgraded with a `uscroll`.

ld.description: The end of the unseal wait: `JSON.stringify` of a `Date` 2 days in the future, so the string holds a quoted ISO 8601 date (for example `"\"2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z\""`). `locksmith` `unlock` sets it on a sealed item (`l: "s"` becomes `"u"`) and reads it with `JSON.parse` on the next `unlock` (node/server.js:6819-6823). The server does not delete it when the unseal completes.

m.description: The merchant whose luck made the item.

v.description: A date string. The item came from PvP.

acl.description: Account locked: only characters of the same owner can get the item. The server tests it as true or false; the value type is unclear from the source.

expires.description: An ISO 8601 date string (a `Date` from `future_s`). The item expires at this time. The `elixir` slot always has it (node/server.js:7797-7799).

gift.description: The item was a gift. The value type is unclear from the source.

charges.description: Charges of an item that skills use.

data.description: Free data of some items, for example a `cxjar`.

ach.description: The item achievement this item counts toward (a key of `G.achievements`); `item_achievement_increment` sets it and deletes it when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5846-5868).

acc.description: The progress count of that item achievement. Deleted when the achievement completes (node/server_functions.js:5850-5865). Live captures show it without `ach` on some items.

ex.description: Only on the item in the `elixir` slot: `use` of an elixir sets `{name, expires, ex: true}` (node/server.js:7799). Renewing the same elixir keeps the object and only moves `expires` (node/server.js:7797).

ps.description: Every property the item has had, in order: `add_item_property` pushes the old `p` and the new one (node/server_functions.js:3220-3233). `cache_item` keeps it.

rid.description: The id of this entry (listing): 5 random characters (`randomStr(5)`). Send it as `rid` with `sbuy`.

x-al-confirm.note: The `info` of `welcome`: `instances[undefined]` is absent, so it is the literal `{}`.

LostandfoundQuery.title: LostandfoundQuery
LostandfoundQuery.description: The object payload of `lostandfound`: a request for the list of lost items. The server ignores other fields. With no payload (`socket.emit("lostandfound")`), the server acts as for an object without `request_id`.

request_id.description: Any truthy value. The replies become `game_response` objects that carry it.

CaveUpdate.title: CaveUpdate
CaveUpdate.description: A `cave` event with a new snapshot of the run.

type.description: `"choice"`: a vote opened, or you talked to an actor. `"result"`: the vote ended. `"returned"`: you came back to the run after a disconnect.

state.description: The run, as you see it.

CaveCueUpdate.title: CaveCueUpdate
CaveCueUpdate.description: A `cave` event with a line or a warning from an actor.

state.description: The run, as you see it.

CaveChatUpdate.title: CaveChatUpdate
CaveChatUpdate.description: A `cave` event with what a traveler says to you.

state.description: The run, as you see it.

CaveEnded.title: CaveEnded
CaveEnded.description: A `cave` event: you left the run.

reason.description: `"exit"`: you left (`leave`, or the `exit` interaction). `"closed"`: the run ended (time out, or all members left). `"restart"`: the game server restarts.

state.description: The last snapshot. `null` when the cave state of the run does not exist.

x-al-confirm.note: `reason` is `"exit"` (both `exit` paths), `"closed"` (the default of `destroy_generated_run`) or `"restart"`

CaveCue.title: CaveCue
CaveCue.description: A line or a warning from an actor in a cave run.

id.description: A serial number in the run.

actor.description: The monster id of the actor.

text_message.description: `text` as a phrase. `cave_cue` leaves it out for a plain string, but every call site in the live code passes a `localization.message` object, so it is always there.

ChatLogPlayer.title: ChatLogPlayer
ChatLogPlayer.description: A public chat line of a player.

message.description: The text, at most 1,200 characters. The server removes some characters first (`strip_string`).

id.description: The id of the speaker: the character name. From the web Communicator it is `"comm:"` plus the database id of the character (api.js:1195).

ChatLogNpc.title: ChatLogNpc
ChatLogNpc.description: A chat line of an NPC or a monster. Most lines have a phrase key for translation.

owner.description: The name that the client shows: `"Ace"` (the `pvp` NPC), `"Grinch"` or `"mainframe"`.

id.description: `"pvp"`, `"mainframe"`, or the monster id of the Grinch.

phrase.description: The phrase key, for example `server.chat_log.pwned`. Absent on a mainframe reply.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase. Absent on a mainframe reply.

CitizenRepair.title: CitizenRepair
CitizenRepair.description: `citizen`: an NPC repairs a worker monster.

CitizenRouteMarks.title: CitizenRouteMarks
CitizenRouteMarks.description: `citizen`: Rook marks the way to an NPC in `desertland`.

to.description: `[x, y]` of the destination NPC.

type.description: An act of the poker dealer.

id.description: The id of the dealer NPC.

CitizenDealerSay.title: CitizenDealerSay
CitizenDealerSay.description: `citizen`: the poker dealer says a line.

type.description: An act of the poker dealer.

id.description: The id of the dealer NPC.

line.description: `<pool>.<index>`: an index into the list `G.npcs.pokerdealer[pool]` of the server (design/npcs.js:168-174). The pools are `idle`, `invite`, `deal`, `allin`, `win` and `split`. In the G that clients load, each pool is only its count (for example `idle: 8`): each client shows the line from its own language file.

name.description: Only for `win`: the winner of the main pot (node/logic/tavern_poker.js:1045).

CitizenDealerMock.title: CitizenDealerMock
CitizenDealerMock.description: `citizen`: the poker dealer deals to the empty seats.

type.description: An act of the poker dealer.

id.description: The id of the dealer NPC.

seats.description: The indexes of the empty seats, 0 to 4.

CitizenDealerFlourish.title: CitizenDealerFlourish
CitizenDealerFlourish.description: `citizen`: the poker dealer shows a card.

type.description: An act of the poker dealer.

id.description: The id of the dealer NPC.

card.description: A random card, `<rank>_<suit>` from `G.games.poker`, for example `"10_spades"`.

type.description: An act of the poker dealer.

id.description: The id of the dealer NPC.

delay.description: Only after an `idle` line: wait this long (1400 ms) before the emote.

DiceRoll.title: DiceRoll
DiceRoll.description: The dice table stops taking bets and rolls.

DiceLock.title: DiceLock
DiceLock.description: The result of the dice round, with the key that proves the commitment.

num.description: The roll: 5 characters, two digits, a dot and two digits (`"00.00"` to `"99.99"`) (node/server_functions.js:1560-1568). Server bug: on a hardcore server, in 7% of the rounds the server replaces the number after the commitment with the roll of an earlier round (node/server_functions.js:1588-1590). `num` is then not the number in `text`, and the HMAC check of `text` still passes.

text.description: The committed text: `"Num: <num> Initials: <first letters of the names in the tavern> Random: <16 to 31 random characters>"`.

key.description: The HMAC key: 20 to 39 random characters. `HMAC-SHA256(key, text)` in hex must equal `hex` of the `bets` event of the round.

DiceBets.title: DiceBets
DiceBets.description: A new round of dice bets, with the commitment to its number.

hex.description: `HMAC-SHA256(key, text)` as 64 hex characters. The `lock` event shows `key` and `text`.

DisappearOutside.title: DisappearOutside
DisappearOutside.description: `disappear`: the entity is out of view of this receiver.

id.description: The entity id: a monster id or a character name.

outside.description: The entity can still exist. The receiver does not see it now.

DisappearTransport.title: DisappearTransport
DisappearTransport.description: `disappear`: a character or an NPC moved to another place.

id.description: The character. An NPC id starts with `$`.

to.description: Characters only: the destination instance. Absent when the character is invisible or stealthed, or when the destination is not a normal map (a private instance).

s.description: Characters only, with `to`: the spawn index on the destination map, or the `[x, y]` (or `[x, y, direction, scatter]`) point. Absent when the code gives no spawn (node/server.js:4653-4656).

effect.description: The effect to draw. A character has it only when there is an effect: `1` (town, respawn, cave doors), `"blink"` or `"magiport"`. An NPC always has `1` or `0`.

DisappearMagiport.title: DisappearMagiport
DisappearMagiport.description: `disappear`: a monster moved to another place.

to.description: The destination map.

DisappearReason.title: DisappearReason
DisappearReason.description: `disappear`: a character disconnected, or an event NPC left.

id.description: The character or the NPC (its id starts with `$`).

DisappearNotThere.title: DisappearNotThere
DisappearNotThere.description: `disappear`: the target of a skill is not there.

id.description: The `id` of the request, unchanged: a number if the request sent a number.

reason.description: The target does not exist, is invisible or is farther than `B.max_vision`.

DisappearRemoval.title: DisappearRemoval
DisappearRemoval.description: `disappear`: `remove_monster` removed a monster without a death.

luckm.description: The luck multiplier of the character that the monster targeted, or 1.

points.description: Only for a cooperative monster: the contribution points, keyed by character name.

DisappearBare.title: DisappearBare
DisappearBare.description: `disappear` with only the id: a pet or an event monster moved.

DisappearingTextHelper.title: DisappearingTextHelper
DisappearingTextHelper.description: A floating text from the `disappearing_text` helper. With a localized text, the payload is the `LocalizedText` plus `x`, `y`, `id` and `args`. With a plain text, `message` is the text.

message.description: The text. A number in one case: a potion that takes HP (`snakeoil`) sends the amount as a number, for example `-100` (node/server.js:7849).

phrase.description: Only for a localized text: the phrase key.

phrase_args.description: Only for a localized text: the values for the phrase.

nv.description: Only when the call sets both `xy` and `nv` (node/server_functions.js:3987-3989). The meaning is unclear from the server.

DisappearingTextArgs.title: DisappearingTextArgs
DisappearingTextArgs.description: The style of a `disappearing_text` from the helper. The helper renames the fields of the call to short keys.

c.description: The color: a CSS color or a color name of the client (`"red"`, `"heal"`, `"evade"`). Absent when the call gives no color.

from.description: The entity that caused the text, for example the attacker of an `immune` text.

DisappearingTextDirect.title: DisappearingTextDirect
DisappearingTextDirect.description: A floating text that a call site sends without the helper. It has no `id`, and `args` has long keys.

x.description: The `x` of the entity or the chest.

y.description: A point above the entity: its `y` minus 10 to 40.

color.description: A CSS color or a color name of the client (`"+gold"`, `"gold"`, `"gray"`).

EvalCode.title: EvalCode
EvalCode.description: An `eval` payload in object form: the code of the official client to run.

code.description: A call of a function of the official client, for example `pot_timeout(4000)`, `pvp_timeout(3600)`, `skill_timeout('ethereal',120)`, `ui_move(x,y)`, `call_code_function('trigger_event','shutdown',{seconds:N})`.

FriendRequest.title: FriendRequest
FriendRequest.description: A friend request from another character.

name.description: The character that asks. To accept, send `friend` with `event: "accept"` and this name.

FriendNew.title: FriendNew
FriendNew.description: Your account has a new friend.

name.description: The account name (`user.name`) of the new friend, not a character name (node/server.js:12108-12109).

friends.description: The new friend list of your account: account ids (`owner` values). Replace your old list.
The new friend list of your account: account ids (`owner` values). Replace your old list. The server does not say which friend left.

phrase.description: The key of the phrase in the language files.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

reason.description: Only when the login claim failed: the reason from the claim (an `ex()` call in the claim transaction, or `"exception"` when it threw), also in `phrase_args`.

examples.message: Your poker hand is still running on another server. Wait for it to finish, or reconnect there.

GameLogPlain.title: GameLogPlain
GameLogPlain.description: A `game_log` line with no phrase key: `message` and `color` only.

examples.message: The stairway is opening. Stay near the landing.

GameResponseCondition.title: GameResponseCondition
GameResponseCondition.description: The `game_response` `condition`: a condition was put on you. Built by `add_condition` (node/server_functions.js:3236-3361) and pushed to `hitchhikers`, so it arrives inside the next `player`. Your `player.s[name]` has the same condition.

name.description: The condition: a key of `G.conditions`.

cevent.description: Always `true`: the official client fires the code event `condition`.

duration.description: The time of the condition, the same as `player.s[name].ms`: `duration` or `ms` of the call, else `G.conditions[name].duration`, else 1000. Never less than the time that the condition already had. Resistances can make it shorter, with a fraction.

from.description: Who gave the condition (`args.from.name` or `args.f`). Absent when the call site gives no source.

GameResponseConditionEnded.title: GameResponseConditionEnded
GameResponseConditionEnded.description: The `game_response` `ex_condition`: a condition of yours ended.

name.description: The condition: a key of `G.conditions`.

GameResponseOther.title: GameResponseOther
GameResponseOther.description: A `game_response` object that is not from `fail_response` or `success_response`.

place.description: The request, when the call site sets it.

failed.description: When the call site sets it.

success.description: When the call site sets it.

cevent.description: Asks the official client to fire a code event. `true` means the code is the event name.

stale.description: Hitchhiker results of a timer that ran while you were offline.

x-al-confirm.note: An open catch-all: some call site sets each listed field; others add their own

HitDamage.title: HitDamage
HitDamage.description: A `hit` from a projectile that reached its target: the damage or the heal, and the effects that happened. The server builds one `def` object for the attack (node/server.js:3229) and changes it for each target. Flags that are not in the list at node/server.js:3964-3973 can stay from an earlier target of the same attack.

projectile.description: A key of `G.projectiles`. The server starts it as `null` (node/server.js:3229-3249), but `commence_attack` then reads `G.projectiles[def.projectile].speed` (node/server.js:3582-3583), which throws for `null`, so every `hit` that is sent has a string.

damage_type.description: The damage type at the start of the attack: `"physical"`, `"magical"` or `"pure"` (node/server.js:3539). Absent when the attacker has none.

pid.description: The projectile id of the first `action`. A reflected projectile keeps this id; see Notes.

id.description: The id of the target of this event.

damage.description: The HP that the target lost, after shields. Absent for a heal.

heal.description: Only for a heal: the HP that the target got (node/server.js:3999).

kill.description: The HP of the target is 0 or less.

crit.description: A critical hit: the damage multiplier, `2 + critdamage / 100` (node/server.js:4016-4017).

lifesteal.description: The HP that the attacker got back (node/server.js:4183).

manasteal.description: The MP that the attacker took from the target (node/server.js:4199).

goldsteal.description: A monster with `goldsteal` took this gold, 1 to 12 (node/server.js:4204-4207). The heal path sets `-88`; no monster in G heals with `goldsteal`.

mp_damage.description: `mshield`: the MP that the shield used instead of HP (node/server.js:4227-4231).

shield_reaction.description: The shield condition of the target that reacted (node/server.js:4236, 4282).

mp_restored.description: `aether_shield`: the MP that the paladin target got back from magical damage. Can be `0` (node/server.js:4281).

redirected.description: `guardians_oath`: the damage that went to the guardian instead (node/server.js:4246).

guardian_mp.description: `guardians_oath`: the MP that the guardian got back. Can be `0` (node/server.js:4248).

dreturn.description: Damage return: the HP that a melee attacker lost, from the `dreturn` of the target (node/server.js:4302).

mobbing.description: More than 3 monsters target the target: its combo counter (`target.combo`, node/server.js:3866).

stacked.description: The ids of the characters on the spot of the target. Each takes a part of the hit (node/server.js:3907-3910).

unintentional.description: This target is a splash or stack target (node/server.js:3977).

splash.description: This target took splash damage from `explosion` or `blast` (node/server.js:3980).

trigger.description: The `sugarrush` attribute of the attacker triggered (node/server.js:4122).

HitMiss.title: HitMiss
HitMiss.description: A `hit` that did no damage: the attack missed.

miss.description: The attack missed. Also when the target disconnected or died.

HitEvade.title: HitEvade
HitEvade.description: A `hit` that did no damage: the target evaded.

evade.description: The target evaded. Only for physical damage.

HitAvoid.title: HitAvoid
HitAvoid.description: A `hit` that did no damage because the target moved away from the start point of the projectile.

x.description: The start point: the position of the target when the `action` started.

HitReflect.title: HitReflect
HitReflect.description: A `hit` that tells that the target reflected the projectile. It has no `source`.

pid.description: The projectile id of the first `action`.

id.description: The id of the target that reflected it.

reflect.description: The damage that goes back to the attacker. The same value is `reflect` in the new `action`.

HitBurn.title: HitBurn
HitBurn.description: A `hit` from one tick of the `burned` condition. It has no `pid` and no `projectile`.

hid.description: On a monster: `f` of the condition, the name of the burner (a character name, or the `G.monsters` name of a monster, for example `"Goo"`). On a character: `fid` of the condition, the id of the burner.

id.description: The id of the burned entity.

kill.description: `true` when the HP is 0 or less after the tick, else `false`.

MapChunkBundle.title: MapChunkBundle
MapChunkBundle.description: The JSON text that the `map_chunk` parts of one floor make, joined in `index` order.

run.description: The key of the cave run, the same as `map_chunk.run`.

floors.description: The floor that the socket goes to. The server sends one floor each time.

manifest.description: All floors of the run, in floor order (node/logic/dream_layout.js:1230).

key.description: The map name of the floor: `zone_<run>_<floor number>`.

definition.description: The `G.maps` entry of the floor, without `data`. `definition.generated` has `run` and `floor`.

geometry.description: The geometry of the floor, the same form as `G.geometry` entries. With `no_graphics=1` it has only `x_lines`, `y_lines`, `min_x`, `min_y`, `max_x`, `max_y`, and empty `tiles`, `placements`, `groups` and `animations`.

navigation.description: Only with `no_graphics=1`: the walk map of the floor (`floor.amap`).

MapChunkManifestEntry.title: MapChunkManifestEntry
MapChunkManifestEntry.description: One floor in the `manifest` of a `MapChunkBundle`.

key.description: The map name of the floor: `zone_<run>_<floor number>`.

definition.description: The `G.maps` entry of the floor that the server builds: `name` (`"Cave of Many Dreams"`), `spawns`, `doors`, `generated` (`run`, `floor`, `version`, `zone`), `rooms` and more.

MerritStatus.title: MerritStatus
MerritStatus.description: Why Merrit, the market patron NPC, does not visit your stand now, and when the next visit can come.

reasons.description: Each condition that blocks a visit now. Empty when a visit can come.

next_at.description: The earliest time of the next visit, in ms since the Unix epoch. It is the larger of the end of the cooldown and the end of `warming`. `0` when the server knows neither.

last.description: The receipt of the last gift to this character (`player.p.merrit_receipt`), or `null` (node/logic/market_patron_runtime.js:62).

server_now.description: The time of the server when it built the status, in ms since the Unix epoch.

account_last.description: Only in the reply to `merrit_info`: the last gift to any character of the account (`owner.info.merrit`), or `null` (node/logic/market_patron_runtime.js:77, 82).

stand_opened.description: Only after the `merchant` handler: `true` when the stand is open now.

MerritStatusError.title: MerritStatusError
MerritStatusError.description: The `merrit_status` that the server sends when it cannot read the account.

MerritStatusReason.title: MerritStatusReason
MerritStatusReason.description: One condition that blocks a visit of Merrit. The server adds the codes in this order: `npc`, `stand_close` and `stand_front` (one per blocker), `area`, `closed`, `listing`. Then `warming`, only when the list is empty. Then `cooldown` and `inventory`. `unreachable` and `unavailable` replace the list. The distances come from `G.npcs.citizen22.market` (node/logic/market_patron.js:29-68).

code.description: `npc`: a fixed NPC is within `npc_clearance`. `stand_close`: an older stand is within `stand_clearance`. `stand_front`: an older stand is in front (within `front_width` sideways and `front_clearance` up or down). `area`: the stand is not in a market area of `main`. `closed`: no open stand (or dead, moving, disconnected, in the bank). `listing`: no item on the stand that qualifies. `warming`: the stand has not stayed in place for `settle_ms`. `cooldown`: the account got a gift less than `hour_ms` ago. `inventory`: no space for a `marketparcel`. `unreachable`: Merrit found no path. `unavailable`: the server could not read the account.

name.description: Only for `npc`, `stand_close` and `stand_front`: the name of the NPC or of the character with the other stand.

distance.description: Only for `npc`, `stand_close` and `stand_front`: the distance to that NPC or stand.

remaining_ms.description: Only for `warming` and `cooldown`: the time until that condition ends.

PartyUpdateState.title: PartyUpdateState
PartyUpdateState.description: The members of the party and their info.

list.description: The names of the members in order. The first name is the leader. The name of the leader is also the name of the party.

party.description: The info of each member, keyed by name. A member that is not on this server now is not in it.

PartyUpdateJoined.title: PartyUpdateJoined
PartyUpdateJoined.description: A text that a member joined, with the new members and their info.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

phrase.description: `server.party.joined_with_invite` when a member that is not the leader sent the invite (`accept`). After `accept`, `phrase_args` has `player` (the new member) and `inviter`, with either phrase; after `raccept`, it has only `player` and the phrase is `server.party.joined`.

list.description: The names of the members in order. The first name is the leader.

party.description: The info of each member, keyed by name.

PartyUpdateLeft.title: PartyUpdateLeft
PartyUpdateLeft.description: A text that a member left, with the members that stay.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

phrase.description: `phrase_args` has `player`: the member that left.

leave.description: Always 1. It marks a member that left.

list.description: The members that stay, in order. `false` when fewer than 2 members stay.

party.description: The info of each member that stays. `{}` when fewer than 2 members stay.

x-al-confirm.note: `list` is `newparty.length >= 2 && newparty`, so `false` for a party that is gone

PartyUpdateNone.title: PartyUpdateNone
PartyUpdateNone.description: An empty object: you are not in a party now.

PmMessage.title: PmMessage
PmMessage.description: A private message, or the copy of it that the sender gets.

to.description: Only in the copy of the sender: the recipient name, as the sender wrote it in `say`.

message.description: The text, at most 1,200 characters. The server removes some characters first (`strip_string`).

id.description: The id of the sender: the character name. From the web Communicator it is `"comm:"` plus the database id of the character (api.js:1195), except on another server.

xserver.description: The recipient is not on this server: in the copy of the sender, or in the message from another server.

x-al-confirm.note: `message` is `strip_string(...).substr(0, 1200)` in both `say` and `communicator_say`

PmDeliveryFailed.title: PmDeliveryFailed
PmDeliveryFailed.description: A notice to the sender: no character has the name of the recipient.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

phrase.description: The phrase key. `phrase_args` is `{}`.

owner.description: The name of the sender: you.

to.description: The recipient name, as you wrote it.

PvpListKill.title: PvpListKill
PvpListKill.description: One PvP kill in `pvp_list`: `[victor, victim]`. `issue_player_award` adds it to a ring of 200 entries (node/server.js:3021). The victor is the character with the `block` of the victim, if any, else the killer. Kills in `duelland` and team kills in `abtesting` return before this line, so they are not in the list (node/server.js:2934-2947).

SimpleEvalWindow.title: SimpleEvalWindow
SimpleEvalWindow.description: `simple_eval`: copy values to the `window` of the client.

window.description: Values that the admin code put in its local `window`. The client copies them to its `window`.

after.description: Code to run after the copy. `""` unless the admin code set it.

code.const: for(var id in data.window) window[id]=data.window[id]; eval(data.after);
code.description: The fixed code that copies `window` and runs `after`.

output.description: Text that the admin code set, or `"Exception: <error>"` when it threw. The client does not show it in this form.

json_output.description: A value that the admin code set.

code.description: The fixed code that shows `json_output`.

output.description: Text that the admin code set, or `"Exception: <error>"` when it threw. `""` when it set nothing.

code.description: The fixed code that shows `output` in a modal. `json_output` is `undefined` in this form, so JSON leaves it out.

TavernInfo.title: TavernInfo
TavernInfo.description: The house edge and the largest win that the tavern can pay now.

edge.description: The house edge in percent: `0.5`, `1`, `1.5` or `2`. It is lower when the server has more gold (`house_edge`, node/server_functions.js:1384-1396).

max.description: 40% of the free gold of the server: `parseInt((S.gold - house_debt()) * 0.4)`. A dice bet whose net win is larger fails with `tavern_gold_not_enough`.

game.description: The `game` value of the request, unchanged. Absent when the request had none or a falsy one (`if (data.game)`, node/server.js:12870).

TavernDiceBet.title: TavernDiceBet
TavernDiceBet.description: A dice bet that a character placed.

name.description: The character that bet.

num.description: The target number, 0.01 to 99.99.

dir.description: `"down"` wins when the roll is at most `num`. `"up"` wins when the roll is at least `num`.

name.description: The character that bet.

num.description: The target number of the bet.

gold.description: The gross win: `parseInt(stake * odds)`. It includes the stake and the house edge.

name.description: The character that bet.

num.description: The target number of the bet.

gold.description: The stake that the character lost.

TavernSlots.title: TavernSlots
TavernSlots.description: The result of one slots spin.

event.description: `"won"` when the spin drew a prize.

name.description: The character that played.

stops.description: One stop per reel: an index into `G.games.slots.reels[r]`.

symbols.description: The symbol at each stop. All three are the prize on a win.

prize.description: The gross prize from `G.games.slots.prizes`. `0` on a loss.

payout.description: The gold that the character got: `prize` minus the cut of the house (the edge on the profit). `0` on a loss.

gold.description: The stake: `G.games.slots.gold`.

TavernWheel.title: TavernWheel
TavernWheel.description: The result of one spin of the wheel.

name.description: The character that played.

side.description: The side of the bet, from `G.games.wheel.sides` (`"sun"` or `"moon"`).

result.description: The side of the slice that the wheel stopped on.

slice.description: The name of that slice (index 0 of the row in `G.games.wheel.slices`), for example `"teal"`.

index.description: The index of that slice in `G.games.wheel.slices`.

gold.description: The stake.

net.description: The profit: `gold` minus the cut of the house on a win, `-gold` on a loss.

payout.description: The gold that the character got: `2 * gold - cut` on a win, `0` on a loss.

TavernRefund.title: TavernRefund
TavernRefund.description: A wager that the tavern returned at the start of a shutdown.

name.description: The character that got the gold back.

gold.description: The gold returned. For dice, the total of all open bets of the character.

index.description: Only for the wheel: the slice that the spin had drawn.

symbols.description: Only for slots: the symbols that the spin had drawn.

TavernRoulette.title: TavernRoulette
TavernRoulette.description: A roulette bet object (dev servers only).

odds.description: The odds name of the bet, a key of `tavern.roulette.odds`. Default `"black"`.

gold.description: The stake, at least 1.

pid.description: The socket id of the character.

UiNamed.title: UiNamed
UiNamed.description: A `ui` event about one character: `type` and the name of that character.

name.description: The character.

UiBare.title: UiBare
UiBare.description: A `ui` event with only `type`: a `darkblessing` or a `warcry`.

UiFromTo.title: UiFromTo
UiFromTo.description: A `ui` event for a skill from one character on one target.

type.description: The skill. The `tangle` skill also sends `"entangle"` (node/server.js:10370-10377).

from.description: The character that used the skill.

to.description: The target. `entangle`: the `id` of the target (a monster or a character). The others: the name of the target character.

UiThrow.title: UiThrow
UiThrow.description: A `ui` event for the `throw` skill: who threw which item at whom.

from.description: The character that threw the item.

to.description: The `id` of the target.

item.description: The item that the character threw.

UiFromTargets.title: UiFromTargets
UiFromTargets.description: A `ui` event for a paladin skill on one friendly character.

targets.description: The target character. Always one name.

UiBeaconOfResolve.title: UiBeaconOfResolve
UiBeaconOfResolve.description: A `ui` event for `beacon_of_resolve`: the characters that got the condition.

from.description: Only from a player: the paladin. The paladin is also in `targets`.

name.description: Only from a cavalry NPC: the `id` of the NPC (node/logic/cavalry.js:443).

targets.description: The characters that got `beacon_of_resolve`. From a player it always has the paladin (`is_same` is true for the same name, node/server_functions.js:506-508). From a cavalry NPC it has at least one name.

UiArea.title: UiArea
UiArea.description: A `ui` event for an area skill: who used it and the ids that it affected.

name.description: The character that used the skill. For the `stomp` of a cave sentinel, the `id` of that monster (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:1482).

ids.description: The monsters (and in PvP, the characters) that the skill affected. It can be empty. `fanofknives` lists the targets of its projectiles.

UiAbsorb.title: UiAbsorb
UiAbsorb.description: A `ui` event for the `absorb` skill: the monsters that now target the priest.

name.description: The priest.

from.description: The `id` of the `skill` request, as sent: the character whose monsters the priest took.

ids.description: The monsters that now target the priest. It can be empty.

UiTargetId.title: UiTargetId
UiTargetId.description: A `ui` event for `huntersmark` or `charm`: who used it and on which target.

name.description: The character that used the skill.

fail.description: Only on a `charm` that failed. The user also gets the bare `game_response` `charm_failed`.

UiGatherFail.title: UiGatherFail
UiGatherFail.description: A `ui` event: `fishing` or `mining` did not start.

name.description: The character.

cevent.description: Asks the official client to fire a code event.

request_id.description: The `request_id` of the `skill` request, echoed. Absent when the request had none.

reason.description: `"location"`: no zone of that kind is 24 px up, down, left or right of the character. `"moving"`: the character moves.

x-al-confirm.note: `request_id` is `data.request_id`, so JSON drops it when the request had none.

name.description: The character.

direction.description: The side of the zone: `0` down, `1` left, `2` right, `3` up. When more than one side is in the zone, the last match in that order wins (node/server.js:10141-10152).

UiGatherNone.title: UiGatherNone
UiGatherNone.description: A `ui` event: `fishing` or `mining` ended with no item.

name.description: The character.

cevent.description: Asks the official client to fire a code event.

request_id.description: The `request_id` of the `skill` request, echoed. Absent when the request had none.

x-al-confirm.note: Sent with `player.socket.emit`, not `xy_emit`.

UiMluckFind.title: UiMluckFind
UiMluckFind.description: A `ui` event: merchant luck gave a merchant a copy of a looted item.

name.description: The merchant that got the copy.

item.description: The copy. `m` is the name of the character that looted the item.

num.description: The inventory slot of the merchant that got the copy.

cevent.description: Asks the official client to fire the code event `mluck`.

UiNpcSell.title: UiNpcSell
UiNpcSell.description: A `ui` event: a character sold an item to an NPC merchant.

id.description: The `id` of the NPC, for example `"basics"`.

name.description: The seller.

item.description: The item sold. For a stack, `q` is the quantity sold.

num.description: The `num` of the `sell` request, as sent: the inventory slot of the item.

x-al-confirm.note: `id` is the `id` of the NPC in `G.maps[map].npcs` (js/old_common_functions.js:233-236).

UiNpcBuy.title: UiNpcBuy
UiNpcBuy.description: A `ui` event: a character bought an item from an NPC merchant.

id.description: The `id` of the NPC, for example `"fancypots"`.

name.description: The buyer.

item.description: The item bought, with the quantity bought.

UiResale.title: UiResale
UiResale.description: A `ui` event: a character bought an item from `secondhands` or from `lostandfound`.

name.description: The buyer.

item.description: The item, from `cache_item(item, 1)`. It keeps `rid` (5 random characters, node/server_functions.js:613, 645). `cache_item` with `trade` removes `grace` and `src` (node/server_functions.js:4203).

UiTrade.title: UiTrade
UiTrade.description: A `ui` event: a sale or a purchase at a merchant stand.

seller.description: The character that gave the item.

item.description: The item, with `q` set to the quantity traded. It has `price`, the gold for one unit. From `trade_buy` it also keeps `rid`.

slot.description: The trade slot of the listing or the buy order.
