num.description: From `trade_sell`: the inventory slot of the buyer that got the item. From `trade_buy`: the `num` of the request, unchanged (a server bug: it is not the slot that got the item). Absent when that request has no `num`.

snum.description: Only from `trade_sell`: the inventory slot of the seller that the item came from.

UiSwap.title: UiSwap
UiSwap.description: A `ui` event: a character accepted a trade offer at a merchant stand.

buyer.description: The character that accepted the offer.

item.description: The listed item, without `want` and `rid` (the server deletes them before the event, node/server.js:9132-9133).

received.description: The item that the owner got. For a stack, `q` is the units given.

slot.description: The trade slot of the offer.

num.description: The inventory slot of the buyer that got the listed item.

snum.description: The inventory slot of the owner that got the item of the buyer.

UiItemSent.title: UiItemSent
UiItemSent.description: A `ui` event: a character sent an item to another character.

receiver.description: The character that got the item.

sender.description: The character that sent the item.

item.description: The item. `q` is always set: the quantity sent, also `1` for an item that does not stack.

num.description: The inventory slot of the receiver that got the item.

fnum.description: The inventory slot of the sender that the item came from.

UiGoldSent.title: UiGoldSent
UiGoldSent.description: A `ui` event: a character sent gold to another character.

receiver.description: The character that got the gold.

sender.description: The character that sent the gold.

gold.description: The gold that the receiver got. When the two characters have different owners and different IP addresses, the server keeps 2.5% (`parseInt(gold * 0.975)`, node/server.js:8557-8559). It does not take a fee on 1 gold.

UiCxSent.title: UiCxSent
UiCxSent.description: A `ui` event: a character sent a cosmetic to another character of the same owner.

receiver.description: The character that got the cosmetic.

sender.description: The character that sent the cosmetic.

cx.description: The `cx` of the `send` request: the cosmetic name.

UiResist.title: UiResist
UiResist.description: A `ui` event: an entity resisted a condition.

type.description: The condition plus `_resist`. These are the conditions with `defense` in G: `stunned` (`phresistance`), `deepfreezed` and `frozen` (`fzresistance`), `burned` (`firesistance`), `poisoned` (`pnresistance`).

id.description: The `id` of the entity that resisted.

x-al-confirm.note: The `type` values are the conditions with `defense` in G 17478.

UiRestoreMp.title: UiRestoreMp
UiRestoreMp.description: A `ui` event: a skill gave MP back instead of using it.

amount.description: The MP that the character got: two times the MP cost.

UiMlevel.title: UiMlevel
UiMlevel.description: A `ui` event: a monster gained or lost a level.

mult.description: `1`: one level up. `-1`: one level down (`delevel`, node/server.js:2656).

UiDisengage.title: UiDisengage
UiDisengage.description: A `ui` event: a monster stopped its attack.

cause.description: Why, for the log of the official client: `"bored"`, `"player_gone"`, `"scare"`, `"defeat"`, `"exceeds_range"`, `"cant_move"`, `"cant_move_smart"`, `"firecrackers"`, `"warpstomp"`, `"anger"`, `"disengage"`, `"stop()"`, `"kill_monster call"`, or a redirect (`"redirect"`, `"agitate redirect"`, `"absorb redirect"`, `"taunt redirect"`).

x-al-confirm.note: Every `stop_pursuit` caller passes `cause` (node/server.js and node/server_functions.js: 17 calls).

UiMheal.title: UiMheal
UiMheal.description: A `ui` event: a monster healed itself or another monster.

id.description: The `id` of the entity that got the HP.

heal.description: The HP that the entity got. Poison halves the heal.

UiSlots.title: UiSlots
UiSlots.description: A `ui` event: a character spun the slot machine of the tavern.

stops.description: The stop of each reel: an index into `G.games.slots.reels[reel]`. One number per reel.

UiWheel.title: UiWheel
UiWheel.description: A `ui` event: a character spun the Fortune's Wheel of the tavern.

side.description: The side that the character bet on: a value of `G.games.wheel.sides`.

index.description: The slice where the wheel stops: an index into `G.games.wheel.slices`. The result is known now; the payout comes when the spin ends.

UiCaveEnter.title: UiCaveEnter
UiCaveEnter.description: A `ui` event: a party starts to enter the Cave of Many Dreams, or the entry failed.

names.description: Only at the start: the characters that enter.

duration.description: Only at the start: the length of the animation, always `1800`.

key.description: The key of the run: 24 hex characters (node/logic/generated_maps.js:473). On a return to a run, the key of that run.

cancel.description: Only when the entry failed after the animation started.

WelcomeCharacter.title: WelcomeCharacter
WelcomeCharacter.description: The character that a `welcome` observer follows: `player_to_client(player)`, with `id` and `name` set to the name of the character.

xp.description: Experience in this level. Can be fractional: XP gains are not rounded, for example a merchant gets `tax * 3.2` per sale (node/server_functions.js:750); seen live as `106466429.2`.

level.description: The level.

m.description: The map-change counter. `move` must send this value.

abs.description: The position is absolute (after a teleport).

angle.description: Set by cave logic on actors. Not set for a normal character.

position_id.description: Set for NPC characters. Not set for a normal character.

motion.description: Set for NPC characters with a scripted motion; `age` is its age in ms (node/server.js:857-858).

c.description: Channeled actions (for example `town`, `fishing`), keyed by name. Each has `ms`, the time left.

q.description: `player.q`: the timers of `upgrade`, `compound` and `exchange`, and the spins of the tavern `wheel` and `slots`, keyed by that name (node/server.js:6669, 7051, 7438; node/logic/tavern_wheel.js:27, node/logic/tavern_slots.js:54).

b.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

rip.description: The character is dead. A gravestone cosmetic replaces `true` with its name (node/server.js:915-917). `false` after a revive or a state restore (node/server.js:1122, 6292, 15108); `null` is seen live on characters whose stored record holds it.

afk.description: `"code"` when the character logged in with `no_html` (a code client).

controller.description: Only when `afk` is `"code"`: the character whose code controls this one, or `""`.

code.description: The last `code` event said that code runs.

party.description: The leader of the party. `null` after leaving a party (node/server_functions.js:3608, 3618, 3633): `player_to_client` copies any value that is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905).

team.description: The team in a team event.

guild.description: The guild: the guild's short name when the account is in one (node/server.js:11732, 11820-11823), else the character record's value, which is `""` or `null`. `player_to_client` copies it whenever it is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905), so `null` arrives (seen live).

allow.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

age.description: The age of the character in days (node/server.js:11808).

cid.description: The change id. It goes up when the character changes.

stand.description: From `p.stand`: the merchant stand is open (the stand item name), or `false`.

tp.description: The character just appeared after a teleport.

slots.description: Equipped items, keyed by slot name (see Units and conventions). A trade slot (`trade1`, `trade2`, ...) of a merchant stand holds a `TradeSlotItem`: `reslot_player` builds it with `cache_item(item, 1)`, which keeps `price`, `rid` and the other trade fields.

owner.description: The user id of the owner, or `""` for a private character.

mp_reduction.description: Percent reduction of skill MP costs.

items.description: The inventory. `null` is an empty slot. A slot in an upgrade holds a `PlaceholderItem`.

gold.description: Gold.

targets.description: How many monsters target the character.

xrange.description: Range leeway in px, up to 25. Each use of it goes down; it comes back at 5 px per second (node/server.js:16240).

tax.description: The tax rate of the merchant stand, 0.01 to 0.05 by level (node/server.js:1718).

user.description: Only in the bank: the bank packs `items0` to `items47` and `gold`.

cc.description: The call cost of the socket now. The server disconnects above 200 in 4 s.

name.description: The name of the character, the same as `id` (node/server.js:4998).
The achievement: a key of `G.achievements` with a `count`.

count.description: The count now (`item.acc`). For `festive` (damage) and `gooped` (attack values) it is a sum, so it can have a fraction.

x-al-confirm.note: `name` and `needed`: the achievements of G with a `count` (abtesting 1000, firehazard 20000, stomped 1200, gooped 60000000 with `rr` 40000, festive 400000); `reflector` (node/server.js:3797-3800) is not in G, so it returns early.

name.description: The achievement. Each name except `"unlucky"` is a key of `G.achievements`.

x.description: The position of the target at the start.

y.description: The position of the target at the start.

eta.description: Milliseconds until the hit: `floor(1000 * distance / G.projectiles[projectile].speed)`. Always present: the object starts with `eta: 0` (node/server.js:3546-3556), and an instant projectile keeps `0` and gets `instant: true` (node/server.js:3582-3586).

m.description: The map-change counter of the target.

pid.description: The projectile id, 6 random characters. The later `hit` carries it.

projectile.description: A key of `G.projectiles`. Always present: `commence_attack` reads `G.projectiles[def.projectile].speed` (node/server.js:3582-3583), which throws when it is `null`, so every sent `action` has one (node/server.js:3564-3565).

instant.description: The projectile has no travel time.

damage.description: The damage before the defenses of the target. Absent for a heal and for 0 damage.

heal.description: The heal amount, for a heal.

positive.description: The action helps the target (a heal or a buff).

conditions.description: Conditions that the hit can apply, for example `"poisoned"`, `"frozen"`.

origin_offset.description: Cavalry volleys only: the side offset of this shot in px, `-16` or `16` (`npc.volley_offset`, node/logic/cavalry.js:484; `0` is not sent, node/server.js:3562).

response.description: `commence_attack` adds it after it sends `action` to clients nearby, for the `game_response` to the attacker (node/server.js:3609). The server keeps the same object, so a reflected `action` also has it.

place.description: The same as `type`. Added with `response` (node/server.js:3610); a reflected `action` also has it.

map.description: The map of the attacker when the projectile hits. The server sets it at the hit (node/server.js:3733), so only a reflected `action` has it.

in.description: The instance of the attacker when the projectile hits (node/server.js:3734). Only a reflected `action` has it.

reflect.description: Only on a reflected `action`: the damage of the reflection, `ceil(attack * (0.9 to 1.1))`. The target reflected a magical attack (`reflection`), so `attacker` and `target` change places, `pid` is new, `x`, `y` and `m` are of the old attacker. `eta` keeps the value of the first action: the server does not change it (node/server.js:3775-3809).

x-al-confirm.note: Every sender calls `commence_attack`, which builds the object; a reflection re-sends the same object (`info.action`) changed in place

allow.description: The `arena` instance lets players in (`instances.arena.allow`). Absent otherwise.

oneOf.title: Snapshot
oneOf.description: `cave_publish`: to each character of the run. `"choice"` when a vote opens, `"result"` when a vote ends, `"returned"` to a member who comes back after a disconnect, else `"state"`. The run loop also publishes when 1 s has passed since the last publish. The `talk` interaction also sends `"choice"` to the requester only.

oneOf.title: Cue
oneOf.description: An actor of the cave speaks or warns (a boss phase, a nest, a betrayal, a decoy). To each character of the run on the map of the actor.

oneOf.title: Chat
oneOf.description: The `talk` interaction with a traveler (a room of kind `citizen`). To the requester only.

oneOf.title: Ended
oneOf.description: You leave the run: `leave`, the `exit` interaction, or the end of the run. To the character that leaves, before the server moves it to `main`.

x-al-confirm.note: Every form carries `cave_snapshot(run, player)`; `cave_players` keeps members that did not leave, are online and stand on a floor of the run

calls.description: `socket.calls`: the calls of the last 4 s, oldest first. The sum of the costs is the call cost now (node/server_functions.js:5354-5361).

climit.description: `limits.calls`, 200 (node/server.js:257). Caution: a socket without a character has a limit of 50, not this value (node/server.js:4905-4906).

total.description: `socket.total_calls`: the number of events that this socket sent since it connected.

anyOf.title: Player chat
anyOf.description: A character sent `say` without `name` and without `party`, or a player used the public chat of the web Communicator.

anyOf.title: NPC or monster line
anyOf.description: A localized line: Ace in the arena (a kill), the Grinch, or the mainframe alert in cyberland.

anyOf.title: Mainframe reply
anyOf.description: The reply of the mainframe to an `eval` with `command`, in cyberland. `message` is plain text; there is no `phrase`.

anyOf.title: Solo
anyOf.description: The opener has no party, or the chest is a reserved encouragement chest (`chest.character`). The server deletes `items` when it is empty (node/server.js:11388-11390).

x-al-confirm.note: Encouragement items of the opener are pushed into the same `r` before `items` is deleted when empty

anyOf.title: Party
anyOf.description: The opener has a party. Each member gets the same object, with `gold` set to the share of that member. `items` stays, also when it is empty.

x-al-confirm.note: One object `r` for the whole party; `r.gold` is set to each member's share just before each emit

anyOf.title: Contributor
anyOf.description: A character that helped kill the monster (encouragement) is not a looter of this chest, and it got gold, items or shells. `items` is absent when empty.

x-al-confirm.note: `goldm` is copied from the opener's `r`, so it is not always 1

anyOf.title: Cave
anyOf.description: A cave chest (`chest.cave`). The gold and amber go to the purse of the run, not to a character.

anyOf.title: Gone
anyOf.description: No chest has this `id` (another character opened it, or it never existed).

x-al-confirm.note: The five emits of `chest_opened`; each variant cites the lines that build it

oneOf.title: Repair
oneOf.description: Patch (`citizen18`) reaches an idle `mechagnome` and repairs it.

oneOf.title: Lamp
oneOf.description: Wick (`citizen20`) lights a lamp at a stop of the route.

oneOf.title: Route marks
oneOf.description: Rook (`citizen17`) in `desertland` marks the way, after `interaction` with `type: "citizen_route"`.

oneOf.title: Dealer: shuffle
oneOf.description: Venn, the poker dealer in the `tavern`, shuffles the cards.

oneOf.title: Dealer: say
oneOf.description: Venn says a line: while he waits (`idle`, `invite`), or for a hand (`deal`, `allin`, `win`, `split`).

oneOf.title: Dealer: mock
oneOf.description: Venn deals to the empty seats as a joke.

oneOf.title: Dealer: flourish
oneOf.description: Venn shows a card.

oneOf.title: Dealer: emote
oneOf.description: Venn dances.

name.description: The name of the sender.

message.description: The `message` of the request, unchanged: any JSON value. A falsy value (absent, `null`, `0`, `false`, `""`) becomes `""` (node/server.js:5086).

x-al-confirm.note: The socket wrapper turns a missing payload into `{}`.

x.description: The position of the character on the server.

y.description: The position of the character on the server.

luckm.description: The luck multiplier of the character that the monster targeted, or 1 when it had no target.

points.description: Only for a cooperative monster: the contribution points, keyed by character name (node/server.js:13315).

x-al-confirm.note: `id` is `++total_monsters + ""` (node/server.js:13417); `points` is set for every monster (node/server.js:13558) but sent only for a cooperative one

oneOf.title: Roll
oneOf.description: The round of bets ended after 30 s. The server takes no more bets. The roll shows for 10 s.

oneOf.title: Lock
oneOf.description: 10 s after `roll`: the server settles the bets and shows the result and the key. The `tavern` results follow 1.6 s later.

oneOf.title: Bets
oneOf.description: 2 s after the results: a new round of bets starts, with the commitment of its number.

anyOf.title: Outside
anyOf.description: The entity left the vision box of the receiver, died or became invisible. Also before each `type: "all"` `entities` frame, for each entity that is not in the new frame.

anyOf.title: Transport
anyOf.description: A character or an NPC moved to another place (`transport_player_to`, `transport_npc_to`).

anyOf.title: Magiport
anyOf.description: A monster moved to another place (`transport_monster_to`): a monster skill, an event monster or a cave actor.

anyOf.title: Invisible
anyOf.description: A rogue used `invis`.

anyOf.title: Disconnect or left
anyOf.description: `"disconnect"`: a character disconnected. `"left"`: an event NPC (the anniversary baker) left; the server sends it to every player in the instance (`instance_emit`).

anyOf.title: Not there
anyOf.description: The target of a `skill` (or `attack`, `heal`) does not exist, is invisible or is too far. Only to your socket, instead of a `game_response`.

anyOf.title: Removal
anyOf.description: `remove_monster` with `method: "disappear"` (an event monster expired, a summoned monster, an irregular monster that the server moves) or with `silent` (the instance closed). Same fields as `death`.

anyOf.title: Bare
anyOf.description: A pet that `whistle` calls, or an event monster (Slenderman, the tiger) that the server moves to another map. No `reason`.

x-al-confirm.note: Every emit of `disappear` is listed in `senders`; each variant cites the lines that build its object. `remove_entity_emit` sends the object unchanged

anyOf.title: Helper
anyOf.description: The `disappearing_text` helper: almost all call sites.

x-al-confirm.note: A localized text comes from `localization.message` (`message`, `phrase`, `phrase_args`); a plain text is `{message: text}`

anyOf.title: Direct
anyOf.description: Direct emits for rewards to one character: PvP gold and XP, chest gold, marketing XP, the hardcore gold of the `woffice` map.

x-al-confirm.note: The helper's four emits plus every direct emit; no other code emits `disappearing_text`

anyOf.title: Call cost
anyOf.description: The call cost of the socket went above its limit. `limitdcreport` comes first.

anyOf.title: Limits at login
anyOf.description: `auth`: `is_player_allowed` returns false for the character.

anyOf.title: Limits from the web server
anyOf.description: `enforce_limitations` on the web server: too many characters for one IP address or one account. A merchant counts on its own.

anyOf.title: Blocked
anyOf.description: `block_account` on the web server: an admin blocks the account. Each character of the account gets it.

anyOf.title: Loose connections
anyOf.description: A new socket connects and more than 5 sockets without a character, the new one included, have the same IP address. Each older socket without a character gets this text.
examples: Too many loose connections from your network. Simply reload to play.

x-al-confirm.note: `is_socket_allowed` counts the new socket too: it is in `sockets` already.

anyOf.title: Shutdown
anyOf.description: An admin sends `shutdown` with a `reason`. The text is that reason. The server stops 10 s later.

x-al-confirm.note: `data.reason` is not checked: any truthy JSON value from the admin is sent as is.

anyOf.title: Check-in (dead code)
anyOf.description: Never: the code is inside an `if (0 && ...)` block.
examples: Failed to check in. Your network might be too slow.

x-al-confirm.note: Every emit passes a string literal except `shutdown`, which passes `data.reason` with no type check.

id.description: The chest id: 30 random characters (`randomStr(30)`). Send it with `open_chest`.

x.description: The x position of the chest.

y.description: The y position of the chest. A PvP chest is 10 below the dead character.

chest.description: The sprite of the chest. `drop_something`: `"chest3"`, `"chest4"` (gold x10), `"chest5"` (gold x50) or `"chest6"` (items). `"chest8"`: PvP or hardcore loot. `"chestp"`: an `essenceoflife`. `"cavechest"`: a cave chest. Default `"chest1"`.

items.description: The number of item stacks in the chest. A PvP chest counts its PvP items (`pvp_items`).

owners.description: The account ids (`owner`) that can open the chest: one per account in the party. Absent only on a cave chest that a run member did not make (`cave_send_chest`).

party.description: The party name (the name of the leader). Only on a party chest.

x-al-confirm.note: Every emit of `drop` builds the object literally; only the cave form has no `owners`

event.description: Always `"chellenge"`. The server spells it this way.

name.description: The character that sent the challenge.
The emote: `G.skills[skill].emote`. In G it is the same as the skill name, for example `"wiggle"`.

player.description: The character that used the emote.

target.description: The target character. Absent when the emote has no target (node/server.js:10079).

variation.description: A random variation of the animation.

x-al-confirm.note: `target` is `target && target.name`; `target` is a player or undefined (node/server.js:9898-9922; the emote skills in G target `player`), so the key is absent, never null

type.description: `"all"`: a full snapshot of everything in view (`send_all_xy`); `send_updates`, `loaded`, `new_map` and `start` carry this form. `"xy"`: the entities that changed in this tick of the instance (`send_xy_updates`).

players.description: Characters and NPCs in view, from `player_to_client(p, 1)`: the stranger form of `Character` (no inventory, gold or detailed stats). Dead and invisible characters are not in the list.

monsters.description: Monsters in view, from `monster_to_client`. Dead and invisible monsters are not in the list.

xy.description: Only when `mode.xyinf` is on and the receiver moves. The default is off (node/server.js:274), so the live server does not send it (node/server.js:13750, node/server_functions.js:3705).

x-al-confirm.note: `"all"` frames are built by `send_all_xy`; `"xy"` frames are a raw JSON string (`RawFrame`) with the same keys, from entries that `monster_to_client` / `player_to_client(p, 1)` built

oneOf.title: Object
oneOf.description: UI timers for one character, and the shutdown countdown. Also a hitchhiker in `player` at login.

oneOf.title: Bare string
oneOf.description: Visual effects at a point: `throw` of an item, `temporalsurge`, the end of a duel. The string is the code.

x-al-confirm.note: Sent with `xy_emit` to the clients near the point.

oneOf.title: Request
oneOf.description: Another character sent `friend` with `event: "request"` and your name.

oneOf.title: New friend
oneOf.description: A character accepted a friend request (`friend` with `event: "accept"`). Each online character of both accounts gets it, with the list of its own account.

x-al-confirm.note: `name` is `R.e2.name` / `R.e1.name`: the account name of the other side

oneOf.title: Lost friend
oneOf.description: A character of one of the two accounts sent `friend` with `event: "unfriend"`. Each online character of both accounts gets it.

anyOf.title: Mute feedback
anyOf.description: A GM sent `gm` with `action: "mute"`. `server.game_chat.muted` or `server.game_chat.unmuted`, with `target`.

anyOf.title: Joined the duel
anyOf.description: A character entered a duel (`duel` with `event: "enter"`). `server.game_chat.joined_the_duel`, with `player`.

anyOf.title: Duel winner
anyOf.description: A duel ended. `server.duel.winner`, with `winner`, and `color`.

anyOf.title: Duel defeat
anyOf.description: A duel ended. The characters near the winning duel player get `server.duel.defeated`, with `winner` and `loser`, and `color`.

anyOf.title: Exception
anyOf.description: A handler threw an exception (the socket wrapper adds 16 to the call cost), or the login of `auth` failed with an exception.

anyOf.title: Server full
anyOf.description: `auth`: the server has `max_players` characters. The server checks before and after the login claim.

examples.message: Can't accept more than 200 players at this time

anyOf.title: Claim failed
anyOf.description: `auth`: the login claim of the character failed. `phrase` is `server.game_error.poker_hand_active` when `reason` is `"poker_hand_active"`, else `server.game_error.authentication_failed`.

examples.message: Your poker hand is still running on another server. Wait for it to finish, or reconnect there.

x-al-confirm.note: `tx` runs once (no `tries` argument): a thrown error that is not an `ex()` gives the reason `"exception"`.

anyOf.title: Characters not confirmed
anyOf.description: `auth`: `encouragement_login` refused the login.

examples.message: Could not confirm your other characters. Please try again.

name.description: The monster type of the boss that spawned. It is a key of `G.monsters`.

x.description: A map position for the event. Absent for `pinkgoo`, `crabxx`, `slenderman` and `wabbit`. It is the top-left corner of the spawn area, except for `snowman` and `dragold`: both always send `900, -800`.

x-al-confirm.note: `spawn_special_monster("tiger")` also sends `{name: "tiger", map}` (node/server_functions.js:2133), but its only caller is commented out (node/server_functions.js:2647), so it is not in `name`.

anyOf.title: Localized
anyOf.description: Almost all call sites: `localization.message`, `item_message` or `kill_message`.

x-al-confirm.note: Every call site adds only `color`, or `color` and `confetti` (the giveaway lines), as extra fields.

anyOf.title: Plain object
anyOf.description: Text with no phrase key: cave messages from a string (for example the stairway of a generated map).

examples.message: The stairway is opening. Stay near the landing.

x-al-confirm.note: The only string passed to `cave_say` is the stairway text of node/logic/generated_maps.js:168.

anyOf.title: Bare string
anyOf.description: `mreport` (the distance to the point, as text) and `random_look` (a fixed code string).

x-al-confirm.note: About 140 call sites. Every object comes from `localization.message`, `item_message` or `kill_message`, except `cave_say` with a string. `exchange` has a plain `{message, color}` branch (node/server_functions.js:4130-4136), but no caller passes a `phrase` that reaches it.

anyOf.title: Bare string
anyOf.description: Older handlers: `socket.emit("game_response", "code")`. The string is the code. Several handlers send an object instead when the request has `request_id`.

anyOf.title: Failure
anyOf.description: `fail_response(code, place, data)`: a request failed. `place` defaults to the event name of the request.

anyOf.title: Success
anyOf.description: `success_response(code, place, data)`: a request succeeded. With an object as the first argument, `response` is `"data"`.

anyOf.title: Other object
anyOf.description: `socket.emit` or the `game_response` helper with an object: `response` and the fields of the code only. No `place`, `failed` or `success` unless the call site adds them. Hitchhiker codes (inside `player`) have this form.

anyOf.title: Skill result
anyOf.description: `skill`, `attack` and `heal`: the result object of the skill with `response: "data"` and `place` (the skill name). A failure has `failed: true` and `reason`. A success from `commence_attack` is the `Action` and has no `success` field.

anyOf.title: Condition
anyOf.description: `add_condition` gave you a condition. Always a hitchhiker in the next `player`, and often not a reply to a request: a skill of another character, a monster, or the server itself. During the anniversary event, each eligible character online when a round's host is picked gets `anniversary_visit` with `duration: 300000` (5 min), with no request. Some conditions are set without `add_condition` (for example `penalty_cd`) and do not send this code.

x-al-confirm.note: Live: `anniversary_visit` arrived unsolicited in `player.hitchhikers` on three characters at once

anyOf.title: Condition ended
anyOf.description: A condition of yours ran out (its `ms` reached 0) in the timer loop of the instance. Sent at once, not as a hitchhiker, and never as a reply to a request. A `player` update follows. Only for a condition in `G.conditions`, but also for one that came without a `condition` code, such as `penalty_cd` (added by teleports, magiport, equips and some item operations).

x-al-confirm.note: Live: `penalty_cd` ended unsolicited after login

action.description: Always `"jump_list"`.

ids.description: The names of all characters on this game server, in the order of the `players` object.

E.description: The whole event state S. On HARDCORE it has `rewards` and `minutes` (see [rewards](#s-key-rewards) and [minutes](#s-key-minutes)).

achiever.description: The character who won a reward slot now. Absent in the update every 60 s.

rewards.!participation: Every authorized account with a level 60+ character receives a participation award!

x-al-confirm.note: On HARDCORE `init_server` replaces E with `{rewards, minutes}`, so E has no `schedule` there. `first_goo` is not in the initial `rewards` but a goo kill adds it; `first_wabbit` is in it but nothing fills it.

anyOf.title: Damage or heal
anyOf.description: The projectile reached the target. One event for each target that it hit (splash, a stack of characters on one spot).

x-al-confirm.note: One `def` per attack, changed for each target; `crit`, `aoe`, `purify`, `sneak`, `trigger`, `deepfreeze`, `lifesteal`, `manasteal`, `goldsteal`, `mobbing`, `stacked` are not reset between targets

anyOf.title: Miss
anyOf.description: The attack missed: the target disconnected or died, the `miss` of the attacker rolled, or the `avoidance` of the target rolled. Also a splash target whose `avoidance` rolled.

anyOf.title: Evade
anyOf.description: The target evaded: its `evasion` rolled. Only for physical damage (`armor` defense).

x-al-confirm.note: `defense` is armor only for physical (or no) damage type

anyOf.title: Avoid
anyOf.description: The target moved more than 72 px (108 px for a heal) from the start point, or changed maps.

anyOf.title: Reflect
anyOf.description: The target reflected a magical projectile. A new `action` follows at once, from the target to the attacker.

anyOf.title: Burn tick
anyOf.description: The `burned` condition did damage. It has no `pid`, because no projectile caused it.

x-al-confirm.note: `burned` is only added at node/server.js:4073, always with `f` and `fid`, so `hid` is always present
Every emit of `hit`; the `events.push(["hit", def])` path is off while `mode.instant_monster_attacks` is 1 (node/server.js:292)

name.description: The character that sent the invite. To accept, send `party` with `event: "accept"` and this name.

mtype.description: The monster type, a key of `G.monsters`.

name.description: The source: the name of the character that used `light`, or the id of the monster.

affected.description: Only to a rogue, or to an invisible character, nearer than 300 px: the light found you. The server removes your `invis` condition and sends you `player` (node/server_functions.js:3762-3766).

x-al-confirm.note: `xy_emit` sends `{name}` to everyone in view; the form with `affected` is built in `xy_emit` itself (node/server_functions.js:3762-3766)

calls.description: `socket.calls`: the calls of the last 4 s, oldest first, with the call that went above the limit.

climit.description: The limit that the socket went above. After a normal call: 200 with a character, 50 without one (node/server.js:4905). After a handler error: always 200.

total.description: `socket.total_calls`: the number of events that this socket sent since it connected.

method.description: Only after a handler error: the event name, up to 200 characters. A handler error adds a cost of 16 (node/server.js:4950).

name.description: The mage that offers the magiport. To accept, send `magiport` with this name.

run.description: The key of the cave run: 24 hexadecimal characters.

index.description: The number of this part, from 0. Parts arrive in order.

count.description: The number of parts. The official client accepts 1 to 1,400 (js/generated_zones.js:9-10).

text.description: Up to 12,000 characters of the JSON text of a `MapChunkBundle`.

x-al-confirm.note: Nothing is sent when `map_protocol` in the handshake query is not 1: `send_generated_maps` throws `client_update_required` (node/logic/generated_maps.js:186).

seconds.description: Seconds until the fight starts: 60 at the start (20 on a Dev server), 1 less on each pass of the event loop, then 0.

active.description: `false` during the countdown. `true` when the fight started.

A.description: Team A: the challenger and the challenger's party members that entered.

B.description: Team B: the challenged character and that character's party members that entered.

id.description: The duel instance: a random 20-character name (`randomStr(20)`, node/server.js:12234).

x-al-confirm.note: `instance_emit` reaches the players of the instance only, not its observers (on HARDCORE it is `broadcast`).

id.description: The receipt id. The same as `receipt.id`.

receipt.description: The receipt of the gift. The character also gets it as `last` in the next `merrit_status`.

receipt.name: Merchant
receipt.reason: Your shop stayed stocked for two minutes and left the neighbors room.

anyOf.title: Status
anyOf.description: The Merrit loop, every 15 s while your stand is open; and after a gift. `reasons` is empty when a visit can come.

anyOf.title: Info
anyOf.description: The reply to `interaction` with `type: "merrit_info"`. It adds `account_last`. The server ignores a second request within 3 s.

account_last.name: Merchant
account_last.reason: Your shop stayed stocked for two minutes and left the neighbors room.

anyOf.title: Stand
anyOf.description: The `merchant` handler opened or closed the stand, or changed the item. It adds `stand_opened`.

anyOf.title: Unreachable
anyOf.description: Merrit chose you but found no path to your stand. `reasons` is only `[{code: "unreachable"}]`; `next_at`, `last` and `server_now` are of the real status (you qualified, so `next_at` is usually in the past). The next try comes after 30 s.

anyOf.title: Error
anyOf.description: The reply to `merrit_info` when the read of the account fails.

name.description: The map of the destination.

x.description: The new position. A spawn with a scatter value adds a random offset.

direction.description: The facing direction, 0 to 3. From a point (`point[2] || 0`, always present) or from a spawn (`spawns[s][2]`); absent only when the spawn has no direction (101 of 154 spawns in G) (node/server.js:4686-4697). Observers always get `0`.

effect.description: The effect to draw. `0`: none. `1`: a teleport (town, respawn, cave doors). `"blink"` and `"magiport"`: those skills (node/server.js:14698, 14717). No other caller of `transport_player_to` passes another value.

info.description: `instance.info` of the destination, for example the state of an event map. `{}` for most instances (node/server_functions.js:1901).

m.description: The new map-change counter (`player.m`). Send it with each `move`. Observers get `0`.

entities.description: A `type: "all"` frame of the entities in view at the new position.

x-al-confirm.note: The two emits are the only senders. The player form also lists `eval: EV`, but `EV` is only assigned in a dead `if (0 && ...)` block, so it is `undefined` and never sent

message.description: The English text. From the admin `notice` handler: the `message` of the request, with no check of its type.

phrase.description: The phrase key. Absent on an admin notice.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase. Absent on an admin notice.

x-al-confirm.note: `broadcast` sets `color: "orange"` on the object only after the emit (node/server_functions.js:3502-3504), so clients never get it.

group.description: The group that the camera shows: `"party:<leader>"`, `"solo:<name>"`, `"town:<map>"`, or `null` when there is no group.

party.description: The members of the group, up to 10, keyed by name. It is `{}` for a town group or no group.

focus.description: The members in the camera frame. Each is in the instance of the anchor character, 230 px or less in `x` and 125 px or less in `y` from it.

map.description: The map of the camera: the map of the anchor character, or the town map.

x.description: The camera position: the center of the `focus` characters, or the town point when `focus` is empty.

online.description: The characters online on this server, without NPCs and disconnected characters.

remaining_ms.description: The time until the camera can change group. The group changes at each 30 s boundary of the server clock.

kind.description: `"group"`: the camera follows a character. `"town"`: the town square shot. `"waiting"`: there is nothing to show.

available.description: `false` only when `kind` is `"waiting"`. Then the camera does not move.

town_players.description: The living characters in the town square shot. The town shot needs 6 or more.

x-al-confirm.note: `remaining_ms` comes from `performance.now()`, so it usually has a fraction. `x`/`y` is the center of the box around the `focus` characters.

name.description: The character of a friend that logged in.

server.description: The server of that character: the region and the server name, for example `"EU I"` or `"US PVP"`.

x-al-confirm.note: `server` is `server_regions[region] + " " + server_name`

anyOf.title: State
anyOf.description: `send_party_update`: every 60 s, and after a member dies, respawns or gets a `revival`. Also the reply to a `party` `kick` of a name that is not in the party.

anyOf.title: Joined
anyOf.description: A `party` `accept` or `raccept` added a member. Each member gets it, the new member too.

anyOf.title: Left
anyOf.description: A member left the party, the leader kicked a member, or a member disconnected. Each other member gets it. With fewer than 2 members left, `list` is `false` and `party` is `{}`: the party is gone.

anyOf.title: None
anyOf.description: You are not in a party now: you left, the leader kicked you, or you joined another party.

message.description: The text, at most 1,200 characters. The server removes some characters first (`strip_string`).

id.description: The id of the sender: the character name.

x-al-confirm.note: `message` is `strip_string(data.message).substr(0, 1200)`; `party_emit` sends the same object to every member

id.description: The `id` that `ping_trig` sent. The official client sends a random string of 5 characters (js/functions.js:230-235).

ui.description: The `ui` that `ping_trig` sent. The official client sends `true` when it shows the ping in the log.

x-al-confirm.note: The request is echoed as is, so a request that is not an object comes back as that value; a missing one comes back as `{}`.

xp.description: Experience in this level. Can be fractional: XP gains are not rounded, for example a merchant gets `tax * 3.2` per sale (node/server_functions.js:750); seen live as `106466429.2`.

level.description: The level.

m.description: The map-change counter. `move` must send this value.

abs.description: The position is absolute (after a teleport).

angle.description: Set by cave logic on actors. Not set for a normal character.

position_id.description: Set for NPC characters. Not set for a normal character.

motion.description: Set for NPC characters with a scripted motion; `age` is its age in ms (node/server.js:857-858).

c.description: Channeled actions (for example `town`, `fishing`), keyed by name. Each has `ms`, the time left.

q.description: `player.q`: the timers of `upgrade`, `compound` and `exchange`, and the spins of the tavern `wheel` and `slots`, keyed by that name (node/server.js:6669, 7051, 7438; node/logic/tavern_wheel.js:27, node/logic/tavern_slots.js:54).

b.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

rip.description: The character is dead. A gravestone cosmetic replaces `true` with its name (node/server.js:915-917). `false` after a revive or a state restore (node/server.js:1122, 6292, 15108); `null` is seen live on characters whose stored record holds it.

afk.description: `"code"` when the character logged in with `no_html` (a code client).

controller.description: Only when `afk` is `"code"`: the character whose code controls this one, or `""`.

code.description: The last `code` event said that code runs.

party.description: The leader of the party. `null` after leaving a party (node/server_functions.js:3608, 3618, 3633): `player_to_client` copies any value that is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905).

team.description: The team in a team event.

guild.description: The guild: the guild's short name when the account is in one (node/server.js:11732, 11820-11823), else the character record's value, which is `""` or `null`. `player_to_client` copies it whenever it is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905), so `null` arrives (seen live).

allow.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

age.description: The age of the character in days (node/server.js:11808).

cid.description: The change id. It goes up when the character changes.

stand.description: From `p.stand`: the merchant stand is open (the stand item name), or `false`.

tp.description: The character just appeared after a teleport.

slots.description: Equipped items, keyed by slot name (see Units and conventions). A trade slot (`trade1`, `trade2`, ...) of a merchant stand holds a `TradeSlotItem`: `reslot_player` builds it with `cache_item(item, 1)`, which keeps `price`, `rid` and the other trade fields.

owner.description: The user id of the owner, or `""` for a private character.

mp_reduction.description: Percent reduction of skill MP costs.

items.description: The inventory. `null` is an empty slot. A slot in an upgrade holds a `PlaceholderItem`.

gold.description: Gold.

targets.description: How many monsters target the character.

xrange.description: Range leeway in px, up to 25. Each use of it goes down; it comes back at 5 px per second (node/server.js:16240).

tax.description: The tax rate of the merchant stand, 0.01 to 0.05 by level (node/server.js:1718).

user.description: Only in the bank: the bank packs `items0` to `items47` and `gold`.

cc.description: The call cost of the socket now. The server disconnects above 200 in 4 s.

reopen.description: Only from `resend` with `reopen`: items, gold or slots changed, so open windows must refresh.

hitchhikers.description: Only from `resend`: events that waited for this update, in order. Handle each `[event, payload]` as if the server sent it now. The list is not sent again. Not all of them answer a request: a `game_response` `condition` from `add_condition` can come at any time (a skill of another character, a monster, the anniversary event).

x-al-confirm.note: Every sender uses `player_to_client`; its keys are the fields of `Character` (`name` and `direction` are for NPCs only)

anyOf.title: Player list
anyOf.description: On a server that is not PvP. It leaves out characters in PvP areas (`is_in_pvp`).

anyOf.title: PvP server
anyOf.description: On a PvP server. It has every character, but hides `name`, `map` and the party name, and adds `kills`.

x-al-confirm.note: `kills` is set to 0 at login, so it is always present here.

anyOf.title: Pets
anyOf.description: The values of `player.p.pets`. No code in `node/` writes `p.pets`, so the list is empty, except for old saved data.

x-al-confirm.note: The items are whatever old saved data has in `player.p.pets` (`object`): no code in `node/` writes it, so the list is `[]` for any character created now.

Two handlers send it: `players` (one of two entry forms, by `is_pvp`) and `pets` (the raw values of `player.p.pets`). A third `emit("players")` with no payload is dead code (`if (0 && ...)`, node/server.js:4862-4866).

anyOf.title: To the recipient
anyOf.description: The recipient is on the same server as the sender.

anyOf.title: From another server
anyOf.description: The recipient is on another server. That server runs the emit through `server_eval_direct`. `id` is the name of the sender.

anyOf.title: Copy to the sender
anyOf.description: Always first, before the server looks for the recipient. `xserver` is `true` when the recipient is not on this server.

anyOf.title: Delivery failed
anyOf.description: No character has the name `to`. The sender gets it after its copy.

name.description: The `name` of the request, unchanged. The server does not check it, so it can be any value, also a name that is not in view. Absent when the request has no `name` (the value is `undefined`, which JSON leaves out).

level.description: The strength, from the level of the `poker` gloves: 1 below +8, 2 at +8, 3 at +9, 4 at +10 and more.

oneOf.title: State
oneOf.description: The public state of the table, after each change: a seat, an action, a street, the time bank, the end of a hand.

x-al-confirm.note: `tavern_poker_emit` uses `instance_emit`, which broadcasts to the whole server on a hardcore server (`poker` is not one of its exceptions).

oneOf.title: Cards
oneOf.description: Your two hole cards: at the deal, and again with `tavern_poker_send` while you are in a hand.

code.description: A copy of `code` from the request (`data && data.code`). Absent when the request has no `code`, `null` when the request data is `null`.

list.description: Up to 200 PvP kills on this server since it started, newest first.

q.description: All timers of the character (`player.q`), not only the one that changed. The loop lowers `ms` one timer at a time (node/server.js:14735-14738), so the `ms` of this timer and of the timers before it in `q` is lower by this tick, and the `ms` of the timers after it is not yet.

num.description: The slot of the placeholder: `num` of the timer. It is the slot value from the `upgrade` or `compound` request with no conversion, so it can be a numeric string.

p.description: The `p` of the placeholder item in that slot (node/server.js:14741). The server changes this same object on each tick: it adds one digit to `nums`, or sets `success` or `failure`.

change.description: A text from the admin that describes the change, for example `"cx"`. It is `""` when the admin gives none.

x-al-confirm.note: `change` is whatever the admin passes (`change || ""`), not checked.

name.description: The character that asks to join your party. To accept, send `party` with `event: "raccept"` and this name.

x-al-confirm.note: Every sender is `broadcast_e()`, which sends the object `E` itself. The keys are confirmed with the type `ServerInfoState`.

phrase.description: The key of the phrase in the language files.

phrase_args.description: The values for the phrase; `{}` when there are none. `localization.message` always sets it (`parameters || {}`, languages/index.js:256-258), and so does the cavalry reply (node/logic/cavalry.js:237-239).

color.description: A CSS color, or `G.monsters[type].announce` for a boss. That is `true`, not a color, for `icegolem` in the current G (node/server.js:13627, 13633).

type.description: The kind of an item or gold announcement: found, received, gold from a chest, upgrade success or failure, compound success or failure.

name.description: With `type`: the character of the announcement.

item.description: With an item `type`: the item, as `cache_item` gives it.

shells.description: Only with `type: "server_found"` from `add_shells`: the shells found (node/server.js:4824).

event.description: An event message: an event item, or the call to fight a cooperative boss. The server does not copy it to Discord.

discord.description: Only on a boss spawn: the format of the Discord copy (node/server.js:13627). `broadcast` also knows `"red"`; no call site sends it.

nod.description: Only on the shutdown countdown: no Discord copy (node/server.js:16974).

log.description: Only on the shutdown countdown. The server does not read it; the meaning is unclear from the source.

sname.description: Only from `realm_broadcast`: the origin server, `region + " " + server_name`, for example `"EU I"` (node/server_functions.js:3490).

x-al-confirm.note: `realm_broadcast` sends the object through `JSON.stringify` to every server, which calls `broadcast`. `broadcast` adds ` [<sname>]` to `message` only after the emit (node/server_functions.js:3499-3501), so clients get the plain text. `add_item` has a plain branch with no phrase (`item_notice`) for a `phrase` other than Fished, Mined or Glitched; no caller passes one.

oneOf.title: Window
oneOf.description: The admin code set `window`.

examples.code: for(var id in data.window) window[id]=data.window[id]; eval(data.after);

oneOf.title: JSON
oneOf.description: The admin code set `json_output` and not `window`.

oneOf.title: Modal
oneOf.description: The admin code set neither, or it threw: `output` is `"Exception: <error>"`.

name.description: The skill. For a skill with `share` in G, the skill that it shares the cooldown with, for example `"quickpunch"` for `quickstab`, or `"use_hp"` for `regen_hp` (node/server_functions.js:3452-3455).

ms.description: The time until the skill is ready. From `consume_skill`, it includes `penalty`. The `attack_ms` form can be 0 or less: then the skill is ready now.

penalty.description: Only from `consume_skill`: the part of `ms` that comes from the `penalty_cd` condition, up to 10,000. Often `0`.

reason.description: Only when the attack speed changed: `ms` is `attack_ms - (time since the last attack)` (node/server.js:1630-1634).

x-al-confirm.note: From node/logic/instance_pause.js the cooldown of `attack` is `1000 / frequency`, so `ms` can have a fraction.

xp.description: Experience in this level. Can be fractional: XP gains are not rounded, for example a merchant gets `tax * 3.2` per sale (node/server_functions.js:750); seen live as `106466429.2`.

level.description: The level.

m.description: The map-change counter. `move` must send this value.

abs.description: The position is absolute (after a teleport).

angle.description: Set by cave logic on actors. Not set for a normal character.

position_id.description: Set for NPC characters. Not set for a normal character.

motion.description: Set for NPC characters with a scripted motion; `age` is its age in ms (node/server.js:857-858).

c.description: Channeled actions (for example `town`, `fishing`), keyed by name. Each has `ms`, the time left.

q.description: `player.q`: the timers of `upgrade`, `compound` and `exchange`, and the spins of the tavern `wheel` and `slots`, keyed by that name (node/server.js:6669, 7051, 7438; node/logic/tavern_wheel.js:27, node/logic/tavern_slots.js:54).

b.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

rip.description: The character is dead. A gravestone cosmetic replaces `true` with its name (node/server.js:915-917). `false` after a revive or a state restore (node/server.js:1122, 6292, 15108); `null` is seen live on characters whose stored record holds it.

afk.description: `"code"` when the character logged in with `no_html` (a code client).

controller.description: Only when `afk` is `"code"`: the character whose code controls this one, or `""`.

party.description: The leader of the party. `null` after leaving a party (node/server_functions.js:3608, 3618, 3633): `player_to_client` copies any value that is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905).

team.description: The team in a team event.

guild.description: The guild: the guild's short name when the account is in one (node/server.js:11732, 11820-11823), else the character record's value, which is `""` or `null`. `player_to_client` copies it whenever it is not `undefined` (node/server.js:899-905), so `null` arrives (seen live).

allow.description: Unclear from the source; no handler sets it on a character.

age.description: The age of the character in days (node/server.js:11808).

cid.description: The change id. It goes up when the character changes.

stand.description: From `p.stand`: the merchant stand is open (the stand item name), or `false`.

tp.description: The character just appeared after a teleport.

slots.description: Equipped items, keyed by slot name (see Units and conventions). A trade slot (`trade1`, `trade2`, ...) of a merchant stand holds a `TradeSlotItem`: `reslot_player` builds it with `cache_item(item, 1)`, which keeps `price`, `rid` and the other trade fields.

owner.description: The user id of the owner, or `""` for a private character.

mp_reduction.description: Percent reduction of skill MP costs.

items.description: The inventory. `null` is an empty slot. A slot in an upgrade holds a `PlaceholderItem`.

gold.description: Gold.

targets.description: How many monsters target the character.

xrange.description: Range leeway in px, up to 25. Each use of it goes down; it comes back at 5 px per second (node/server.js:16240).

tax.description: The tax rate of the merchant stand, 0.01 to 0.05 by level (node/server.js:1718).

user.description: Only in the bank: the bank packs `items0` to `items47` and `gold`.

cc.description: The call cost of the socket now. The server disconnects above 200 in 4 s.

ipass.description: A random string of 12 characters. The HTTP check-in of the official client sends it back.

home.description: The home server of the character, `player.p.home`: region plus server name, for example `"EUI"`.

friends.description: The friend list of the account: the user ids of the friends (node/server.js:11632).

acx.description: The cosmetics that the account owns: cosmetic name to count.

xcx.description: A list of cosmetic names. The server only sets it to `[]` (node/server_functions.js:4448). The official client adds the free cosmetics of the class.

info.description: `instance.info` of the instance of the character. Usually `{}`. A duel instance has `{seconds, active, A, B, id}` (node/server.js:12238-12246). The `tavern` has `{dice, num, seconds}`. A dream cave floor has `{zone}` (see Notes).

base_gold.description: `D.base_gold`: monster type to map name to the base gold of one kill (node/server_functions.js:231-232).

s_info.description: The server event state `E`, the same object as the `server_info` payload.

blessed_by.description: Only while the server has a blessing: the character that paid for it.

blessed_minutes.description: Only while the server has a blessing: the minutes that remain.

code.description: When `auth` loaded code from a code slot: the source code text. It replaces the `code` flag of `player_to_client` (node/server.js:11937-11941). Otherwise it is that flag.

code_slot.description: Only with the code text: the code slot that the server found for `auth.code_slot`, as a string.

code_version.description: Only with the code text: the save count of that code slot.

entities.description: An `entities` payload with `type: "all"` for the start position (`send_all_xy(player, {raw: true})`).

status.description: `"persisted_steam_id"`: the account or character already had a Steam id, and the server did not check the ticket. `"steam_ticket_verified"`: Steam accepted the ticket.

pid.description: The Steam id: 16 to 20 digits as a string (node/server_functions.js:873-877; adventure_functions.js:35 for a ticket).

reason.description: `"steam_auth_failed"`: Steam did not accept the ticket, or the check had an error. `"steam_link_failed"`: the server could not save the Steam id to the account and the character.

stage.description: The step that failed. `steam_auth_failed` always has `"verify_ticket"`. `steam_link_failed` has `"persist_saved_id"` (a Steam id that the account had) or `"persist_verified_ticket"` (a new Steam id from the ticket).

anyOf.title: Info
anyOf.description: The reply to `tavern` with `event: "info"` and no `request_id`. With `request_id`, the same fields come in `game_response` `data`.

anyOf.title: Dice bet
anyOf.description: A character placed a dice bet.

anyOf.title: Dice won
anyOf.description: The dice round ended and the bet won. `gold` is the gross win (`bet.win`), not the stake.

anyOf.title: Dice lost
anyOf.description: The dice round ended and the bet lost. `gold` is the stake. There is no `net`.

anyOf.title: Slots
anyOf.description: The slots timer (`q.slots`) ended. `event` is `"won"` or `"lost"`. Not sent when a disconnect settles the spin.

anyOf.title: Wheel
anyOf.description: The wheel timer (`q.wheel`) ended. `event` is `"won"` or `"lost"`. Not sent when a disconnect settles the spin.

anyOf.title: Refund
anyOf.description: The shutdown of the server started (`tavern_close`), and the tavern returned an open wager. Wheel: `index`. Slots: `symbols`. Dice: neither, and `gold` is the total of all dice bets of the character.

anyOf.title: Roulette bet
anyOf.description: Dev servers only: the reply to a `bet` with `type: "roulette"`. The payload is the bet object itself, with no `event`.

date.description: The time of the server now: a `Date`, which arrives as an ISO 8601 string in UTC.

monsters.description: Monster type to the kills of this character (`player.p.stats.monsters`).

monsters_diff.description: Monster type to a score correction (`player.p.stats.monsters_diff`). Each kill adds `score - 1` from `calculate_monster_score` (node/server.js:2662-2714), so the value can be negative and can have a fraction. The tracker count is `monsters + monsters_diff`.

exchanges.description: Drop table name to the exchanges of this character (`player.p.stats.exchanges`). For an item with levels (upgrade or compound), the name has the level as a suffix, for example `"armorbox0"`.

maps.description: Map name to the drop table of the map (`D.drops.maps`). It also has the keys `global` and `global_static`.

tables.description: Table name to drop table: each exchange table (`G.items[name].e`), and each table that an `"open"` entry of any table in this payload names. Upgradable and compoundable items have one table for each level: `<name><level>`.

max.description: The best values of all characters of the account (`player.max_stats`).

monsters_home_server.description: Monster type to the extra drops on the home server (`D.drops.monsters_home_server`). This is a drop table, not a kill count.

drops.description: Monster type to the drop table of the monster (`D.drops.monsters`), for every monster.

global.description: The global drop table (`D.drops.maps.global`): every kill rolls it. Present when the table exists. The live `drops.js` has it.

global_static.description: The second global table (`D.drops.maps.global_static`). Present when the table exists, even when it is empty.

x-al-confirm.note: `maps`, `tables`, `drops` and the global tables are `D.drops`, from design/drops.js; every row in that file has one of the forms of `DropRow`.

oneOf.title: Name only
oneOf.description: `level_up`: the character reached a new level. `dampened`: a field generator stopped a `blink` or a magiport of the character. The others: the character used that skill (`track`, `magiport` on the safe PvE path, `alchemy`, and the merchant buffs `mcourage`, `mfrenzy`, `massproduction`, `massexchange` and their `pp` forms).

oneOf.title: Type only
oneOf.description: A priest used `darkblessing`, or a warrior used `warcry`. The payload does not tell who used it (see Notes).

oneOf.title: From one to one
oneOf.description: A character used `mluck`, `rspeed`, `reflection`, `energize`, `4fingers`, or `entangle` (also for the `tangle` skill) on a target.

oneOf.title: Throw
oneOf.description: A merchant used `throw`.

oneOf.title: Paladin support
oneOf.description: A paladin used `cleansing_light` or `guardians_oath`.

oneOf.title: Beacon of Resolve
oneOf.description: A paladin used `beacon_of_resolve` (with `from`), or a paladin cavalry NPC gave the condition (with `name`).

oneOf.title: Area skill
oneOf.description: A character used `agitate`, `stomp`, `scare`, `cleave`, `shadowstrike` or `fanofknives`. A `cave_sentinel` in the Cave of Many Dreams also sends `stomp`.

oneOf.title: Absorb
oneOf.description: A priest used `absorb` on a character.

oneOf.title: Skill on a monster
oneOf.description: A ranger used `huntersmark`, or a character used `charm`. A failed `charm` has `fail: true`.

oneOf.title: Fishing or mining fails
oneOf.description: The `skill` request for `fishing` or `mining` found no zone of that kind next to the character, or the character moves.

x-al-confirm.note: `request_id` is `data.request_id`, so JSON drops it when the request had none.

oneOf.title: Fishing or mining starts
oneOf.description: The `skill` request for `fishing` or `mining` started the timer of the skill.

oneOf.title: Fishing or mining finds nothing
oneOf.description: The timer of `fishing` or `mining` ended and the drop gave nothing. Only the socket of the character gets it.

x-al-confirm.note: Sent with `player.socket.emit`, not `xy_emit`.

oneOf.title: Merchant luck
oneOf.description: A character with the `mluck` condition looted an item from a chest. With a 2% chance, the merchant of that `mluck` got a copy.

oneOf.title: Sale to an NPC
oneOf.description: The `sell` request succeeded.

x-al-confirm.note: `id` is the `id` of the NPC in `G.maps[map].npcs` (js/old_common_functions.js:233-236).

oneOf.title: Purchase from an NPC
oneOf.description: The `buy` request succeeded.

oneOf.title: Secondhands or lost and found
oneOf.description: The `sbuy` request bought an item. `+$p`: from `secondhands`. `+$f`: from `lostandfound` (`f` in the request).

oneOf.title: Player trade
oneOf.description: `trade_sell` (you sell to a buy order) or `trade_buy` (you buy a listing) succeeded.

oneOf.title: Trade swap
oneOf.description: The `trade_swap` request succeeded.

oneOf.title: Item sent
oneOf.description: The `send` request with `num` succeeded.

oneOf.title: Gold sent
oneOf.description: The `send` request with `gold` succeeded.

oneOf.title: Cosmetic sent
oneOf.description: The `send` request with `cx` succeeded.

oneOf.title: Resist
oneOf.description: `add_condition` rolled against the resistance of the target (`G.conditions[name].defense`) and the target resisted.

x-al-confirm.note: The `type` values are the conditions with `defense` in G 17478.

oneOf.title: MP restore
oneOf.description: `consume_mp` rolled the `restore_mp` attribute of the character (for example from Mana Gloves) and won.

oneOf.title: Monster level
oneOf.description: `level_monster` ran without `silent`: the monster lived long enough, killed characters, or a monster hunt took a level away.

oneOf.title: Disengage
oneOf.description: `stop_pursuit` ran on a monster that stays in the world. A spawned monster disappears instead, unless the stop is a redirect.

x-al-confirm.note: Every `stop_pursuit` caller passes `cause` (node/server.js and node/server_functions.js: 17 calls).

oneOf.title: Monster heal
oneOf.description: A monster with `self_healing` or `healing` healed. It arrives inside the monster `events` of `entities`, not as its own socket event.

oneOf.title: Tavern slots
oneOf.description: The `bet` request with `type: "slots"` started a spin.

oneOf.title: Tavern wheel
oneOf.description: The `bet` request with `type: "wheel"` started a spin.

oneOf.title: Cave entry
oneOf.description: The start of the entry animation has `names` and `duration`. If the entry then fails, a second event has `key` and `cancel: true`.

x-al-confirm.note: Every emit of `ui` is cited on its variant (grep of `"ui"` in node/ and node/logic/); `xy_emit` sends the object unchanged.

type.description: The animation. `"exchange"` for the exchange NPC. `"poof"` for the statue in spookytown. `<token>s` (for example `"monstertokens"`) for a token exchange: always the token name plus `s`, also when the NPC has another name.

success.description: `1` for a success, `0` for a failure. Only `upgrade` and `compound` send `0`.

region.description: The region of the server, for example `"EU"`, `"US"` or `"ASIA"`.

name.description: The name of the server in its region, for example `"I"`, `"II"` or `"PVP"`.

pvp.description: `true` on a PvP server (`is_pvp`): a name that starts with `PVP` or `HARDCORE`, and the `TEST` and `DUNGEON` servers (node/server.js:367-418).

gameplay.description: The game mode of the server. The server name selects it (node/server.js:367-410).

info.description: `instance.info` of the first map. In practice it is always `{}`: the code reads `socket.first_map` before it sets it (node/server.js:4982-4985). The `start` entry lists the forms of `instance.info`.

version.description: `G.version`, the version of the game data, for example `17478`.

x.description: The start position of the camera: the observer point of the server, or the position of the matched character.

y.description: The start position of the camera. The server adds 120 to the observer point. For a matched character it adds 120 only when the query has `desktop` (node/server.js:4987, 5003-5006).

map.description: The start map of the camera: the map of the matched character, or the observer map of the server.

in.description: The start instance of the camera.

S.description: The server event state `E`, the same object as the `server_info` payload. The page "Server events" lists its keys.

character.description: Only when the `secret` query parameter matches the secret of a character on this server. A character in a generated map matches only with `map_protocol=1`.

x-al-confirm.note: `broadcast_e(true)` only reads E here; it sends nothing.

ActivateRequestEquipment.title: ActivateRequestEquipment
ActivateRequestEquipment.description: `activate`, variant Equipment: Activates an equipped item: `etherealamulet`, `angelwings`, `tristone` or `darktristone`.

slot.description: The equipment slot of the item to activate: `etherealamulet`, `angelwings`, `tristone` or `darktristone`. A trade slot (`trade1` to `trade48`) does nothing.
slot.x-al-coerce: any truthy value selects this path; then used as a key of `player.slots`

ActivateRequestInventory.title: ActivateRequestInventory
ActivateRequestInventory.description: `activate`, variant Inventory: Uses an inventory item: `frozenstone`, `bkey`, `ukey` or `dkey`.

num.description: The inventory slot: `frozenstone`, `bkey`, `ukey` or `dkey`.
num.x-al-coerce: none: used as an array key (`player.items[num]`), so a number or a numeric string; any other value is an empty slot

x-al-confirm.note: The handler reads only `slot` and, without it, `num`

ActivateEthereal.title: ActivateEthereal
ActivateEthereal.description: `activate` reply (Ethereal): `etherealamulet`: you get the `ethereal` condition for 5,000 ms. A `player` update (not `reopen`) follows.

code.description: JavaScript for the official client: it shows the cooldown.

ActivateDoorUnlocked.title: ActivateDoorUnlocked
ActivateDoorUnlocked.description: `activate` reply (Door unlocked): `bkey` (unlocks `bank_b` and creates pack `items8`) or `ukey` (unlocks `bank_u` and creates pack `items24`). The server uses one key. The `player` update follows.

ActivatePackUnlocked.title: ActivatePackUnlocked
ActivatePackUnlocked.description: `activate` reply (Pack unlocked): `dkey`: the server unlocks the first bank pack (`items0` to `items47`) that you do not have, and uses one key. The `player` update follows.

ActivateFailure.title: ActivateFailure
ActivateFailure.description: `activate`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

AttackRequest.title: AttackRequest

id.description: The target: a monster id or a character name. A missing id, or your own name, fails with `no_target`.

AttackRequest.x-al-others: ignored: the handler calls `skill` with `{name: "attack", id}` only

x-al-confirm.note: The handler passes only `id` on to `skill`

AttackSuccess.title: AttackSuccess
AttackSuccess.description: `attack` reply (Success): All checks pass and the projectile starts. The object is the `Action` plus `response` and `place`. It has no `success` field.

x.description: The position of the target at the start.

y.description: The position of the target at the start.

eta.description: Milliseconds until the hit: `floor(1000 * distance / G.projectiles[projectile].speed)`. Always present: the object starts with `eta: 0` (node/server.js:3546-3556), and an instant projectile keeps `0` and gets `instant: true` (node/server.js:3582-3586).

m.description: The map-change counter of the target.

pid.description: The projectile id, 6 random characters. The later `hit` carries it.

projectile.description: A key of `G.projectiles`. Always present: `commence_attack` reads `G.projectiles[def.projectile].speed` (node/server.js:3582-3583), which throws when it is `null`, so every sent `action` has one (node/server.js:3564-3565).

instant.description: The projectile has no travel time.

damage.description: The damage before the defenses of the target. Absent for a heal and for 0 damage.

heal.description: The heal amount, for a heal.

positive.description: The action helps the target (a heal or a buff).

conditions.description: Conditions that the hit can apply, for example `"poisoned"`, `"frozen"`.

origin_offset.description: Cavalry volleys only: the side offset of this shot in px, `-16` or `16` (`npc.volley_offset`, node/logic/cavalry.js:484; `0` is not sent, node/server.js:3562).

map.description: The map of the attacker when the projectile hits. The server sets it at the hit (node/server.js:3733), so only a reflected `action` has it.

in.description: The instance of the attacker when the projectile hits (node/server.js:3734). Only a reflected `action` has it.

reflect.description: Only on a reflected `action`: the damage of the reflection, `ceil(attack * (0.9 to 1.1))`. The target reflected a magical attack (`reflection`), so `attacker` and `target` change places, `pid` is new, `x`, `y` and `m` are of the old attacker. `eta` keeps the value of the first action: the server does not change it (node/server.js:3775-3809).

x-al-confirm.note: The Action replaces `resolve`, so there is no `success`

AttackFailureDisabled.title: AttackFailureDisabled
AttackFailureDisabled.description: `attack` failure: You are disabled: dead (`rip`), or `stunned`, `fingered`, `stoned`, `deepfreezed` or `sleeping`. Silence and the `konami` skin do not stop `attack`.

AttackFailureCooldown.title: AttackFailureCooldown
AttackFailureCooldown.description: `attack` failure: The attack is on cooldown. The cooldown is `attack_ms` (`round(1000 / frequency)`, node/server.js:1627) plus any `penalty_cd`, up to 10,000 ms.

AttackFailureTooFar.title: AttackFailureTooFar
AttackFailureTooFar.description: `attack` failure: The target is farther than `range + xrange`. `xrange` is a leeway of up to 25 px; an attack that uses it lowers it.

dist.description: The distance to the target in px.

AttackFailureData.title: AttackFailureData
AttackFailureData.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: your instance or the instance of the target is paused.

AttackFailureData2.title: AttackFailureData2
AttackFailureData2.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: you or the target is a cave actor, and the cave rules say that the target is not hostile.

AttackFailureAttackFailed.title: AttackFailureAttackFailed
AttackFailureAttackFailed.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: you are a merchant without a `dartgun` in `mainhand`.

AttackFailureData3.title: AttackFailureData3
AttackFailureData3.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: you are a merchant without a `dartgun` in `mainhand`.

AttackFailureAttackFailed2.title: AttackFailureAttackFailed2
AttackFailureAttackFailed2.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: `mode.pvp_level_gap` is on (only on the `HARDCORE` server), the target is a character, and your levels differ by more than 10.

AttackFailureData4.title: AttackFailureData4
AttackFailureData4.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: `mode.pvp_level_gap` is on (only on the `HARDCORE` server), the target is a character, and your levels differ by more than 10.

AttackFailureData5.title: AttackFailureData5
AttackFailureData5.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: the target is a character that is not in a PvP area (`is_in_pvp`), or the target is an NPC.

AttackFailureNoMp.title: AttackFailureNoMp
AttackFailureNoMp.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: your `mp` is less than your `mp_cost`.

AttackFailureData6.title: AttackFailureData6
AttackFailureData6.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: your `mp` is less than your `mp_cost`.

AttackFailureFriendly.title: AttackFailureFriendly
AttackFailureFriendly.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: you are on a `safe` map; or the map is `duelland` and you or the target is not in the duel; or `mode.friendly_fire` is off (it is on, node/server.js:286) and the target is in your party or guild.

AttackFailureData7.title: AttackFailureData7
AttackFailureData7.description: `attack` failure: `commence_attack`: you are on a `safe` map; or the map is `duelland` and you or the target is not in the duel; or `mode.friendly_fire` is off (it is on, node/server.js:286) and the target is in your party or guild.

AttackFailure.title: AttackFailure
AttackFailure.description: `attack`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

AttackAlsoSkillTimeout.title: AttackAlsoSkillTimeout
AttackAlsoSkillTimeout.description: `attack` also sends `skill_timeout` (you): Success: the cooldown starts. Also before `action` for `invis` when the attack ends your invisibility.

name.description: The skill whose cooldown starts.

user.x-al-coerce: must be `typeof "string"`, else the server ignores the request; the prefix `US_` is added if it is missing

auth.description: The session auth token. It must be in the `auths` list of the account.
auth.x-al-coerce: must be `typeof "string"`, else the server ignores the request

character.description: The id of the character to start (the `id` from the character list, not the name).
character.x-al-coerce: must be `typeof "string"`, else the server ignores the request; the prefix `CH_` is added if it is missing

code_slot.description: The CODE slot to load. If no slot has that key, the server looks for a slot whose file name matches (`find_code_slot`, adventure_functions.js:140-153). The code comes back in `start`.

passphrase.description: Only on a server with `gameplay == "test"`, where it is required. It must be `"potato salad"`.

bot.description: If it matches, the character becomes a bot (`afk: "bot"`).
bot.x-al-coerce: compared with `==` to the `BOT_MASTER` key of the server

no_html.description: Marks the session as a code client (`afk: "code"`). If the value is the name of a character online on this server, that name becomes `player.controller`; else `controller` is `""`.

epl.description: The platform. `"mas"` needs `receipt`; `"steam"` needs `ticket`; `"tauri_steam"` uses `ticket` or a Steam id that the account saved before. Any other value, or `"mas"`/`"steam"` without its field, means web.

receipt.description: A Mac App Store receipt, for `epl: "mas"`.

mainframe_session.description: The server checks it against the mainframe assignment of the character (`is_valid_mainframe_session`). A mismatch fails the login with `mainframe_issue`.

x-al-confirm.note: ALClient sends `user` and `character` with their `US_` / `CH_` prefixes and `passphrase: ""` (live capture)

AuthTauriSteam.title: AuthTauriSteam
AuthTauriSteam.description: `auth` reply (Tauri Steam): `epl: "tauri_steam"` and the Steam check succeeds. It comes before `start`.

status.description: `persisted_steam_id`: the account had a Steam id saved. `steam_ticket_verified`: the server verified `ticket`.

pid.description: The Steam id. It becomes the `pid` of the character.

ticket_received.description: `true` when the request has a truthy `ticket`.

AuthTauriSteamError.title: AuthTauriSteamError
AuthTauriSteamError.description: `auth` reply (Tauri Steam error): `epl: "tauri_steam"` and the Steam check fails. The login continues as web and ends with `start`.

reason.description: `steam_auth_failed`: the ticket did not verify, or the check threw. `steam_link_failed`: the server could not save the Steam id to the account.

stage.description: The step that failed. `verify_ticket` goes with `steam_auth_failed`; the other two go with `steam_link_failed`.

ticket_received.description: `true` when the request has a truthy `ticket`.

AuthAlsoGameResponse.title: AuthAlsoGameResponse
AuthAlsoGameResponse.description: `auth` also sends `game_response` (every character of your account online on this server, you included): Later, after `start`, one time per account: the server sends the Tracktrix mail (when the account has not got it yet).

count.description: The number of unread mails of the account after the Tracktrix mail, up to 100 (`update_mail_count`).

x-al-confirm.note: `count` is undefined (no reply) when the mail was not sent

AuthAlsoOnline.title: AuthAlsoOnline
AuthAlsoOnline.description: `auth` also sends `online` (your friends: each online character, on any server, whose `friends` holds your account): Later, after `start`, when the account has friends and the character is not `private`.

name.description: Your name.

server.description: The region and the name of this server, for example `"EU I"`.

BankRequestWithdraw.title: BankRequestWithdraw
BankRequestWithdraw.description: `bank`, variant withdraw: Takes gold from the bank.

operation.description: The bank operation. It selects the variant. Any other value (or none) changes nothing and sends the **Success** reply.

amount.description: The gold to take from the bank.
