num.description: `num` after `to_number`.

slot.description: The trade slot.

EquipEquipped.title: EquipEquipped
EquipEquipped.description: `equip` reply (Equipped): Gear: `can_equip_item` accepts the item for the slot. The server swaps it with the item in the slot (a displaced item with `b` is deleted), and adds 120 ms to `penalty_cd` (at most 120,000 ms).

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

num.description: `num` after `to_number`.

slot.description: The equipment slot that got the item. It can differ from `slot` in the request, for example `weapon` becomes `mainhand` or `offhand`.

EquipElixir.title: EquipElixir
EquipElixir.description: `equip` reply (Elixir): The item is of type `elixir`. The server puts it in `slots.elixir` with `expires`. The same elixir again sets the time left to the full duration plus 97.5% of the old time left. An old elixir with `withdrawal` gives you that condition. A new elixir with `withdrawal` removes the condition `withdrawal`.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

num.description: `num` after `to_number`.

EquipPotion.title: EquipPotion
EquipPotion.description: `equip` reply (Potion): The item has `gives` (a potion). The server adds each `[stat, amount]` of `gives` to you, at least 1 for each stat. `poisoned` halves the amounts. A `debuff` potion also removes the debuff conditions. The potion cooldown starts: `def.cooldown`, else 2,000 ms, or 0.1 ms for an XP potion.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

num.description: `num` after `to_number`.

EquipUsed.title: EquipUsed
EquipUsed.description: `equip` reply (Used): `cxjar` (adds the cosmetic in `data`), an item of type `licence` (adds 7 minutes to `licenced`), or an item of type `spawner` (spawns the trap monster `spawn` at your position, with you as owner). The server removes one unit.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

num.description: `num` after `to_number`.

acx.description: All your cosmetics now: name to count.

name.description: The cosmetic from `data` of the jar.

EquipFailureInvalid.title: EquipFailureInvalid
EquipFailureInvalid.description: `equip` failure: `num` is the inventory length or more. The server stopped your channeled actions (`c`) already.

EquipFailureItemBlocked.title: EquipFailureItemBlocked
EquipFailureItemBlocked.description: `equip` failure: The item has the flag `b`.

EquipFailureItemPlaceholder.title: EquipFailureItemPlaceholder
EquipFailureItemPlaceholder.description: `equip` failure: The item is a placeholder: an upgrade or compound runs on the slot.

EquipFailureNotEnough.title: EquipFailureNotEnough
EquipFailureNotEnough.description: `equip` failure: `q` is more than the units of the item (`q || 1`).

EquipFailureTradeOfferInvalid.title: EquipFailureTradeOfferInvalid
EquipFailureTradeOfferInvalid.description: `equip` failure: Not a giveaway: `want` does not name an item of `G.items` (or names `placeholder`), or its `p` is not a key of `G.titles`.

EquipFailureSlotOccuppied.title: EquipFailureSlotOccuppied
EquipFailureSlotOccuppied.description: `equip` failure: The trade slot holds an item already (a listing, or a wishlist entry with `b`). The code has this spelling.

EquipFailureNotReady.title: EquipFailureNotReady
EquipFailureNotReady.description: `equip` failure: Potion: the potion cooldown runs.

EquipFailureCantEquip.title: EquipFailureCantEquip
EquipFailureCantEquip.description: `equip` failure: Gear: `can_equip_item` refuses the item for the slot. For a two-handed weapon while you hold an offhand item, a `game_log` comes first.

EquipFailureCantConsume.title: EquipFailureCantConsume
EquipFailureCantConsume.description: `equip` failure: `consume` is set and the item is none of the kinds above.

EquipFailure.title: EquipFailure
EquipFailure.description: `equip`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

EquipAlsoEval.title: EquipAlsoEval
EquipAlsoEval.description: `equip` also sends `eval` (you): Potion, after the stats change.

code.description: `"pot_timeout(<ms>)"`: the cooldown for the official client. For an XP potion it is `pot_timeout(120)`.

EquipBatchRequest.title: EquipBatchRequest
EquipBatchRequest.x-al-note: The server uses the first 15 entries and ignores the rest. An entry that is a number or a string reads as `{}` and gets `"no_item"`. A `null` entry throws.

x-al-confirm.note: Of each entry the handler reads `num` and `slot`. Setting `.num` on a number or string entry does nothing (no strict mode), so `num` reads `undefined` and the slot is empty

EquipBatchSuccess.title: EquipBatchSuccess
EquipBatchSuccess.description: `equip_batch` reply (Success): The payload is an array. The server equips the entries in order and stops at the first entry that fails. It sends this reply also when an entry failed: the code of that entry is the last element of `slots`.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

slots.description: One element for each entry that the server read: a result for each equipped entry, then the code of the first failed entry (if any). `invalid`: `num` is past the end of the inventory. `no_item`: the slot is empty. `item_blocked`: the item has the flag `b`. `item_placeholder`: an upgrade or compound runs on the slot. `cant_equip`: `can_equip_item` refuses the item for the slot.

EquipBatchFailureInvalid.title: EquipBatchFailureInvalid
EquipBatchFailureInvalid.description: `equip_batch` failure: The payload is not an array. The server stopped your channeled actions (`c`) already.

EquipBatchFailure.title: EquipBatchFailure
EquipBatchFailure.description: `equip_batch`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

ErrorRequest.title: ErrorRequest
ErrorRequest.x-al-note: Any payload. The handler body is empty. A comment says that a client `error` event brought the server down before. The official client never sends `error`: the only `emit("error", ...)` in its code is inside the socket.io library, on its own connection object, and it does not go to the server (js/socket.io/4.2.0/socket.io.js:453).

x-al-confirm.note: The handler body is a comment

command.description: The mainframe terminal on the `cyberland` map. The commands are in the Notes. When it is falsy, the handler skips the mainframe part.
command.x-al-coerce: tested for truthiness, compared with `==`, then read with `.startsWith` and `.split(" ")`. A truthy value that is not a string throws at `.startsWith` (Failure row 3)

request_id.description: Mainframe only. With it, you also get a `game_response` with the result (success or failure).

pass.description: Admin only. When it is correct, the server runs `code`.

code.description: Admin only: JavaScript that the server runs. The server sends nothing back.

x-al-confirm.note: The handler reads `command`, `request_id`, `pass` and `code`

EvalMainframeAnswer.title: EvalMainframeAnswer
EvalMainframeAnswer.description: `eval` reply (Mainframe answer): A mainframe command ran. It goes to every client whose view holds (0, -100) on `cyberland`, so you get it only when you are near that point.

message.description: The answer: see the commands in the Notes.

x-al-confirm.note: Every answer is a literal in the handler

EvalResultWithRequestId.title: EvalResultWithRequestId
EvalResultWithRequestId.description: `eval` reply (Result, With request_id): A mainframe command ran. Sent after `chat_log`, only when the request has `request_id`.

request_id.description: Your `request_id`.

authorized.description: `false` only for an unknown command (the `UNAUTHORIZED` answers).

reply.description: The answer, the same as `message` of the `chat_log`.

request_id.description: Your `request_id`.

EvalFailureNotConnected.title: EvalFailureNotConnected
EvalFailureNotConnected.description: `eval` failure: You are not on `cyberland`, or you are dead.

request_id.description: Your `request_id`.

EvalFailure.title: EvalFailure
EvalFailure.description: `eval`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

EvalAlsoDrop.title: EvalAlsoDrop
EvalAlsoDrop.description: `eval` also sends `drop` (you): `"give spares"` with items in `S.misc.spares`: after the `chat_log`, `drop_one_thing` makes a `chest1` with the spares at (1, -88) on `cyberland`. Then the list is empty.

items.description: How many item stacks the chest holds (`drop.items.length`). The spares are `electronics` and `networkcard`, which stack, so it is 1 or 2.

id.description: The chest id, 30 random characters. Send it with `open_chest`.

x-al-confirm.liveNeeded: The spares list is live state (`S.misc.spares`, which the cyberland timer grows at random every 10 s or so, node/server_functions.js:2866-2895): whether it holds anything, and so whether `drop` comes, depends on the server.

item_num.description: The slot of an item that you can exchange (`G.items[name].e`).
item_num.x-al-coerce: none: used as an array key, so `"4"` also works. Any other value reads an empty slot

x-al-confirm.note: The handler reads only `item_num`

ExchangeStarted.title: ExchangeStarted
ExchangeStarted.description: `exchange` reply (Started): All checks pass. The server removes `G.items[name].e` units of the item, puts a placeholder in the first empty slot and starts the timer.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

success.description: Always `false`: the result comes when the timer ends.

num.description: The slot of the placeholder `{name: "placeholder"}`. This placeholder has no `p`.

ExchangeCosmetic.title: ExchangeCosmetic
ExchangeCosmetic.description: `exchange` reply (Cosmetic): The timer ends and the roll gives a cosmetic (`cx`) or a cosmetic bundle (`cxbundle`).

acx.description: All your cosmetics now: name to count (`player.p.acx`).

name.description: The cosmetic or the bundle that you got.

ExchangeQuestDone.title: ExchangeQuestDone
ExchangeQuestDone.description: `exchange` reply (Quest done): The timer ends, after the results, when the item has a `quest` (for example `seashell`, `leather`, `gemfragment`, `lostearring`, or `cx` for `cosmo*`).

suffix.description: The level of an upgrade or compound item (for example `lostearring`), else `""`. A level of 0 also gives `""`: the server stores the level only when it is truthy (node/server.js:6670-6672) and sends `ref.s || ""`.

ExchangeFailureCantInBank.title: ExchangeFailureCantInBank
ExchangeFailureCantInBank.description: `exchange` failure: The character is in the bank.

ExchangeFailureItemLocked.title: ExchangeFailureItemLocked
ExchangeFailureItemLocked.description: `exchange` failure: The item has the lock `l`.

ExchangeFailureInventoryFull.title: ExchangeFailureInventoryFull
ExchangeFailureInventoryFull.description: `exchange` failure: No empty inventory slot (`esize <= 0`), and the item is a stack with `q` above 1.

ExchangeFailureDistance.title: ExchangeFailureDistance
ExchangeFailureDistance.description: `exchange` failure: You are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the NPC: the quest NPC of the item (`G.quests[quest]`), else the exchange NPC on `main`. A character with a `computer` passes this check.

ExchangeFailureExchangeNotenough.title: ExchangeFailureExchangeNotenough
ExchangeFailureExchangeNotenough.description: `exchange` failure: `e` is above 1, and the stack has fewer than `e` units.

ExchangeFailure.title: ExchangeFailure
ExchangeFailure.description: `exchange`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

ExchangeAlsoUpgrade.title: ExchangeAlsoUpgrade
ExchangeAlsoUpgrade.description: `exchange` also sends `upgrade` (nearby): The timer ends, for an item without a `quest`. Every client whose view holds the exchange NPC on `main`.

num.description: The slot of the stack of tokens (an item of type `token`: `funtoken`, `monstertoken`, `pvptoken` or `friendtoken`).
num.x-al-coerce: none: used as an array key, so `"2"` also works. Any other value reads an empty slot

name.description: What to buy: a key of `G.tokens[token]`. The key is an `ItemName`, or `<item>-<data>`: then the new item is `<item>` with `data: "<data>"` (for example `"cxjar-xgravestone2"`).

q.description: A safety check: the quantity of the token stack now. If it does not match, the server refuses. This stops a second buy on a stack that changed.
q.x-al-coerce: compared with `!=` to the quantity of the stack, so `"140"` also matches 140

x-al-confirm.note: The handler reads `num`, `name` and `q`

ExchangeBuySuccess.title: ExchangeBuySuccess
ExchangeBuySuccess.description: `exchange_buy` reply (Success): All checks pass. The server removes the price in tokens and adds the item. A price below 1 means that 1 token buys `parseInt(1 / price)` units.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

num.description: The slot that got the item.

cevent.description: Tells the official client to fire its `exchange_buy` code event.

ExchangeBuyFailureCantInBank.title: ExchangeBuyFailureCantInBank
ExchangeBuyFailureCantInBank.description: `exchange_buy` failure: The character is in the bank.

ExchangeBuyFailureInvalid.title: ExchangeBuyFailureInvalid
ExchangeBuyFailureInvalid.description: `exchange_buy` failure: The slot is empty, or the item is not of type `token`.

ExchangeBuyFailureItemLocked.title: ExchangeBuyFailureItemLocked
ExchangeBuyFailureItemLocked.description: `exchange_buy` failure: The token stack has the lock `l`.

ExchangeBuyFailureSafetyCheck.title: ExchangeBuyFailureSafetyCheck
ExchangeBuyFailureSafetyCheck.description: `exchange_buy` failure: `q` is not the quantity of the stack.

ExchangeBuyFailureDistance.title: ExchangeBuyFailureDistance
ExchangeBuyFailureDistance.description: `exchange_buy` failure: You are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the NPC of the token on `main`: `G.items[token].npc` (`monsterhunter` for `monstertoken`), else `<token>s`. A character with a `computer` passes this check.

ExchangeBuyFailureExchangeNotenough.title: ExchangeBuyFailureExchangeNotenough
ExchangeBuyFailureExchangeNotenough.description: `exchange_buy` failure: The stack has fewer tokens than the price.

ExchangeBuyFailureInventoryFull.title: ExchangeBuyFailureInventoryFull
ExchangeBuyFailureInventoryFull.description: `exchange_buy` failure: The item does not fit in the inventory, and the token stack does not become empty.

ExchangeBuyFailure.title: ExchangeBuyFailure
ExchangeBuyFailure.description: `exchange_buy`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

ExchangeBuyAlsoUpgrade.title: ExchangeBuyAlsoUpgrade
ExchangeBuyAlsoUpgrade.description: `exchange_buy` also sends `upgrade` (nearby): Success. Every client whose view holds the token NPC.

type.description: The token name plus `s`, for example `"funtokens"` or `"monstertokens"`.

FriendRequestRequest.title: FriendRequestRequest
FriendRequestRequest.description: `friend`, variant request: Asks a character on this server to be friends. The server keeps the request until the other character accepts it.

event.description: The action. Another value gets only the `in_progress` reply.

name.description: The exact name of a character online on this server.
name.x-al-coerce: none: `data.name || ""`, used as a key of `name_to_id`

FriendRequestAccept.title: FriendRequestAccept
FriendRequestAccept.description: `friend`, variant accept: Accepts a friend request that `name` sent to you. The server adds each account to the `friends` of the other, after the `in_progress` reply.

event.description: The action. Another value gets only the `in_progress` reply.

name.description: The exact name of the character that sent the request (the `name` of the `friend` `{event: "request"}` event).
name.x-al-coerce: none: part of the key `name + "-" + your name` of the open requests

request_id.description: Any truthy value. With it, the server sends `friend_complete` on success and copies `request_id`, `name` and `cevent` into the later failures. Without it, the success has no reply to you, and the server does not update the `friends` of your character itself: the `friend` `{event: "new"}` event carries the change.

FriendRequestUnfriend.title: FriendRequestUnfriend
FriendRequestUnfriend.description: `friend`, variant unfriend: Ends a friendship, after the `in_progress` reply.

event.description: The action. Another value gets only the `in_progress` reply.

name.description: A character name or an account id. The server looks for a character with that name. If there is none, it looks for an account with that id.
name.x-al-coerce: `"" + (name || "")`, then lower case without spaces for the character search

request_id.description: The server copies it into the later reply.

FriendInProgress.description: `friend` reply (In progress): At once, for `accept` (when the request exists), for `unfriend`, and for an unknown `event`. The database change of `accept` and `unfriend` runs after this reply. It does not carry `request_id`.

success.description: Always `false`: the change is not done yet.

x-al-confirm.note: `success_response` keeps `success: false` (it only sets `true` when `success !== false`)

FriendRequestSent.title: FriendRequestSent
FriendRequestSent.description: `friend` reply (Request sent): The request is stored, and the other character got `friend` `{event: "request"}`.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

FriendAlreadyFriends.title: FriendAlreadyFriends
FriendAlreadyFriends.description: `friend` reply (Already friends): The account of the other character is in your `friends` already, or it is your own account. Nothing changes. The reply has `success: true`, not `failed`.

HealRequest.title: HealRequest

id.description: The target: a character name (your own name too) or a monster id. A missing or `null` id fails with `no_target`.
id.x-al-coerce: `"" + parseInt(id) === "" + id` means a monster id, else a character name

HealRequest.x-al-others: ignored: the handler calls `skill` with `{name: "heal", id}` only

x-al-confirm.note: The handler passes only `id` on to `skill`

HealSuccess.title: HealSuccess
HealSuccess.description: `heal` reply (Success): All checks pass and the projectile starts. The object is the `Action` plus `response` and `place`. It has `heal` and `positive`, and no `damage` or `success` field.

x.description: The position of the target at the start.

y.description: The position of the target at the start.

eta.description: Milliseconds until the hit: `floor(1000 * distance / G.projectiles[projectile].speed)`. Always present: the object starts with `eta: 0` (node/server.js:3546-3556), and an instant projectile keeps `0` and gets `instant: true` (node/server.js:3582-3586).

m.description: The map-change counter of the target.

pid.description: The projectile id, 6 random characters. The later `hit` carries it.

projectile.description: A key of `G.projectiles`. Always present: `commence_attack` reads `G.projectiles[def.projectile].speed` (node/server.js:3582-3583), which throws when it is `null`, so every sent `action` has one (node/server.js:3564-3565).

instant.description: The projectile has no travel time.

damage.description: The damage before the defenses of the target. Absent for a heal and for 0 damage.

heal.description: The heal amount, for a heal.

positive.description: The action helps the target (a heal or a buff).

conditions.description: Conditions that the hit can apply, for example `"poisoned"`, `"frozen"`.

origin_offset.description: Cavalry volleys only: the side offset of this shot in px, `-16` or `16` (`npc.volley_offset`, node/logic/cavalry.js:484; `0` is not sent, node/server.js:3562).

map.description: The map of the attacker when the projectile hits. The server sets it at the hit (node/server.js:3733), so only a reflected `action` has it.

in.description: The instance of the attacker when the projectile hits (node/server.js:3734). Only a reflected `action` has it.

reflect.description: Only on a reflected `action`: the damage of the reflection, `ceil(attack * (0.9 to 1.1))`. The target reflected a magical attack (`reflection`), so `attacker` and `target` change places, `pid` is new, `x`, `y` and `m` are of the old attacker. `eta` keeps the value of the first action: the server does not change it (node/server.js:3775-3809).

x-al-confirm.note: `G.skills.heal` has `projectile: "plight"` and `heal: true`; the Action replaces `resolve`, so there is no `success`

HealFailureDisabled.title: HealFailureDisabled
HealFailureDisabled.description: `heal` failure: You are disabled: dead (`rip`), or `stunned`, `fingered`, `stoned`, `deepfreezed` or `sleeping`.

HealFailureSkillCantIncapacitated.title: HealFailureSkillCantIncapacitated
HealFailureSkillCantIncapacitated.description: `heal` failure: You are `silenced`, or your temporary skin is `konami`.

HealFailureCooldown.title: HealFailureCooldown
HealFailureCooldown.description: `heal` failure: The attack cooldown runs. `heal` shares it (`share: "attack"`): the cooldown is `attack_ms` (`round(1000 / frequency)`, node/server.js:1627), and the last use is `last.attack`.

HealFailureSkillCantUse.title: HealFailureSkillCantUse
HealFailureSkillCantUse.description: `heal` failure: You are not a priest (`G.skills.heal.class`), and your `role` is not `gm`.

HealFailureTooFar.title: HealFailureTooFar
HealFailureTooFar.description: `heal` failure: The target is farther than `range + xrange`. `xrange` is a leeway of up to 25 px; a heal that uses it lowers it.

dist.description: The distance to the target in px.

HealFailureData.title: HealFailureData
HealFailureData.description: `heal` failure: `commence_attack`: your instance or the instance of the target is paused, or one of you is entering a zone. No cooldown starts.

HealFailureAttackFailed.title: HealFailureAttackFailed
HealFailureAttackFailed.description: `heal` failure: `commence_attack`: you are a merchant. Only a character with `role: "gm"` passes the class check as a merchant.

HealFailureData2.title: HealFailureData2
HealFailureData2.description: `heal` failure: `commence_attack`: you are a merchant. Only a character with `role: "gm"` passes the class check as a merchant.

HealFailureData3.title: HealFailureData3
HealFailureData3.description: `heal` failure: `commence_attack`: the target is an NPC. A heal on a character outside a PvP area passes (a heal is `positive`).

HealFailureFriendly.title: HealFailureFriendly
HealFailureFriendly.description: `heal` failure: `commence_attack`: the map is `duelland`, and you or the target is not in the duel. A `safe` map, your party and your guild do not stop a heal.

HealFailureData4.title: HealFailureData4
HealFailureData4.description: `heal` failure: `commence_attack`: the map is `duelland`, and you or the target is not in the duel. A `safe` map, your party and your guild do not stop a heal.

HealFailure.title: HealFailure
HealFailure.description: `heal`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

HealAlsoSkillTimeout.title: HealAlsoSkillTimeout
HealAlsoSkillTimeout.description: `heal` also sends `skill_timeout` (you): Success: the cooldown starts. Its `name` is `"attack"`, because `heal` shares the attack cooldown.

name.description: The cooldown that starts: the attack cooldown.

x-al-confirm.note: `consume_skill` swaps `heal` for its `share`, `attack`

a.description: The first slot. If the two items stack, this slot gets the stack.
a.x-al-coerce: `max(0, parseInt(a) || 0)`, so a missing or non-numeric value is slot 0

b.description: The second slot. If the two items stack, this slot becomes empty.
b.x-al-coerce: `max(0, parseInt(b) || 0)`, so a missing or non-numeric value is slot 0

x-al-confirm.note: The handler reads only `a` and `b`

ImoveSuccess.title: ImoveSuccess
ImoveSuccess.description: `imove` reply (Success): All checks pass. If the two items can stack (`can_stack`: same stackable item, the same title unless G marks the title `stackable`, the same `data` for a `cxjar`, the same PvP flag, neither locked nor on a stand, and the total fits in one stack), slot `a` gets the sum and slot `b` becomes empty. Else, the two slots swap. A move to an empty slot is a swap.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

ImoveFailureInvalid.title: ImoveFailureInvalid
ImoveFailureInvalid.description: `imove` failure: `a` and `b` are the same slot after the conversion.

ImoveFailureItemPlaceholder.title: ImoveFailureItemPlaceholder
ImoveFailureItemPlaceholder.description: `imove` failure: One of the two slots holds a placeholder (an upgrade or a compound runs on it).

ImoveFailure.title: ImoveFailure
ImoveFailure.description: `imove`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

InteractionRequestCave.title: InteractionRequestCave
InteractionRequestCave.description: `interaction`, variant cave: The Cave of Many Dreams: `action` selects what to do. The reply always comes as one `game_response` `data` with `interaction: "cave"`, after the async work.

type.description: The thing to interact with. It selects the variant. Leave it out for a konami `key`. Any other value (or none) with no `key` gets no reply.

request_id.description: Changes some replies: see each variant. The cave and cavalry replies always copy it. With it, `citizen_route`, `newyear_tree` and `the_lever` also send a `data` reply on success, and their `distance` failure (except for `citizen_route`) is an object.

action.description: What to do. `enter` opens a run for you and your party (or joins your run again). `info` reads the daily visit state. The others need an open run. A missing or unknown value fails with `invalid_interaction` (after the run check).

room.description: `talk` and `buy`: the id of the room.

actor.description: `talk`: the id of the actor to talk to. Without it, the server takes the nearest actor that can talk.

choice.description: `vote`: the id of the open vote (`choice.id` in the cave state).

option.description: `vote`: the id of the option that you vote for.

x-al-confirm.note: `action`, `room`, `actor`, `choice`, `option` are compared with `===` in `cave_interaction`

MailDeliveryFailed.title: MailDeliveryFailed
MailDeliveryFailed.description: `mail` reply (Delivery failed): Later: the delivery failed. The server keeps the gold. For `nocharacter`, `nouser` and `unknown`, it gives the item back if you are online and have a free slot. Then a `player` update with `reopen` follows. Else you lose the item. For `coms_failure`, you always lose the item. A missing or non-string `to` throws before the first `await` of the delivery, so that `mail_failed` (`coms_failure`) comes at once, before the `player` update and `mail_sending`.

instant.description: The projectile has no travel time.

damage.description: The damage before the defenses of the target. Absent for a heal and for 0 damage.

heal.description: The heal amount, for a heal.

positive.description: The action helps the target (a heal or a buff).

conditions.description: Conditions that the hit can apply, for example `"poisoned"`, `"frozen"`.

map.description: The map of the attacker when the projectile hits. The server sets it at the hit (node/server.js:3733), so only a reflected `action` has it.

reflect.description: Only on a reflected `action`: the damage of the reflection, `ceil(attack * (0.9 to 1.1))`. The target reflected a magical attack (`reflection`), so `attacker` and `target` change places, `pid` is new, `x`, `y` and `m` are of the old attacker. `eta` keeps the value of the first action: the server does not change it (node/server.js:3775-3809).

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

success.description: Always `false`: the result is not known yet.

SkillChannelStarted.title: SkillChannelStarted
SkillChannelStarted.description: `skill` reply (Channel started): The channel starts. The result comes when the channel ends (see Also sent).

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

success.description: Always `false`: the result is not known yet.

x-al-confirm.note: Overridden by `reject` when the zone check fails

SkillDashMove.title: SkillDashMove
SkillDashMove.description: `skill` reply (Dash move): The dash succeeds: the official client runs the code to move the camera. `dash` has a `cooldown` of 0, so no `skill_timeout` comes; the `player` update follows.

code.description: `"ui_move(<x>,<y>)"` with the spot that the server found.

SkillCleansingLight.title: SkillCleansingLight
SkillCleansingLight.description: `skill` reply (Cleansing light): The skill passes the checks.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

cleansed.description: The conditions that the server removed from the target: each one has `cleansable` in `G.conditions`. Can be empty.

SkillGuardiansOath.title: SkillGuardiansOath
SkillGuardiansOath.description: `skill` reply (Guardians oath): The skill passes the checks.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

target.description: The character that now has the oath.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

affected.description: The characters that got the condition, you included.

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

x-al-confirm.note: The states are the keys of `G.skills.paladin_aura.states` (four in the current G)

SkillCburstHits.title: SkillCburstHits
SkillCburstHits.description: `skill` reply (Cburst hits): At least one target got a projectile. The object is the `Action` of the first hit, plus the ids of all projectiles and targets.

x.description: The position of the target at the start.

y.description: The position of the target at the start.

eta.description: Milliseconds until the hit: `floor(1000 * distance / G.projectiles[projectile].speed)`. Always present: the object starts with `eta: 0` (node/server.js:3546-3556), and an instant projectile keeps `0` and gets `instant: true` (node/server.js:3582-3586).

m.description: The map-change counter of the target.

pid.description: The projectile id, 6 random characters. The later `hit` carries it.

projectile.description: A key of `G.projectiles`. Always present: `commence_attack` reads `G.projectiles[def.projectile].speed` (node/server.js:3582-3583), which throws when it is `null`, so every sent `action` has one (node/server.js:3564-3565).

instant.description: The projectile has no travel time.

damage.description: The damage before the defenses of the target. Absent for a heal and for 0 damage.

heal.description: The heal amount, for a heal.

positive.description: The action helps the target (a heal or a buff).

conditions.description: Conditions that the hit can apply, for example `"poisoned"`, `"frozen"`.

origin_offset.description: Cavalry volleys only: the side offset of this shot in px, `-16` or `16` (`npc.volley_offset`, node/logic/cavalry.js:484; `0` is not sent, node/server.js:3562).

map.description: The map of the attacker when the projectile hits. The server sets it at the hit (node/server.js:3733), so only a reflected `action` has it.

in.description: The instance of the attacker when the projectile hits (node/server.js:3734). Only a reflected `action` has it.

reflect.description: Only on a reflected `action`: the damage of the reflection, `ceil(attack * (0.9 to 1.1))`. The target reflected a magical attack (`reflection`), so `attacker` and `target` change places, `pid` is new, `x`, `y` and `m` are of the old attacker. `eta` keeps the value of the first action: the server does not change it (node/server.js:3775-3809).

pids.description: The projectile id of each hit, in hit order. Each later `hit` carries one of them.

targets.description: The target of each hit, in the same order.

SkillMultiShotHits.title: SkillMultiShotHits
SkillMultiShotHits.description: `skill` reply (Multi-shot hits): At least one target got a projectile. The object is the `Action` of the first hit, plus the ids of all projectiles and targets.

x.description: The position of the target at the start.

y.description: The position of the target at the start.

eta.description: Milliseconds until the hit: `floor(1000 * distance / G.projectiles[projectile].speed)`. Always present: the object starts with `eta: 0` (node/server.js:3546-3556), and an instant projectile keeps `0` and gets `instant: true` (node/server.js:3582-3586).

targets.description: The target of each hit, in the same order.

SkillTrackResult.title: SkillTrackResult
SkillTrackResult.description: `skill` reply (Track result): Always: the characters in your instance within 1,440 px, nearest first. NPCs and you are not in the list. Before `skill_timeout`.

SkillStomp.title: SkillStomp
SkillStomp.description: `skill` reply (Stomp): Always, also when the skill stunned nothing (`ids` is empty).

request_id.description: A copy of `request_id` from the request, on handlers that copy it.

ids.description: The monsters, and in PvP the characters, that the skill stunned.

SkillStompImmune.title: SkillStompImmune
SkillStompImmune.description: `skill` reply (Stomp immune): A monster in range is `immune`. One for each immune monster.

SkillScareImmune.title: SkillScareImmune
SkillScareImmune.description: `skill` reply (Scare immune): A monster in range is `immune`. One for each immune monster.

SkillCleaveHits.title: SkillCleaveHits
SkillCleaveHits.description: `skill` reply (Cleave hits): At least one target got a projectile. The object is the `Action` of the first hit, plus the ids of all projectiles and targets. Else the reply is the default success.

x.description: The position of the target at the start.

y.description: The position of the target at the start.

eta.description: Milliseconds until the hit: `floor(1000 * distance / G.projectiles[projectile].speed)`. Always present: the object starts with `eta: 0` (node/server.js:3546-3556), and an instant projectile keeps `0` and gets `instant: true` (node/server.js:3582-3586).

targets.description: The target of each hit, in the same order.

SkillMagiportSent.title: SkillMagiportSent
SkillMagiportSent.description: `skill` reply (Magiport sent): Offer path: on a server that is not PvP, with `mode.pve_safe_magiports` on (the default), the target got the offer. The default success follows.

SkillGoldReceived.title: SkillGoldReceived
SkillGoldReceived.description: `skill` reply (Gold received): Always, after the `player` update. The default success follows.

gold.description: The value of one unit of the first item without `l`, times a rate of 0.8 (below level 50) to 1.12 (level 100 and up). Not rounded, so it can have a fraction; your `gold` gets the same fraction. `0` when no item was found.

SkillTemporalSurge.title: SkillTemporalSurge
SkillTemporalSurge.description: `skill` reply (Temporal surge): At least one respawn timer is within 160 px. The default success follows.

times.description: The new time left of each timer: `old * 0.85 - 1000`. It can be negative (the monster respawns at once).

SkillFailureDisabled.title: SkillFailureDisabled
SkillFailureDisabled.description: `skill` failure: You are disabled: dead (`rip`), or `stunned`, `fingered`, `stoned`, `deepfreezed` or `sleeping`.

SkillFailureSkillCantIncapacitated.title: SkillFailureSkillCantIncapacitated
SkillFailureSkillCantIncapacitated.description: `skill` failure: The skill is not `attack`, and you wear the `konami` skin or are silenced (`silenced`; a disabled character counts as silenced).

SkillFailureNoSkill.title: SkillFailureNoSkill
SkillFailureNoSkill.description: `skill` failure: `name` is not a key of `G.skills`.

SkillFailureInvalid.title: SkillFailureInvalid
SkillFailureInvalid.description: `skill` failure: The skill is `3shot`, `5shot` or `fanofknives`, and `ids` is not an array, or a kept entry is not a string or a non-negative safe integer.

SkillFailureSkillCantUse2.title: SkillFailureSkillCantUse2
SkillFailureSkillCantUse2.description: `skill` failure: `ikissyou` (the only emote that the anniversary code reads) that your account does not own (`p.acx`), unless you are a guest of the featured character. `anniversary_state()` always returns the event controller, so this form applies also when no anniversary event runs (then `reason` is `"no_round"`).

phrase.description: `"interface.anniversary_status.<reason>"`.

phrase_args.description: Always `{}`.

SkillFailureNoMp.title: SkillFailureNoMp
SkillFailureNoMp.description: `skill` failure: Your `mp` is less than `G.skills[name].mp * (100 - mp_reduction) / 100`. A GM can `blink` with no MP.

SkillFailureNoLevel.title: SkillFailureNoLevel
SkillFailureNoLevel.description: `skill` failure: Your level is less than `G.skills[name].level`.

SkillFailureCooldown.title: SkillFailureCooldown
SkillFailureCooldown.description: `skill` failure: The skill is on cooldown. A skill with `share` uses the cooldown of the shared skill times `cooldown_multiplier`. A skill with only `reuse_cooldown` (`invis`, `pickpocket`, `fishing`, `mining`) uses that.

skill.description: The `name` from the request (not the shared skill).

id.description: The `id` from the request. Absent when the request has none.

SkillFailureSkillCantWtype.title: SkillFailureSkillCantWtype
SkillFailureSkillCantWtype.description: `skill` failure: The skill has a `wtype`, and the item in your `mainhand` is not of that type (or the slot is empty).

SkillFailureSkillCantSlot.title: SkillFailureSkillCantSlot
SkillFailureSkillCantSlot.description: `skill` failure: The skill has an `offhand_type` (`shield_slam`: a shield), and your `offhand` is not of that type.

SkillFailureSkillCantSafe.title: SkillFailureSkillCantSafe
SkillFailureSkillCantSafe.description: `skill` failure: The skill is `hostile`, and your map is `safe`.

SkillFailureNoTarget.title: SkillFailureNoTarget
SkillFailureNoTarget.description: `skill` failure: The skill has a `target`, and `id` is `undefined` or `null`.

SkillFailureInvalidTarget.title: SkillFailureInvalidTarget
SkillFailureInvalidTarget.description: `skill` failure: The kind of `id` (monster id or character name) is not the kind that `G.skills[name].target` allows (`"monster"`, `"player"`, or `true` for both).

SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget.title: SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget
SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget.description: `skill` failure: An emote skill with a target: the target is in another instance; or, except for `ikissyou`, the target is not in your party, not on your account and not a friend of your account.

SkillFailureInvalidTarget2.title: SkillFailureInvalidTarget2
SkillFailureInvalidTarget2.description: `skill` failure: The skill is `ikissyou`, and the target is an NPC, disconnected, dead or at 0 HP; or you are dead; or the target is on another map or farther than 80 px.

SkillFailureSkillCantRequirements.title: SkillFailureSkillCantRequirements
SkillFailureSkillCantRequirements.description: `skill` failure: The skill has `requirements` (character stats, for example `mentalburst` needs `int` 64), and one of your stats is lower.

SkillFailureSkillCantCharges.title: SkillFailureSkillCantCharges
SkillFailureSkillCantCharges.description: `skill` failure: The worn item has `charge` in `G.items`, and its `charges` are less than that. If it has enough, the server takes the charges here, also if a later check fails.

SkillFailureTooFar.title: SkillFailureTooFar
SkillFailureTooFar.description: `skill` failure: The target is farther than the range: the `range` of the skill (else your `range`), times `range_multiplier`, plus `range_bonus`, plus your level for `throw`, plus your `xrange` (not for a `fixed_range` skill). Before this check, the server removed your `invincible` condition.

dist.description: The distance to the target in px.

SkillFailureSkillCantItem.title: SkillFailureSkillCantItem
SkillFailureSkillCantItem.description: `skill` failure: A skill with `consume`: the slot `num` (or, without `num`, every slot) does not hold that item. If it does, the server removes one.

SkillFailureData.title: SkillFailureData
SkillFailureData.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: your instance or the instance of the target is paused. No cooldown starts.

SkillFailureData2.title: SkillFailureData2
SkillFailureData2.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: you or the target is a cave actor, and the cave rules say that the target is not hostile.

SkillFailureAttackFailed.title: SkillFailureAttackFailed
SkillFailureAttackFailed.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: you are a merchant, and the skill has no `merchant_use` (only `snowball` has it). `attack` with a `dartgun` passes.

SkillFailureData3.title: SkillFailureData3
SkillFailureData3.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: you are a merchant, and the skill has no `merchant_use` (only `snowball` has it). `attack` with a `dartgun` passes.

SkillFailureAttackFailed2.title: SkillFailureAttackFailed2
SkillFailureAttackFailed2.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: `mode.pvp_level_gap` is on (only on the `HARDCORE` server), the target is a character, the skill is hostile, and your levels differ by more than 10.

SkillFailureData4.title: SkillFailureData4
SkillFailureData4.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: `mode.pvp_level_gap` is on (only on the `HARDCORE` server), the target is a character, the skill is hostile, and your levels differ by more than 10.

SkillFailureData5.title: SkillFailureData5
SkillFailureData5.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: a hostile skill on a character that is not in a PvP area, or any of these skills on an NPC.

SkillFailureNoMp2.title: SkillFailureNoMp2
SkillFailureNoMp2.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: `attack` and your `mp` is less than your `mp_cost`; or `burst` and your `mp` is less than 1.

SkillFailureData6.title: SkillFailureData6
SkillFailureData6.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: `attack` and your `mp` is less than your `mp_cost`; or `burst` and your `mp` is less than 1.

SkillFailureData7.title: SkillFailureData7
SkillFailureData7.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`, except `attack` and skills with `pierces_immunity`: the target is `immune`. Clients near the target get `disappearing_text` "IMMUNE!".

SkillFailureFriendly.title: SkillFailureFriendly
SkillFailureFriendly.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: a hostile skill, and you are on a `safe` map; or the map is `duelland` and you or the target is not in the duel; or `mode.friendly_fire` is off (it is on, node/server.js:286) and the target is in your party or guild.

SkillFailureData8.title: SkillFailureData8
SkillFailureData8.description: `skill` failure: `commence_attack`: a hostile skill, and you are on a `safe` map; or the map is `duelland` and you or the target is not in the duel; or `mode.friendly_fire` is off (it is on, node/server.js:286) and the target is in your party or guild.

SkillFailureSkillCantUse3.title: SkillFailureSkillCantUse3
SkillFailureSkillCantUse3.description: `skill` failure: You are `marked` (and not invisible now).

SkillFailureData9.title: SkillFailureData9
SkillFailureData9.description: `skill` failure: No zone of that type is next to you (24 px in one of four directions), or you move. Clients nearby get `ui` `fishing_fail` or `mining_fail`. The MP is spent. These skills have only `reuse_cooldown`, so no cooldown starts.

place.description: The skill. The object has no `failed` field.

SkillFailureData10.title: SkillFailureData10
SkillFailureData10.description: `skill` failure: The point (`x`, `y`) is more than 50 px from you; or the server finds no safe spot at the point, at 80% or at 60% of the way, or the spot is less than 10 px from you. The MP is spent. `dash` has no cooldown.

place.description: The skill. The object has no `failed` field.

SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget2.title: SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget2
SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget2.description: `skill` failure: The target is you, an NPC, dead, in another instance, or fails `is_same` level 3. Level 3 accepts every character while you are not in PvP; in PvP it accepts your account, your IP address, your party, your coop or your team.

SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget3.title: SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget3
SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget3.description: `skill` failure: The target is you, an NPC, dead, in another instance, or fails `is_same` level 3. Level 3 accepts every character while you are not in PvP; in PvP it accepts your account, your IP address, your party, your coop or your team.

SkillFailureSkillCantUse4.title: SkillFailureSkillCantUse4
SkillFailureSkillCantUse4.description: `skill` failure: You already have an active oath on a character.

SkillFailureSkillCantUse5.title: SkillFailureSkillCantUse5
SkillFailureSkillCantUse5.description: `skill` failure: The target already has an active oath.

SkillFailureItemPlaceholder.title: SkillFailureItemPlaceholder
SkillFailureItemPlaceholder.description: `skill` failure: The item is a placeholder (an upgrade or a compound runs).

SkillFailureNotInPvp.title: SkillFailureNotInPvp
SkillFailureNotInPvp.description: `skill` failure: The item is harmful (`essenceoffire`, or it has `attack` or `armor`), the target is a character, and you are not in PvP.

SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget4.title: SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget4
SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget4.description: `skill` failure: You are not in PvP, and the target fails `is_same` level 1 (your account, your IP address, your party, your coop or your team).

SkillFailureTargetAlive.title: SkillFailureTargetAlive
SkillFailureTargetAlive.description: `skill` failure: The target is not dead.

SkillFailureReviveFailed.title: SkillFailureReviveFailed
SkillFailureReviveFailed.description: `skill` failure: The target does not have full HP. The MP and the cooldown are spent.

SkillFailureData11.title: SkillFailureData11
SkillFailureData11.description: `skill` failure: The target does not have full HP. The MP and the cooldown are spent.

place.description: The skill. The object has no `failed` field.

SkillFailureData12.title: SkillFailureData12
SkillFailureData12.description: `skill` failure: No target got a projectile. You also get `disappearing_text` "NO HITS". The MP and the cooldown are spent. A `commence_attack` failure for one target only skips that target, but its first reply (`attack_failed`, `no_mp`, `friendly`) still comes.

SkillFailureData13.title: SkillFailureData13
SkillFailureData13.description: `skill` failure: No heal started. The reply is the `commence_attack` failure of the last member (see the **Attack** variant, with `place: "partyheal"`). The MP and the cooldown are spent.

reason.description: The reason of the last failure.

id.description: The member, for every reason except `cave_paused`.

SkillFailureData14.title: SkillFailureData14
SkillFailureData14.description: `skill` failure: No target got a projectile. You also get `disappearing_text` "NO HITS". The MP and the cooldown are spent. A `commence_attack` failure for one target only skips that target, but its first reply (`attack_failed`, `no_mp`, `friendly`) still comes.

SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget5.title: SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget5
SkillFailureNonFriendlyTarget5.description: `skill` failure: The target fails `is_same` level 1, and your level is below 75 or your `mp` is below 6 times the MP of the skill.

SkillFailureSkillCantPve.title: SkillFailureSkillCantPve
SkillFailureSkillCantPve.description: `skill` failure: The target is a character, you are not in PvP, and it fails `is_same` level 1.

SkillFailureCantEnter.title: SkillFailureCantEnter
SkillFailureCantEnter.description: `skill` failure: You or the target is in a generated map (the dream cave).

SkillFailureMagiportFailed.title: SkillFailureMagiportFailed
SkillFailureMagiportFailed.description: `skill` failure: On a PvP server, or with `mode.pve_safe_magiports` off: the target is not on your account, IP address, party, coop or team, and wears a helmet; or no safe spot is near you. The MP and the cooldown are spent. **Server bug:** `ported` is an undeclared variable (node/server.js:10819-10821). While no code assigned it, the read throws, and you get `game_error` `"ERROR!"`; later the read gives the value of an earlier magiport.

SkillFailureBlinkFailed.title: SkillFailureBlinkFailed
SkillFailureBlinkFailed.description: `skill` failure: No safe spot near (`x`, `y`) on your map.

SkillFailureBlinkFailed2.title: SkillFailureBlinkFailed2
SkillFailureBlinkFailed2.description: `skill` failure: No instance has the name `in`.

SkillFailureCantInBank.title: SkillFailureCantInBank
SkillFailureCantInBank.description: `skill` failure: The instance has a different `mount` than your instance (for example the bank).

SkillFailure.title: SkillFailure
SkillFailure.description: `skill`: every failure reply on `game_response`, in check order. Bare strings are the code alone.

SkillAlsoSkillTimeout.title: SkillAlsoSkillTimeout
SkillAlsoSkillTimeout.description: `skill` also sends `skill_timeout` (you): After the variant, when the skill has a `cooldown` (a skill with `share`: the shared skill). Not after a `commence_attack` failure of a single-target skill, and not for skills with only `reuse_cooldown` (`invis`, `pickpocket`, `fishing`, `mining`: they get it later from the effect).

name.description: The skill whose cooldown starts. For a skill with `share` it is the shared skill (`3shot` gives `attack`, `quickstab` gives `quickpunch`).

SkillAlsoUi.title: SkillAlsoUi
SkillAlsoUi.description: `skill` also sends `ui` (nearby): Any skill that spends MP through `consume_mp`, when the `restore_mp` attribute roll hits: you get twice the MP back instead of paying.

amount.description: The MP added: 2 times the MP of the skill.

SkillAlsoEmote.title: SkillAlsoEmote
SkillAlsoEmote.description: `skill` also sends `emote` (nearby): An emote skill passes the checks.

name.description: The emote (`G.skills[name].emote`).

target.description: The target. Absent for an emote without a target.

SkillAlsoDisappearingText.title: SkillAlsoDisappearingText
SkillAlsoDisappearingText.description: `skill` also sends `disappearing_text` (nearby): The target is `immune`: "IMMUNE!" on the target.

phrase.description: For "IMMUNE!": `"server.floating.immune"`.

phrase_args.description: With `phrase`: `{}`.

y.description: The position of the entity, minus 30.

SkillAlsoDisappear.title: SkillAlsoDisappear
SkillAlsoDisappear.description: `skill` also sends `disappear` (nearby): You become invisible. Every client that saw you or is near you.

SkillAlsoGameResponse.title: SkillAlsoGameResponse
SkillAlsoGameResponse.description: `skill` also sends `game_response` (you): Later: the channel ends. `picked` when the roll takes an item that has `v` (an item from PvP) from a random slot of the target; then `skill_timeout` (from `reuse_cooldown`) and `player`. Else `pick_failed`.

slot.description: `picked` only.

reason.description: `pick_failed` only: the target left, is more than 20 px away, or the slot had no PvP item.
